title: 物品图标：消耗品、魔道具、材料与商品

subject.zh: 一只小圆肚粗玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，软木塞，瓶颈细麻绳系紧，绳下压着一片小绿草叶。粗玻璃略带气泡与淡绿杂色，里面是治疗红#d04040药液，装到瓶肚。
subject.en: A small round-bellied coarse glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, with a cork stopper and thin hemp string tied at the neck, a small green herb leaf tucked under the string. The glass is slightly bubbled with a faint greenish cast and holds healing-red #d04040 liquid up to the belly.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T1 治疗药水：粗玻璃圆肚瓶加麻绳，绳下草叶是辨识点；与次级灵力药水同瓶型，只换药液颜色。

subject.zh: 一只透明玻璃平肩瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，软木塞外封一层红褐色蜡，蜡沿垂下一小滴。瓶身干净无饰，里面是治疗红#d04040药液，一直装到平肩下。
subject.en: A clear flat-shouldered glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its cork sealed over with red-brown wax that has run down in one small drip. The bottle is clean and unadorned, filled with healing-red #d04040 liquid to just below the flat shoulders.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T2 治疗药水：平肩瓶与红褐蜡封是阶标记，红色与次级相同；瓶上不加叶子或任何挂饰。

subject.zh: 一只细高玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，锡盖用细铁丝扣扣紧。修长透明的瓶身里是治疗红#d04040药液，液面在瓶颈下方，玻璃上一道竖向高光。
subject.en: A tall slender glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its tin cap held shut by a thin iron wire clasp. The long clear body holds healing-red #d04040 liquid up to just below the neck, with one vertical highlight on the glass.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T3 治疗药水：细高瓶加锡盖铁丝扣是阶标记，红色不变；与同阶灵力药水只差药液颜色。

subject.zh: 一只小圆肚粗玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，软木塞，瓶颈细麻绳缠两圈打个小结。粗玻璃略带气泡，里面是灵力蓝#4070e0药液，装到瓶肚。
subject.en: A small round-bellied coarse glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, with a cork stopper and thin hemp string wound twice round the neck in a small knot. The slightly bubbled coarse glass holds mana-blue #4070e0 liquid up to the belly.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T1 灵力药水：与次级治疗药水同一种圆肚瓶，只换蓝色药液；绳上不压草叶。

subject.zh: 一只细高玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，锡盖用细铁丝扣扣紧。修长透明的瓶身里是灵力蓝#4070e0药液，液面在瓶颈下方，瓶肩一点小高光。
subject.en: A tall slender glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its tin cap held by a thin iron wire clasp. The long clear body holds mana-blue #4070e0 liquid up to just below the neck, with a small highlight on the shoulder.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T3 灵力药水：与强效治疗药水同一种细高瓶锡盖，只换蓝色药液，不加附件。

subject.zh: 一小束净泉草，斜放，根部用细麻绳扎住。细长的嫩叶是带一点灰的浅草绿#8aaa78，叶面湿润有光，叶尖挂着一两颗小水珠，根须上沾着少许湿泥。
subject.en: A small bunch of spring herb lying at a slant, tied at the base with thin hemp string. Its long slender young leaves are a pale grass green with a hint of grey #8aaa78, damp and glossy, one or two tiny water droplets hanging from the leaf tips and a little wet mud on the roots.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。生用草药：叶尖小水珠与湿润光泽是辨识点；只画一束扎绳的草，不画瓶罐。

subject.zh: 一只粗陶扁肚小酒壶，直立，四分之三视角，壶口在上。壶身是没上釉的灰褐粗陶#8a7a6a，下半截被烟熏得发黑，像在炉灰里埋过；短颈塞着软木塞，细麻绳绕颈系住。壶口挂着一滴琥珀色酒液。
subject.en: A small flat-bellied rough clay liquor flask, upright in three-quarter view with the mouth on top. Unglazed grey-brown earthenware #8a7a6a, its lower half blackened by smoke as if buried in hearth ash; the short neck is stoppered with cork and tied round with thin hemp string. A single amber drop hangs at the mouth.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T1 粗陶；下半截烟熏发黑是辨识点，不要加紫色；与蒸馏烈酒的釉陶细颈瓶区分。

subject.zh: 一只透明玻璃平肩瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，软木塞外封红褐色蜡。里面是体相赭红#a85a3a药液，瓶底沉着一层灰白石英粉，像一截薄薄的石层。
subject.en: A clear flat-shouldered glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its cork sealed with red-brown wax. It holds body-aspect ochre-red #a85a3a liquid with a layer of grey-white quartz powder settled at the bottom like a thin band of stone.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。体相守剂 T2：赭红比治疗红更暗更偏黄，瓶底灰白石英粉层是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一张白纸长符，斜放，下端一角微微卷起。纸面用细墨线画着拱门形的几何框，框线描着门扉金#f0d890的细光，门框正中盖一枚红色圆印#c03030；符的上端穿一根细红绳。纹样全是抽象几何，不像文字。
subject.en: A long strip of white paper charm lying at a slant, one lower corner slightly curled. Fine ink lines draw an arched, door-shaped geometric frame traced with a thin glint of door gold #f0d890, with a red round seal #c03030 stamped in the middle of the doorway; a thin red cord threads through the top end. All markings are abstract geometry, nothing like writing.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。门扉金只用在拱门形框线上；与寻遗符（螺旋纹加门石碎屑）和封缄符（锁扣纹）区分。

subject.zh: 一个圆形乡村面包，四分之三俯视，摆在一张油纸上。表皮烤成金褐色#b07838，顶上划着十字割口，裂开处露出浅奶色内瓤，表面撒着少许面粉。
subject.en: A round country loaf in three-quarter overhead view, resting on a sheet of oiled paper. The crust is baked golden brown #b07838 and scored with a cross on top that has split open to show pale cream crumb, with a light dusting of flour over the surface.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。口粮面包：十字割口与浅色内瓤是辨识点；只画一个面包和垫纸，不画篮子或刀。

subject.zh: 一只铁箍木酒杯，直立，四分之三视角，杯把朝右。中褐木杯身#8a6040上下两道铁箍#7a7f88，盛满琥珀金的麦酒#c89040，雪白的泡沫高出杯沿，一侧顺着杯壁淌下一道。素朴耐用，没有纹饰。
subject.en: An iron-hooped wooden tankard, upright in three-quarter view with the handle to the right. A mid-brown wooden body #8a6040 with two iron hoops #7a7f88, filled with amber-gold ale #c89040; a snow-white head of foam rises above the rim and one runnel slides down the side. Plain and sturdy, no decoration.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T1 木杯；溢出的白泡沫是辨识点，与北境黑麦酒的近黑酒色和粗陶杯区分。

subject.zh: 一只矮胖的粗陶蜜罐，正面四分之三视角，罐口蒙一块本色布，用细绳扎紧。一道金琥珀色#d89a30的蜂蜜从布边溢出，沿罐身流下一条粗亮的蜜痕。
subject.en: A squat coarse earthenware honey pot in front three-quarter view, its mouth covered with undyed cloth tied down with thin string. A thick glossy run of golden-amber #d89a30 honey has seeped out from under the cloth and trickles down the side of the pot.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。蜂蜜原料：溢出罐边的蜜痕是辨识点；不画蜂巢与蜜蜂，蜜色不要用门扉金。

subject.zh: 三只小圆肚粗玻璃药瓶用麻绳捆成紧凑的一束，直立，各塞软木塞，里面都是治疗红#d04040药液；绳结上挂一块空白小木牌，表示是军需批货。
subject.en: Three small round-bellied coarse glass potion bottles bound upright into one compact bundle with hemp rope, each with a cork stopper and healing-red #d04040 liquid; a small blank wooden tag hangs from the rope knot to mark it as a bulk supply lot.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。城军计量单位：必须是三瓶一捆加空白木牌，与单瓶次级治疗药水区分；木牌上不能有字。

subject.zh: 一只厚壁玻璃罐，直立，四分之三视角。泛浅绿的粗玻璃#a8c0a8里装满褐色肉块与豆子，浸在深褐汤汁里；罐口压着釉陶盖，用两道细铁丝十字扣紧，接缝封一圈暗红蜡#8a3030，蜡上压一枚无字的方形几何印。
subject.en: A thick-walled glass jar, upright in three-quarter view. Coarse glass with a pale green tint #a8c0a8, packed with brown chunks of meat and beans in dark brown gravy; the mouth is capped with a glazed earthenware lid clamped by two thin iron wires crossed over it, and the seam is sealed with dark red wax #8a3030 pressed with a wordless square geometric stamp.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。要像手工封存的玻璃罐，不能画成金属罐头，不要印刷标签或任何商标。

subject.zh: 一只深棕釉陶细颈长瓶，直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上。釉面#5a3a24从肩部流下几道亮釉泪，瓶颈细长，塞着软木塞，外缠一圈细铜丝#c87a48；瓶口沾着一滴清澈如水的酒。
subject.en: A tall slender-necked bottle in dark brown glazed earthenware #5a3a24, upright in three-quarter view with the mouth on top. A few glossy drips of glaze run down from the shoulder; the long thin neck is corked and wound with a ring of fine copper wire #c87a48, and one drop of water-clear spirit clings to the lip.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T2 釉陶；酒液清澈透明不是琥珀色；细长瓶颈是辨识点，与灰烬烈酒的扁肚粗壶区分。

subject.zh: 一张摊开的油纸上并排三只小泡芙，四分之三俯视。泡芙烤得金黄#d8a050，表皮鼓起裂纹，顶上撒一层雪白糖粉，其中一只裂口露出奶黄色的软馅；油纸四角折起，一角系着细麻绳。
subject.en: Three small cream puffs side by side on an opened sheet of oiled paper, slight three-quarter overhead view. The puffs are baked golden #d8a050 with puffed, cracked crusts and a dusting of snow-white powdered sugar; one has split open to show a soft custard-yellow filling. The paper's corners are folded up and one is tied with thin hemp string.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。手工点心配油纸，不要现代纸盒或标签；三只泡芙与布丁、硬糖、月露蜜糕区分。

subject.zh: 一只矮圆的素陶小罐，正面四分之三视角，罐口蒙的油纸掀开一角，露出深绿色#4a6a3a的草药膏，膏面有一道指头抹过的凹痕；罐颈系一道细麻绳。
subject.en: A short round plain earthenware jar in front three-quarter view, the oiled paper over its mouth peeled back at one corner to show dark green #4a6a3a herbal salve with a finger-scooped dent in its surface; a thin hemp string is tied round the neck.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T1 膏药：素陶罐是阶标记，深绿膏与指痕是辨识点；与釉陶罐的澱斑膏区分开。

subject.zh: 一卷粗麻绷带，四分之三俯视，卷得略松，一截布尾垂出。粗麻布米褐色#d8c8a8，织纹粗糙可见，边缘有几根毛头，用一段本色麻绳绕一圈打结。
subject.en: A roll of coarse hemp bandage in three-quarter overhead view, wound a little loosely with a tail of cloth hanging out. The hemp is beige #d8c8a8 with a rough visible weave and a few frayed threads at the edge, tied once round with a length of undyed hemp twine.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。绷带 T1：粗麻质感与毛边是阶标记；四阶绷带同一卷形，只换布料与系法。

subject.zh: 一卷细布绷带，四分之三俯视，卷得紧实整齐，一截布尾平整地垂出。细布近白#ece6d8，织纹细密，边缘锁过边，用一根红褐细线缠两圈系住。
subject.en: A roll of fine-cloth bandage in three-quarter overhead view, wound tight and neat, a flat tail of cloth hanging out. The near-white #ece6d8 cloth has a dense weave and hemmed edges and is bound twice round with a fine red-brown thread.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。绷带 T2：比麻绷带更白更紧，锁边与红褐细线是辨识点；不发光。

subject.zh: 一卷丝绷带，四分之三俯视，卷得紧而薄，布尾轻轻翻卷。浅象牙色丝面#f0e8d8带一道柔亮的高光，卷侧别着一枚小锡夹，夹住布尾。
subject.en: A roll of silk bandage in three-quarter overhead view, wound tight and thin, its tail curling lightly. The pale ivory silk #f0e8d8 shows one soft sheen highlight, and a small tin clip on the side of the roll holds the tail in place.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。绷带 T3：丝面的柔光高光与小锡夹是辨识点；与细布绷带的哑光织纹区分。

subject.zh: 一卷林丝绷带，四分之三俯视，卷得紧薄匀整，布尾翻出一角。林丝绸浅绿银#c8dcc0，表面一道柔光，布尾用一枚叶形小银扣扣住。
subject.en: A roll of forest-silk bandage in three-quarter overhead view, wound thin, tight and even, one corner of the tail turned out. The forest silk is a pale green-silver #c8dcc0 with a soft sheen, its tail fastened with a small leaf-shaped silver clasp.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。绷带 T4：浅绿银林丝与叶形银扣是辨识点；是最精致的一卷，但不发光。

subject.zh: 一只带盖的小釉陶碗，正面四分之三视角，米黄釉面，碗盖斜搭在碗沿露出半碗。碗里是浅红琥珀色的清汤#c8704a，汤面浮着一片银白小叶，冒一缕细热气。
subject.en: A small lidded glazed earthenware bowl in front three-quarter view, cream-yellow glaze, the lid set askew on the rim to show half the bowl. Inside is a clear light red-amber broth #c8704a with one small silvery leaf floating on top and a thin wisp of steam rising.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T2 汤药：米黄釉带盖碗是阶标记，银白小叶与清汤是辨识点；与暗褐釉的淬体汤区分。

subject.zh: 一只多面切割玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，银盖#d0d4dc。棱面上几道折光，里面是治疗红#d04040药液，被切面折成深浅几块红色。
subject.en: A faceted cut-glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, with a silver cap #d0d4dc. A few refracted glints sit on its facets, and the healing-red #d04040 liquid inside is broken by the cuts into patches of lighter and darker red.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T4 治疗药水：规整的多面切割瓶加银盖是阶标记，红色不变；与缠藤的月苔愈露区分。

subject.zh: 一只多面切割的水滴形玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，银盖上缠着一圈细青藤，藤上一片小叶。里面是治疗红#d04040药液，液面浮着一层薄薄的银绿光泽。
subject.en: A faceted teardrop-shaped cut-glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, a fine green vine with one small leaf wound round its silver cap. It holds healing-red #d04040 liquid with a thin silvery-green sheen across the surface.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T4 治疗类：水滴瓶形与银盖上的青藤是辨识点；与规整切割瓶的高级治疗药水区分。

subject.zh: 一只水晶瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，外套一层金丝笼，瓶塞是一顶三尖小金冠。里面的治疗红#d04040药液自身微微发光，把水晶从里面映成暖红。
subject.en: A crystal bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, inside a gold wire cage and stoppered with a tiny three-pointed gold crown. The healing-red #d04040 liquid glows faintly on its own, lighting the crystal from within with a warm red.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T5 治疗药水：金丝笼水晶瓶是阶标记，三尖金冠瓶塞是辨识点；与续肢灵药的白布夹板区分。

subject.zh: 一只水晶瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，外套金丝笼，瓶腰用白麻布条绑着两根小木夹板，像包扎好的断骨。里面是治疗红#d04040药液，自身微微发光。
subject.en: A crystal bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, inside a gold wire cage, with two tiny wooden splints bound round its waist by a white linen strip like a set bone. The healing-red #d04040 liquid inside glows faintly on its own.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T5 伤病药：瓶腰白布条与两根小夹板是辨识点；与同瓶型的王愈液（金冠瓶塞）区分。

subject.zh: 一只透明玻璃平肩瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，软木塞外封红褐色蜡，瓶颈系着一片银白小叶#d0d4dc。里面是灵力蓝#4070e0药液，装到平肩下。
subject.en: A clear flat-shouldered glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its cork sealed with red-brown wax and a small silvery-white leaf #d0d4dc tied at the neck. It holds mana-blue #4070e0 liquid up to just below the shoulders.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T2 灵力药水：平肩瓶红褐蜡封，颈上银白小叶是辨识点；与无饰红液的治疗药水区分。

subject.zh: 一只多面切割玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，银盖#d0d4dc，棱面几道折光。里面是灵力蓝#4070e0药液，液中悬着一缕银绿色的细苔丝，从瓶底飘到中段。
subject.en: A faceted cut-glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, with a silver cap #d0d4dc and a few refracted glints on the facets. It holds mana-blue #4070e0 liquid with a fine strand of silvery-green moss drifting up from the bottom to the middle.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T4 灵力药水：多面瓶银盖，液中银绿苔丝是辨识点；与红液缠藤的月苔愈露区分。

subject.zh: 一只水晶瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，外套一层金丝笼。里面的灵力蓝#4070e0药液自身微微发光，液中散着三四粒单像素的白色亮点，像夜空里的星。
subject.en: A crystal bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, inside a gold wire cage. The mana-blue #4070e0 liquid glows faintly on its own, with three or four single-pixel white points of light scattered through it like stars in a night sky.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T5 灵力药水：金丝笼水晶瓶，液中几粒星点是辨识点；星点要少而清楚，不要满瓶亮斑。

subject.zh: 一只细高玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，锡盖用细铁丝扣扣紧。药液分成上下两层：下半是治疗红#d04040，上半是灵力蓝#4070e0，中间一条清楚的分界线。
subject.en: A tall slender glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its tin cap held by a thin iron wire clasp. The liquid sits in two layers, healing-red #d04040 in the lower half and mana-blue #4070e0 in the upper half, with one crisp dividing line between them.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。双效药：红下蓝上两层分明，分界线要直，不要混成紫色；瓶型与强效治疗药水相同。

subject.zh: 一只透明玻璃平肩瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，软木塞外封红褐色蜡。里面是浓稠的暗血红#7a1a24药液，瓶肩外侧挂着一道干掉的暗红流痕，一直淌到瓶腰。
subject.en: A clear flat-shouldered glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its cork sealed with red-brown wax. It holds thick dark blood-red #7a1a24 liquid, and a dried dark red drip runs down the outside from the shoulder to the waist.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。战意药：暗血红比治疗红深得多，瓶外干流痕是辨识点；不加紫色，不发光。

subject.zh: 一只透明玻璃平肩瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，软木塞外封红褐色蜡。里面是清亮的淡琥珀色#d8a848药液，一串细小气泡从瓶底笔直升到液面。
subject.en: A clear flat-shouldered glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its cork sealed with red-brown wax. It holds clear pale amber #d8a848 liquid, with a single column of tiny bubbles rising straight from the bottom to the surface.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。气息药：淡琥珀药液和一串上升气泡是辨识点；颜色不要偏成门扉金或浓稠的蜂蜜色。

subject.zh: 一枚拇指大的灰晶，斜放在一小片揉皱的油纸上。晶体浑浊灰#8a8a90，内里一缕澱紫#4a3a62的芯，一端崩碎成参差的裂口，像被咬过一口，旁边散着两三粒碎渣。
subject.en: A thumb-sized grey crystal lying at a slant on a small scrap of crumpled oiled paper. The crystal is murky grey #8a8a90 with a wisp of taint-purple #4a3a62 at its core, one end shattered into a jagged break as if bitten, with two or three crumbs scattered beside it.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。未净灰晶消耗品：浑浊灰带澱紫芯，一端咬碎状是辨识点；不要画成透明浅青的净晶。

subject.zh: 一只透明玻璃平肩瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，软木塞外封红褐色蜡。里面是赤褐色#8a4a2a的牛筋剂，瓶颈用皮绳挂着一枚弯弯的小牛角坠。
subject.en: A clear flat-shouldered glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its cork sealed with red-brown wax. It holds red-brown #8a4a2a ox elixir, and a small curved horn charm hangs from a leather cord at the neck.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。力量战剂 T2：赤褐药液与小牛角坠是全族统一标记；本阶靠平肩瓶加红褐蜡封区分。

subject.en: A faceted cut-glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, with a silver cap and a few refracted glints on its facets. It holds leaf-green #5aa040 miasma-ward draught, and a layer of fine white froth floats on the surface.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。生相守剂 T4：叶绿药液与液面白泡沫是全族统一标记；与低阶同色同标记，只换多面切割瓶加银盖。

subject.zh: 一只水晶瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，外套一层金丝笼。里面是生叶绿#5aa040的避瘴剂，自身微微发光，液面浮着一层细密的白泡沫。
subject.en: A crystal bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, enclosed in a gold wire cage, the liquid inside glowing faintly on its own. It holds leaf-green #5aa040 miasma-ward draught, and a layer of fine white froth floats on the surface.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。生相守剂 T5：叶绿药液与液面白泡沫是全族统一标记；与低阶同色同标记，换金丝笼水晶瓶，药液微微发光。

subject.zh: 一只水晶瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，外套金丝笼，笼上横箍着七道细金环。药液是七相守剂的七种颜色叠成的细层，从焰橙一直到体赭红，自身微微发光。
subject.en: A crystal bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, inside a gold wire cage banded with seven thin gold rings. The liquid is stacked in thin layers of the seven ward colours, from flame orange down to body ochre-red, glowing faintly on its own.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。七相合剂：七道金环与七色细层是辨识点；层数比群英剂多，色层要窄而分明。

subject.zh: 一只透明玻璃平肩瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，软木塞外封红褐色蜡。里面是墨黑#1e1c24的药液，正中悬着一粒圆圆的琥珀黄亮点#e0b030，像夜里反光的兽瞳。
subject.en: A clear flat-shouldered glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its cork sealed with red-brown wax. It holds ink-black #1e1c24 liquid with one round amber-yellow point of light #e0b030 hanging at its centre like an animal eye shining in the dark.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。夜视剂：透明瓶里墨黑药液加一粒兽瞳亮点；不能画成暗色瓶身的黄绿毒药。

subject.zh: 一只多面切割玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，银盖，瓶颈系着一枚白色小贝壳。里面是海水般的蓝绿色#3a9a8a药液，瓶底沉着一层白色盐粒。
subject.en: A faceted cut-glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, with a silver cap and a small white seashell tied at the neck. It holds sea-like blue-green #3a9a8a liquid with a layer of white salt grains settled at the bottom.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。水下呼吸剂 T4：颈上白贝壳与瓶底盐粒是辨识点；蓝绿色要比夜枭剂浅亮。

subject.zh: 一只透明玻璃平肩瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，软木塞外封红褐色蜡。里面是薄荷青色#8ae0c0的疾行剂，瓶颈两侧插着一对小白羽，像一双张开的翅膀。
subject.en: A clear flat-shouldered glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its cork sealed with red-brown wax. It holds mint-green #8ae0c0 swiftstep draught, and a pair of small white feathers is tucked at either side of the neck like a pair of open wings.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。疾行剂 T2：薄荷青药液与颈上一对白羽是全族统一标记；本阶靠平肩瓶加红褐蜡封区分。

subject.zh: 一只细高玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，锡盖用细铁丝扣扣紧。里面是薄荷青色#8ae0c0的疾行剂，瓶颈两侧插着一对小白羽，像一双张开的翅膀。
subject.en: A tall slender glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its tin cap held by a thin iron wire clasp. It holds mint-green #8ae0c0 swiftstep draught, and a pair of small white feathers is tucked at either side of the neck like a pair of open wings.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。疾行剂 T3：薄荷青药液与颈上一对白羽是全族统一标记；与 T2 同色同标记，只换细高瓶加锡盖铁丝扣。

subject.zh: 一只多面切割玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，银盖，棱面上几道折光。里面是薄荷青色#8ae0c0的疾行剂，瓶颈两侧插着一对小白羽，像一双张开的翅膀。
subject.en: A faceted cut-glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, with a silver cap and a few refracted glints on its facets. It holds mint-green #8ae0c0 swiftstep draught, and a pair of small white feathers is tucked at either side of the neck like a pair of open wings.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。疾行剂 T4：薄荷青药液与颈上一对白羽是全族统一标记；与低阶同色同标记，只换多面切割瓶加银盖。

subject.zh: 一只细高玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，锡盖用细铁丝扣扣紧。里面是浅天蓝的乳色药液#b0d0e8，正中悬浮着一根完整的白色绒羽，羽梗一线浅灰，像飘在半空。
subject.en: A tall slender glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its tin cap held by a thin iron wire clasp. It holds milky pale sky-blue liquid #b0d0e8 with one whole white down feather, its shaft a thin grey line, floating at the centre as if drifting in mid-air.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。羽落剂 T3：羽毛悬浮在药液中间是辨识点；与疾行剂颈上的一对羽、夜枭剂的横纹羽区分。

subject.zh: 一只透明玻璃平肩瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，软木塞外封红褐色蜡。瓶身套着一层干草编的粗套子，只露出瓶颈和一截土褐色#7a6040的浑浊药液。
subject.en: A clear flat-shouldered glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its cork sealed with red-brown wax. The body is sheathed in a rough woven dry-grass sleeve, leaving only the neck and a band of murky earth-brown #7a6040 liquid visible.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。匿息剂：瓶身干草编套是辨识点，药液土褐浑浊；不要画成灰色，免得像澱病药。

subject.zh: 一只细高玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，锡盖用细铁丝扣扣紧，锡盖顶上嵌着一枚圆形小镜片。里面是清澈近无色的药液，泛着一层淡淡的虹彩。
subject.en: A tall slender glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its tin cap held by a thin iron wire clasp, with a small round lens set into the top of the cap. It holds clear, almost colourless liquid with a faint iridescent sheen.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。破拟剂 T3：盖顶圆镜片与近无色的淡虹彩药液是辨识点；虹彩要淡，不要画成彩色分层。

subject.zh: 一枚蜂蜡色#d8b060的塔形香锥，立在一只小釉陶碟上，四分之三视角。香锥底部裹着一圈白羊毛，尖端点燃，冒出一缕弯弯的细烟。
subject.en: A beeswax-coloured #d8b060 cone of incense standing on a small glazed earthenware dish in three-quarter view. A ring of white wool wraps its base, and the lit tip sends up a thin curling thread of smoke.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。安兽香：塔形香锥加底部白羊毛是辨识点；与定流香的直线香、照执香的盘香区分。

subject.zh: 一只粗陶小杯，四分之三视角，杯口略不圆整。杯里是微浑的灰绿色茶汤#7a8a6a，汤面浮着一片带细绒的灰绿草叶，杯口冒着一缕热气。
subject.en: A small coarse earthenware cup in three-quarter view, its rim slightly uneven. It holds faintly cloudy grey-green tea #7a8a6a with one downy grey-green herb leaf floating on top and a wisp of steam rising from the rim.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。预防茶 T1：粗陶杯与微浑的灰绿茶汤是辨识点；与庭泉茶的木杯清茶区分。

subject.zh: 一块折成方形的本色粗布面巾#d8c8a8，四分之三俯视，两角各缀一根细系带垂下。布面中央晕着一大片浅灰绿的草汁水渍#9aaa88，水渍边缘颜色略深。
subject.en: A square-folded undyed coarse cloth face veil #d8c8a8 in three-quarter overhead view, a thin tie hanging from each of two corners. A large pale grey-green herb-water stain #9aaa88 spreads across the middle, its edge slightly darker.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。预防面巾：折方布加两根系带，中央灰绿水渍是辨识点；不要画成绷带卷。

subject.zh: 一只小小的本色布香囊#d8c8a8，居中，上方一段红绳系环。囊身塞得鼓鼓的，收口处露出几根灰绿干草叶#7a8a6a，布面用红线缝着一朵简单的圆点小花。
subject.en: A small undyed cloth sachet #d8c8a8, centred, with a short loop of red cord above. Its body is stuffed plump, a few dried grey-green herb leaves #7a8a6a poke out of the gathered mouth, and a simple dotted flower is stitched on the cloth in red thread.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。孩童用香囊：小而鼓，口露灰绿干草、红线小花是辨识点；与灰巾的平布区分。

subject.zh: 一只小圆肚素陶瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，软木塞，瓶颈细麻绳上系着一小把灰绿草叶。瓶口沿着瓶肩流下一道灰绿色#7a8a6a的水痕。
subject.en: A small round-bellied plain earthenware bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, with a cork stopper and a little sprig of grey-green herb leaves tied into the hemp string at the neck. A grey-green #7a8a6a water trail runs from the mouth down over the shoulder.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T1 澱病药：用陶瓶不用玻璃，颈上草叶与灰绿水痕是辨识点；与陶罐装的药膏区分。

subject.zh: 一只矮圆的釉陶小罐，正面四分之三视角，米白釉面，罐盖斜靠在罐边。罐里是灰绿色#7a8a6a的药膏，膏面抹得平整光滑，罐颈箍着一道细麻绳。
subject.en: A short round glazed earthenware jar in front three-quarter view, cream-white glaze, its lid leaning against the side. Inside is grey-green #7a8a6a salve smoothed flat and glossy, with a thin hemp string bound round the neck.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T2 膏药：釉陶罐是阶标记，灰绿膏面平整是辨识点；与素陶深绿的草药膏区分。

subject.zh: 一只带盖的小锡碗#a8acb0，正面四分之三视角，碗盖掀开搁在一侧碗沿。碗里是灰绿色#7a8a6a的药汤，汤面浮着一片灰白的百合花瓣，冒一缕细热气。
subject.en: A small lidded tin bowl #a8acb0 in front three-quarter view, the lid lifted and propped on one side of the rim. It holds grey-green #7a8a6a medicinal broth with one grey-white lily petal floating on top and a thin thread of steam.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T3 汤药：锡碗是阶标记，灰白百合瓣是辨识点；与釉陶碗的愈伤汤、淬体汤区分。

subject.zh: 一个半展开的硬革卷包#6a4226，斜放，四分之三俯视，用皮绳系着。卷包插袋里露出一把细长的精钢小刀#a8b0bc，刃口一线高光，旁边插着一小卷白细布绷带。
subject.en: A half-unrolled hardened leather tool roll #6a4226 lying at a slant in three-quarter overhead view, tied with a leather thong. From its pockets show a slender little fine-steel knife #a8b0bc with a single bright line along the edge and, beside it, a small roll of white fine-cloth bandage.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。医用刀包：卷包里的精钢小刀与白绷带是辨识点；刀要细小像医刀，不要画成武器。

subject.zh: 一只多面切割玻璃瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，银盖#d0d4dc。里面是清澈见底的泉水，只带一丝极淡的灰绿#c8d8c8，瓶底卧着一颗圆润的白卵石。
subject.en: A faceted cut-glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, with a silver cap #d0d4dc. It holds spring water clear to the bottom with only the faintest grey-green tint #c8d8c8, and a smooth round white pebble rests on the bottom.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T4 泉水：水近乎透明，瓶底白卵石是辨识点；不发光，与圣水的白缎带金环区分。

subject.zh: 一只带盖的水晶小碗，正面四分之三视角，碗盖斜搭露出半碗。碗里是清透的浅灰绿汤#a8b8a0，汤面浮着一朵小小的白莲花，花心一点淡黄，汤色微微发亮。
subject.en: A small lidded crystal bowl in front three-quarter view, the lid set askew to show half the bowl. It holds clear pale grey-green broth #a8b8a0 with one small white lotus flower floating on top, a touch of pale yellow at its heart, the broth faintly luminous.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T5 汤药：水晶碗是阶标记，汤面一朵白莲是辨识点；与锡碗的退澱热汤区分，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一只银白木#e8e4d8雕成的小盏，四分之三视角，盏沿冒出两三粒细小绿芽。盏底托着一汪清亮的浅青绿露水#b8e0c0，自身发着柔光，整只盏外缘一圈一像素的淡光。
subject.en: A small cup carved from silver-white wood #e8e4d8 in three-quarter view, two or three tiny green buds sprouting from its rim. A small pool of clear pale green dew #b8e0c0 sits in the bottom, glowing softly, with a faint one-pixel glow around the whole cup.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T6 珍品：银白木小盏带绿芽是辨识点；露水只一小汪，外缘一像素淡光，不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 一只透明玻璃平肩瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上，软木塞外封红褐色蜡，瓶颈系一条白缎带，缀一枚小金环。里面是清澈的水，透出一层淡淡的神光白金#fff0c0。
subject.en: A clear flat-shouldered glass bottle standing upright in three-quarter view, mouth up, its cork sealed with red-brown wax, a white satin ribbon with a small gold ring tied at the neck. It holds clear water suffused with a faint holy white-gold #fff0c0.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。教会圣水：白缎带金环与淡白金水色是辨识点；只用白与金，不加紫也不用灰绿。

subject.zh: 一页对折的契纸斜放，展开一角，用黑细绳系着。纸面用晶墨画着一个正在松开的绳结形几何纹，泛着淡青微光#a8e0d8，纸脚并排两枚暗红色的圆形压印。
subject.en: A single folded contract page lying at a slant with one corner opened out, tied with a thin black cord. A geometric figure shaped like a loosening knot is drawn on it in crystal ink with a faint pale-cyan glow #a8e0d8, and two dark red round impressions sit side by side at the foot.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。契约纸 T3：晶墨松结纹与并排两枚暗红压印是辨识点；纹样抽象，不能像字。

subject.zh: 三条窄长的试纸叠成一小沓，斜放，中段用细麻绳扎住。纸条是浅灰绿色#b8c0a8的粗纸，其中一条的下端已经变成暗灰色，像刚浸过什么。
subject.en: Three narrow strips of test paper stacked into a small sheaf lying at a slant, tied round the middle with thin hemp string. The strips are coarse pale grey-green paper #b8c0a8, and the lower end of one strip has turned dark grey as if just dipped in something.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。诊断试纸：三条纸其中一条下端变灰是辨识点；变色只是暗灰，不要带紫。

subject.zh: 一只朴素的小木杯，四分之三视角，浅褐木色#a88060，杯壁有细细的木纹。杯里是清亮的浅灰绿茶汤#a8c0a0，汤面浮着两片嫩绿新芽，冒一缕细热气。
subject.en: A plain little wooden cup in three-quarter view, light brown wood #a88060 with fine grain on its wall. It holds clear pale grey-green tea #a8c0a0 with two fresh green young buds floating on top and a thin wisp of steam.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。庭院茶 T0：木杯与两片嫩芽是辨识点；茶汤比祛灰茶更清亮，不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 一块长方形的普通木牌#8a6040，四分之三视角，顶端钻孔穿一根红绳。牌面烙着一个锤子与麦穗交叉的几何纹章，烙痕焦黑，边角磨得圆润。
subject.en: A rectangular plain wooden token #8a6040 in three-quarter view, a red cord threaded through a hole at the top. A geometric emblem of a hammer crossed with an ear of grain is branded into its face in scorched black, and its corners are worn round.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。出师牌：锤与麦穗交叉的烙纹是辨识点；是木牌不是药，牌上不能有字。

subject.zh: 一根粗线香直立插在一只素陶小香座里，四分之三视角。香身浅褐，夹着几粒琥珀色#c88a30碎屑，顶端点着一粒小红火，冒出一缕笔直不散的细烟。
subject.en: A thick stick of incense standing upright in a small plain earthenware holder, three-quarter view. The stick is light brown flecked with a few amber #c88a30 chips, its tip lit with a tiny red ember that sends up one perfectly straight, unwavering thread of smoke.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。定流香：单根直香插陶座，笔直不散的烟是辨识点；与安兽香的香锥、照执香的盘香区分。

subject.zh: 一只带盖的小釉陶碗，正面四分之三视角，深铁褐釉#5a3a26，碗盖斜搭露出半碗。碗里是浓稠的深褐色胶汤#6a4a30，汤面浮着几片灰绿草叶，冒着热气。
subject.en: A small lidded glazed earthenware bowl in front three-quarter view, dark iron-brown glaze #5a3a26, the lid set askew to show half the bowl. It holds thick dark brown gelatinous broth #6a4a30 with a few grey-green herb leaves floating on top, steaming.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。淬体汤 T2：暗褐釉碗与浓稠胶汤是辨识点；与米黄釉、清汤的愈伤汤区分。

subject.zh: 一个折成方包的油纸小包，四分之三视角，用细绳十字捆住，没有任何封签。纸包一角破开，漏出一小撮浑浊的灰色粉末#8a8a90，粉里夹着几粒澱紫#4a3a62细点。
subject.en: A small square packet of folded oiled paper in three-quarter view, tied crosswise with thin string and bearing no seal or label of any kind. One corner has torn open, spilling a small pinch of murky grey powder #8a8a90 flecked with a few specks of taint-purple #4a3a62.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。黑市散剂：无封签纸包与漏出的灰粉是辨识点；紫只是几粒细点，不要整包发紫。

subject.zh: 一只矮胖的小瓷酒壶，四分之三视角，白瓷上绘着一圈深蓝卷草花纹。壶口塞着裹红布的木塞，壶颈系一根细绳，绳下坠着一颗琥珀珠#c88a30。
subject.en: A squat little porcelain wine flask in three-quarter view, white porcelain painted with a band of deep blue scrolling vine pattern. Its mouth is plugged with a wooden stopper wrapped in red cloth, and a thin cord round the neck carries a dangling amber bead #c88a30.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。临关酒 T3：花纹瓷壶、红布塞与琥珀坠是辨识点；是共饮的酒壶，不要画成药瓶。

subject.zh: 一张白纸卷起一半斜放，展开的部分画着几行起伏的波浪墨线与小圆点，像旋律而不是字。纸角盖着一枚红色圆印，卷口系一根绿色细丝带。
subject.en: A sheet of white paper half rolled up and lying at a slant, the open part drawn with a few rows of rising and falling wavy ink lines and small dots that suggest a melody rather than writing. A red round seal is stamped in one corner and a thin green silk ribbon ties the roll.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。颂歌纸 T2：白纸加红圆印是阶标记，波浪线与圆点不能像文字或真实乐谱。

subject.zh: 一只银边大盘，四分之三俯视，盘上卧着一只烤得焦黄的整禽，腿骨翘起，旁边点缀几颗红果与绿叶。禽背上插着一面小三角旗，旗面是无字的几何纹章。
subject.en: A large silver-rimmed platter in three-quarter overhead view, bearing a whole roast fowl baked golden brown with its drumsticks sticking up, garnished with a few red berries and green leaves. A small pennant stands in the bird, showing a wordless geometric emblem.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。立名宴：银边大盘上的烤整禽加小三角旗是辨识点；只画一盘，不画桌子与宾客。

subject.zh: 一盘螺旋形的银灰绿盘香#a0b8a8，挂在一只小金丝香架上，四分之三视角。香身嵌着几粒单像素的亮屑，外端点燃，冒出一缕绕成小圈的细烟。
subject.en: A spiral coil of silvery grey-green incense #a0b8a8 hung on a small gold wire stand, three-quarter view. A few single-pixel bright flecks are set into the coil, and its outer end is lit, sending up a thin thread of smoke that curls into a small loop.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。照执香 T5：螺旋盘香挂金丝架，亮屑点缀是辨识点；与定流香的直香、安兽香的香锥区分。

subject.zh: 一只小小的月银手铃直立，四分之三视角，铃身冷白带浅蓝#e0e8f0，铃口下露出一颗琥珀色铃舌。铃顶短柄缠着红、蓝、黄三色彩绳，铃身一两点单像素亮光。
subject.en: A small moonsilver hand bell standing upright in three-quarter view, its body cold white with a pale blue tint #e0e8f0 and an amber clapper showing below the mouth. Red, blue and yellow cords are wound round the short handle on top, with one or two single-pixel glints on the bell.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。系魂铃：月银铃身、琥珀铃舌与三色彩绳是辨识点；不用神光白金，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一只尖底的黑琉璃长瓶直立，四分之三视角，瓶塞是一块浑浊灰晶#8a8a90，带一缕澱紫芯。瓶中是浓稠的澱紫#4a3a62药液，暗紫纹路爬过瓶身，瓶口绕着一圈淡淡的暗雾。
subject.en: A tall pointed-bottomed black glass vial standing upright in three-quarter view, stoppered with a lump of murky grey crystal #8a8a90 that has a wisp of taint-purple at its core. It holds thick taint-purple #4a3a62 liquid, dark purple veins creep over the glass, and a faint dark mist curls around the mouth.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T6 浓澱剂：尖底黑瓶与灰晶瓶塞是辨识点；按重档澱画暗紫纹加暗雾，不要亮光。

subject.zh: 两块圆形黑麦硬饼叠放，四分之三俯视，下面垫一张粗油纸。饼面深褐#5a3a24，粗糙干硬，满布整齐的戳孔点阵，边缘掰掉一小块，露出灰褐的紧实内里；用一根麻绳十字捆住。
subject.en: Two round dark rye hard biscuits stacked on a sheet of coarse oiled paper, slight three-quarter overhead view. Deep brown #5a3a24, rough and dry, covered in a neat grid of docking holes, with a small piece broken off the edge showing a dense grey-brown inside; tied crosswise with hemp twine.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。圆形、深褐、戳孔点阵；中间不开孔（那是空心饼），与方形浅黄的军团硬饼区分。

subject.zh: 一只木碗盛着满满的炖肉，四分之三俯视。浓稠的赭褐汤汁#8a4a2a里堆着大块炖肉与橙色胡萝卜，冒一缕热气；碗沿斜插一片月牙形的烤面包片，是最显眼的标志。木碗中褐#8a6040，碗沿有一道补过的旧裂痕。
subject.en: A wooden bowl heaped with stew, slight three-quarter overhead view. Thick ochre-brown gravy #8a4a2a piled with big chunks of braised meat and orange carrot, a wisp of steam rising; a crescent-moon-shaped slice of toasted bread is tucked upright against the rim as its signature feature. Mid-brown wooden bowl #8a6040 with an old mended crack on the rim.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。月牙形面包片必须清楚；T1 木碗，与金湾鱼汤的蓝釉碗、汤面的粗陶碗区分。

subject.zh: 一条腌制熏干的咸鱼，斜放，鱼头在左下、鱼尾在右上翘起。鱼身银灰#a8acb0，背上熏出一层落日般的橙红#d0703a，表面结着细白盐粒；一根麻绳穿过鱼鳃打结，鱼身下垫一角油纸。
subject.en: A salted, smoke-dried herring lying diagonally, head at lower left and tail flicked up at upper right. Silver-grey body #a8acb0 with a sunset orange-red smoke tint #d0703a across the back and a crust of fine white salt grains; a hemp cord threads through the gills and is knotted, with a corner of oiled paper beneath.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。熏出的橙红背色与盐粒是辨识点；是干咸鱼不是鲜鱼，鱼尾翘起。

subject.zh: 一只赭黄釉陶盘里的蜜烤鹿腿，四分之三俯视。鹿腿烤得深褐，刷着一层亮晶晶的琥珀蜂蜜#d89a30，正往盘里滴；腿骨一端露出白骨，缠一圈细绳，旁边点缀两三片灰绿的榆叶#8a9a80。
subject.en: A honey-roasted venison haunch on an ochre-yellow glazed earthenware platter, slight three-quarter overhead view. The haunch is roasted deep brown and brushed with glossy amber honey #d89a30 that drips into the plate; one end shows a bare white bone wrapped with a little string, garnished with two or three grey-green elm leaves #8a9a80.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T2 釉陶盘；蜂蜜釉光与露骨的腿端是辨识点；与月下烤全羊（整只、锡盘）区分。

subject.zh: 一只钟形的甜面包，直立，四分之三视角，放在一张油纸上。面包烤成上窄下宽的钟形，金褐色#c8843a，表面刷蜜发亮；顶端捏出一个小圆钮像钟的提环，底边一圈压出的细褶像钟口，撒几粒白芝麻。
subject.en: A bell-shaped sweet bun standing upright in three-quarter view on a sheet of oiled paper. Baked narrow at the top and flared at the bottom like a bell, golden brown #c8843a and glossy with brushed honey; a small round knob of dough on top forms the bell's hanging loop, a ring of pressed pleats along the base suggests the bell's lip, and a few white sesame seeds are scattered on it.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。钟的外形要一眼看出，但它是面包不是金属铃；与环形的空心饼区分。

subject.zh: 三根深褐肉干并成一束，斜放，用一截旧铁丝缠紧。肉干#5a3020又薄又韧，边缘焦黑卷曲，表面沾着一层灰烬色细粉#9a9690；铁丝两头拧成一个小环，可以挂在腰上。粗陋，没有包装纸。
subject.en: Three strips of dark brown jerky bundled together at a slant, bound tight with a length of old iron wire. The jerky #5a3020 is thin and tough with charred curling edges and a coat of fine ash-grey dust #9a9690; the wire ends are twisted into a small loop for hanging from a belt. Crude, with no wrapping paper.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。灰烬色粉末不加紫；旧铁丝捆扎是辨识点，与风鬃肉条的马鬃辫绳和草叶区分。

subject.zh: 一只环形面包，中间空心，四分之三俯视，平放在一张油纸上。面包金黄#d0a050，表面刷蜜发亮，环身绕着一道浅浅的螺旋压纹，烤出几处深一点的焦色；就是一只寻常的乡间面包圈，没有别的装饰。
subject.en: A ring-shaped loaf with a hollow center, lying flat on a sheet of oiled paper in slight three-quarter overhead view. Golden #d0a050 and glossy with brushed honey, with a shallow spiral pressed around the ring and a few darker toasted spots; it looks like an ordinary country bread ring with no other decoration.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。要像寻常面包圈，不加任何符号或光；中空环形是辨识点，与钟声面包区分。

subject.zh: 一片薄薄的圆形白面圣饼，斜立在一只素白小陶碟上，四分之三视角。饼面米白#f0ead8，压出对称的光环纹：一圈同心圆加放射细线，边缘一圈细齿；饼面透出一丝神光白金#fff0c0的柔亮。
subject.en: A thin round white wafer leaning upright on a small plain white earthenware dish, three-quarter view. The wafer is off-white #f0ead8, pressed with a symmetrical halo pattern of concentric rings and fine radiating lines and a finely toothed edge, with a faint soft sheen of holy white-gold #fff0c0.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。光环纹是对称几何纹，不要十字或文字；饼要很薄，别画成饼干或面包。

subject.zh: 一只椭圆形橄榄油面包，四分之三俯视，放在油纸上。外皮金黄#d0a050，泛着一层油亮的光泽，顶上划着三道斜口；面包上用一根白色细绳系着一小枝橄榄：两片银绿叶和两颗深绿橄榄#4a6a30。
subject.en: An oval olive-oil loaf on oiled paper, slight three-quarter overhead view. Golden crust #d0a050 with an oily sheen and three diagonal slashes across the top; a thin white cord ties a small olive sprig to the loaf, with two silver-green leaves and two dark green olives #4a6a30.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。橄榄枝与油亮外皮是辨识点；白绳不发光，不要加神光色。

subject.zh: 三块方正的淡黄硬饼整齐叠放，四分之三俯视。饼色浅麦黄#d8c090，每块大小完全一样，饼面压着同样的方格纹，一侧边上一排无字的短竖编号刻痕；用一条深红布带#8a2a2a捆紧，打成方结。
subject.en: Three square pale biscuits stacked neatly, slight three-quarter overhead view. Pale wheat-yellow #d8c090, every block exactly the same size and pressed with the same square grid, with a row of wordless short tally notches along one edge; bound tight with a dark red cloth band #8a2a2a tied in a square knot.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。军规方块、样式统一；深红布带与编号刻痕是辨识点，与圆形深褐的黑麦硬饼区分。

subject.zh: 一根烤肉串斜放，签尾在左下、签尖在右上。木签上串着四大块焦红烤肉#9a3a24，边缘烤得发黑，撒满赤红香料粉与粗盐；签尾缠一小条红布，滴下一滴油。分量十足，肉块比签子宽得多。
subject.en: A meat skewer lying diagonally, handle end at lower left and tip at upper right. Four large charred red chunks of roast meat #9a3a24 on a wooden stick, edges blackened and dusted with red spice powder and coarse salt; the handle end is wrapped with a small strip of red cloth and a drop of fat falls from it. Hearty, the chunks much wider than the stick.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。只画一串；大块肉与红香料粉是辨识点，不加竞技场徽记或文字。

subject.zh: 一只鲜蓝釉陶碗盛着奶白鱼汤，四分之三俯视。汤色奶白#e8dcc0，浮着鱼块、绿色香草碎和两只张开的贝壳；碗沿斜搭一块烤面包。碗外壁是鲜亮的蓝釉#2a70b0，口沿一道明黄釉线，热气袅袅。
subject.en: A bright blue glazed earthenware bowl of creamy fish chowder, slight three-quarter overhead view. Milky-white soup #e8dcc0 with chunks of fish, flecks of green herbs and two opened clam shells; a piece of toasted bread leans on the rim. The outside is a vivid blue glaze #2a70b0 with a bright yellow glaze line at the lip, steam curling up.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。两只张开的贝壳是辨识点；T2 蓝釉碗，与醉月炖肉的木碗、雪莲汤的白瓷盅区分。

subject.zh: 一只圆鼓鼓的肉派盛在橙褐釉陶派盘里，四分之三俯视。派皮烤得金黄#d8a050，边缘捏出整齐的花褶，派顶用面皮捏出一束麦穗；切掉一角，露出层层肉馅与琥珀色蜜汁。厚实饱满，派比盘还高。
subject.en: A plump round meat pie in an orange-brown glazed earthenware pie dish, slight three-quarter overhead view. The crust is baked golden #d8a050 with neatly crimped edges and a wheat sheaf shaped from dough on top; one wedge is cut away to show layered meat filling and amber honey juice. Thick and generous, the pie stands taller than its dish.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。面皮麦穗与切开的一角是辨识点；圆润厚实，与夜宴拼盘、炸排区分。

subject.zh: 一块方墩墩的焦黑炉饼放在灰釉陶小盘上，四分之三俯视。饼厚如砖，表皮黑褐#3a2a20，硬得像铁，面上压着几排铆钉般的小凸粒；一角被敲裂，裂缝露出灰褐的粗粮内里。方正厚重，像锻出来的。
subject.en: A squat, square, charred hearth bread on a small grey-glazed earthenware plate, slight three-quarter overhead view. Thick as a brick with a black-brown crust #3a2a20 hard as iron, pressed with rows of rivet-like little studs; one corner has been cracked open, the fissure showing a coarse grey-brown crumb. Square and heavy, as if forged.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。砖形、铆钉凸粒、敲裂的一角是辨识点；不画锤子；与黑麦硬饼、军团硬饼区分。

subject.zh: 一块方形蜜糕盛在白瓷小碟上，碟沿绘一圈浅绿藤叶纹，四分之三俯视。糕身浅银绿#c8dcc0，细腻柔软，顶上淋一层半透明的林蜜#e0b050，正中凝着一颗晶亮的蜜露珠；糕下垫一片新鲜绿叶。
subject.en: A square honey cake on a small white porcelain dish rimmed with a pale green leafy vine pattern, slight three-quarter overhead view. The cake is a soft pale silvery green #c8dcc0, topped with a translucent glaze of forest honey #e0b050 and a single gleaming dewdrop of honey at its center, set on a fresh green leaf.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T3 花纹瓷碟；银绿糕身与正中一颗露珠是辨识点；不加紫，与异界甜点区分。

subject.zh: 一个用宽大落叶包成的方包，四分之三俯视，用一根草茎十字扎紧。外层是褐绿相间的自然落叶#8a8a50，叶脉清楚，边缘略干卷；叶包一角掀开，露出浅黄的谷糕和几颗红色林果#c03838。
subject.en: A square parcel wrapped in broad fallen leaves, slight three-quarter overhead view, tied crosswise with a single grass stem. The outer leaves are a natural mix of brown and green #8a8a50 with clear veins and slightly dried, curled edges; one corner is folded back to show pale yellow grain cake and a few red forest berries #c03838.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。叶色是褐绿的落叶，不是鲜绿嫩叶；掀开一角的红果是辨识点，与月露蜜糕区分。

subject.zh: 一束细长的风干肉条，斜放，中间用编成辫的黑色马鬃绳#2a2420绑住。肉条深红褐#7a3020，又长又直，带一层细盐霜；绳结里插着一小枝灰绿的草原鼠尾草#8a9a78，绳尾垂一颗彩绘小骨珠。
subject.en: A bundle of long thin air-dried meat strips lying at a slant, tied in the middle with a braided black horsehair cord #2a2420. The strips are dark red-brown #7a3020, long and straight with a light frost of salt; a small sprig of grey-green steppe sage #8a9a78 is tucked into the knot, and a little painted bone bead hangs from the cord's tail.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。马鬃辫绳与鼠尾草是辨识点；肉条比拾荒肉干更长更规整，颜色偏红。

subject.zh: 一只烤全羊卧在刻花锡盘上，四分之三俯视。羊身烤得金褐油亮#b8702a，四腿收在身下，皮面焦脆起纹，背上铺几枝灰绿鼠尾草；羊颈系一条红蓝相间的部族彩绳。锡盘#a0a4a8沿口刻一圈卷纹。
subject.en: A whole roast lamb lying on an engraved pewter platter, slight three-quarter overhead view. The body is roasted a glossy golden brown #b8702a with legs folded beneath and crackling-crisp skin, a few sprigs of grey-green sage laid along the back; a red-and-blue tribal cord is tied round its neck. The pewter platter #a0a4a8 has a ring of scrolls engraved around the rim.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。整只羊的卧姿要一眼认出，T3 刻花锡盘；颈上部族彩绳是辨识点，与蜜烤鹿腿区分。

subject.zh: 一只墨绿釉陶小碗里卧着三只泉蛋，四分之三俯视。蛋壳米白，带淡淡的青褐泽斑#a09a70，其中一只剥开一半，露出嫩白蛋清和半凝的橙黄蛋黄#e09a30；碗底浅浅一汪温水，冒着一缕热气。
subject.en: Three hot-spring eggs nestled in a small dark green glazed earthenware bowl, slight three-quarter overhead view. Cream shells with a faint grey-brown marsh mottling #a09a70; one is half peeled to show tender white and a soft, half-set orange-yellow yolk #e09a30. A shallow pool of warm water in the bowl gives off a wisp of steam.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。半凝的蛋黄与热气是辨识点；T2 墨绿釉陶碗，不画蛇或沼泽背景。

subject.zh: 一扇肋排盛在黑釉瓷盘里，盘沿一圈暗红折角纹，四分之三俯视。三根弯骨向上翘出，骨端露白；肉烤得焦红发黑#6a2418，撒着点点硫黄色粉粒#d8c040，冒出几缕淡黄的烟。
subject.en: A rack of ribs on a black-glazed porcelain plate rimmed with a dark red angular zigzag pattern, slight three-quarter overhead view. Three curved bones jut upward with white ends showing; the meat is charred to a red-black #6a2418, flecked with sulphur-yellow powder #d8c040, and a few wisps of pale yellow smoke rise from it.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。黄色硫粉与淡黄烟是辨识点；T3 花纹黑瓷盘，黑红配色，与斗场烤串区分。

subject.zh: 一只黑漆大圆盘，盘沿一圈亮银边#d0d4dc，四分之三俯视，盘面描着暗红的多角纹。盘上堆着两扇撒硫粉的焦红肋排和一圈剥壳泉蛋，正中立着一只盛琥珀烈酒的小银杯。丰盛的宴席拼盘。
subject.en: A large round black-lacquered platter with a bright silver rim #d0d4dc, slight three-quarter overhead view, its face painted with dark red angular patterns. It is piled with two charred red racks of sulphur-dusted ribs and a ring of peeled hot-spring eggs, with a small silver cup of amber spirits standing at the center. A lavish feast spread.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T4 银边器皿；肋排、泉蛋、小银杯三样要可辨，与单份硫烟肋排区分。

subject.zh: 一只白瓷汤盅，盅沿一圈银边#d0d4dc，四分之三俯视，盖子斜靠在盅边。清亮的浅金汤面上浮着一朵完整的白雪莲，花瓣尖带冰蓝#a0d0f0，下面露出几片薄肉；盅身绘淡蓝雪峰纹，冒着细细的热气。
subject.en: A white porcelain soup tureen with a silver rim #d0d4dc, slight three-quarter overhead view, its lid propped against the side. A whole white snow lotus floats on clear pale golden broth, petal tips tinged ice blue #a0d0f0, with a few thin slices of meat beneath; the tureen is painted with pale blue mountain-peak motifs and gives off a fine steam.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。整朵白雪莲浮在汤面是辨识点；T4 银边白瓷盅，与金湾鱼汤的蓝釉碗区分。

subject.zh: 一只粗陶浅盘里堆着几只饺子，四分之三俯视。饺子是半月形，面皮米白#ece6d8，背上一排手捏的细褶，大小略不一样，像灶房里手包的；其中一只破了个小口，透出肉与青菜的馅；冒着一缕热气。
subject.en: A shallow rough earthenware plate piled with a few dumplings, slight three-quarter overhead view. Half-moon dumplings with off-white wrappers #ece6d8 and a row of hand-pinched pleats along each back, slightly uneven in size as if folded by hand in a farmhouse kitchen; one has a small tear showing a filling of meat and green vegetables. A wisp of steam rises.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。半月形与背上细褶是辨识点；手工粗陶盘，不要现代餐具；与汤面、便当区分。

subject.zh: 一只赭红釉陶盘里盛着一大块炸肉排，四分之三俯视。肉排裹着金黄酥脆的面包屑外衣#d8a040，切成几条厚片，断面露出白里透粉的厚肉；旁边堆一撮切得细细的绿叶菜丝。肉排几乎占满盘子。
subject.en: A big fried cutlet on an ochre-red glazed earthenware plate, slight three-quarter overhead view. Coated in a crisp golden breadcrumb crust #d8a040 and cut into thick strips, the cut faces showing thick pale pink meat; a little heap of finely shredded green leaves sits beside it. The cutlet nearly fills the plate.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。金黄面包屑外衣与切开的厚片是辨识点；肉要大块；与斗场烤串区分。

subject.zh: 一只倒扣成形的蛋奶布丁立在米白釉陶小碟上，四分之三视角。布丁是平顶圆台形，淡奶黄#f2e4b4，表面光滑，微微颤动；顶上一层深琥珀色焦糖#8a4a18，顺着侧面流下几道，在碟里积成一小汪。
subject.en: A turned-out custard pudding standing on a small off-white glazed earthenware dish, three-quarter view. A flat-topped truncated cone of pale custard yellow #f2e4b4, smooth and faintly wobbling; a layer of deep amber caramel #8a4a18 on top runs down the sides in a few streaks and pools in the dish.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。平顶圆台加顶上焦糖是辨识点；不要画成塑料杯装；奶黄要避开门扉金色。

subject.zh: 一只粗陶大碗盛着热汤面，四分之三俯视。清亮的骨汤#d8b880里盘着淡黄面条，上面盖一片肉和几点葱绿，冒着一大团热气；碗上横搭一双木筷，筷头挑起一缕面。粗陶碗沿有一处小缺口。
subject.en: A big rough earthenware bowl of hot noodle soup, slight three-quarter overhead view. Clear bone broth #d8b880 with coils of pale yellow noodles, topped with a slice of meat and a few flecks of green scallion, a big puff of steam rising; a pair of wooden chopsticks rests across the bowl, lifting a strand of noodles. A small chip in the earthenware rim.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。木筷挑起的面条是辨识点；T1 粗陶碗；与醉月炖肉的木碗和月牙面包区分。

subject.zh: 一只小粗陶罐，直立，四分之三视角，罐口蒙的油纸用细麻绳绑着，掀开一半。罐里是奶白色的浓稠酱#f4ecd8，顶上挑出一个弯弯的尖儿，插着一把小木勺；罐身是素面陶#b89878，没有任何标签。
subject.en: A small rough earthenware crock, upright in three-quarter view, its oiled-paper cover tied with thin hemp string and pulled half open. Inside is a thick creamy white sauce #f4ecd8 swirled up into a curling peak, with a little wooden spoon stuck in it; the crock is plain unglazed clay #b89878 with no label at all.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。奶白酱的旋尖与木勺是辨识点；不能画成玻璃瓶或带标签的现代包装。

subject.zh: 一只绘着蓝色卷草纹的白瓷盘，四分之三俯视。盘里一半是白米饭，一半浇满浓稠的橙黄香料烩#d89030，里面有肉块与胡萝卜块，汁面浮着几点红色辣油，冒着热气。
subject.en: A white porcelain plate painted with blue scrolling vines, slight three-quarter overhead view. Half of it holds white rice, the other half is smothered in thick orange-yellow spice stew #d89030 with chunks of meat and carrot, a few red dots of chili oil on its surface, and steam rising.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。一半白饭一半橙黄浓汁是辨识点；T3 花纹瓷盘，与火锅、醉月炖肉区分。

subject.zh: 一口双耳圆锡锅，四分之三俯视，锅心一道弯弯的隔板把汤分成两半：一半是翻滚的红油汤#c03020，一半是乳白清汤。汤里浮着肉片、绿叶菜和几粒花椒，冒着热气。锡锅#a0a4a8外壁刻一圈简单卷纹。
subject.en: A round two-handled pewter pot, slight three-quarter overhead view, with a curved divider in the middle splitting the broth in two: one half bubbling red chili-oil soup #c03020, the other a milky white broth. Slices of meat, green leaves and a few peppercorns float in it, steam rising. The pewter pot #a0a4a8 has a simple ring of scrolls engraved on the outside.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。红白两半的隔板汤是辨识点；T3 锡锅，不画炉子与碗筷，与香料烩区分。

subject.zh: 一只打开的长方素木盒，四分之三俯视，盒盖斜靠在后面，盒下垫一块打结的蓝布#3a5a8a。盒里一道木隔板分成两格：一格是白饭团，一格是金黄的煎蛋卷和绿叶菜。木纹本色#c8a070，榫角是手工做的。
subject.en: An open rectangular plain wooden box, slight three-quarter overhead view, its lid leaning behind it and a knotted blue cloth #3a5a8a beneath it. A wooden divider splits it into two compartments: white rice balls in one, golden rolled omelette and green leaves in the other. Natural wood grain #c8a070 with hand-cut joined corners.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。两格木盒加蓝布是辨识点；必须是木盒，不要塑料饭盒；与饺子、汤面区分。

subject.zh: 一张摊开的小油纸上放着三颗圆硬糖，四分之三俯视。糖是透明的琥珀色、樱红色、薄荷绿各一颗，每颗都有一个亮亮的高光点；其中一颗还裹着两头拧起的油纸。糖小而圆，像三粒宝石。
subject.en: Three round hard candies on a small opened square of oiled paper, slight three-quarter overhead view. One translucent amber, one cherry red, one mint green, each with a bright highlight; one of them is still wrapped in oiled paper twisted at both ends. Small, round and jewel-like.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。三色透明圆糖加两头拧的油纸是辨识点；不要现代糖纸花纹或文字。

subject.zh: 一只素面粗陶圆肚水壶，直立，四分之三视角，壶口在上。没上釉的土褐陶#a08060，侧边一个小耳系着麻绳背带，壶口塞木塞；壶口边挂着一滴清水#a8d0e0。粗朴，壶身留着手捏的指痕。
subject.en: A plain round-bellied rough clay water flask, upright in three-quarter view with the mouth on top. Unglazed earth-brown clay #a08060 with a small side lug holding a hemp carrying cord and a wooden stopper in the mouth; a drop of clear water #a8d0e0 hangs at the lip. Rustic, with finger marks pressed into the body.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。净水四阶同一圆肚壶形，只按阶换材质；T1 粗陶加麻绳，水滴清透无光。

subject.zh: 一只青白釉陶圆肚水壶，直立，四分之三视角，壶口在上。釉色清淡#c8dcd8，侧边小耳系一根编绳，壶口塞软木塞；壶肩贴着一片青绿蕨叶，壶口挂着一滴清亮的山泉水#a8d0e0。
subject.en: A pale celadon-glazed round-bellied water flask, upright in three-quarter view with the mouth on top. Soft clear glaze #c8dcd8, a braided cord through the small side lug and a cork in the mouth; a green fern frond is pressed against the shoulder, and a drop of clear spring water #a8d0e0 hangs at the lip.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与 T1 同壶形；青白釉加蕨叶是辨识点，与 T1 粗陶、T3 花纹白瓷区分。

subject.zh: 一只白瓷圆肚水壶，直立，四分之三视角，壶口在上。壶身绘一圈浅蓝水波纹，壶口扣着锡盖#a0a4a8，侧边小耳挂一条细锡链；壶口挂着的一滴水泛着极淡的浅青微光#a8e8e8，水滴里一粒细小亮点。
subject.en: A white porcelain round-bellied water flask, upright in three-quarter view with the mouth on top. A ring of pale blue wave pattern circles the body, a pewter cap #a0a4a8 closes the mouth and a fine pewter chain hangs from the side lug; the drop of water at the lip has a very faint pale cyan glow #a8e8e8 with one tiny bright point inside.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。同壶形；T3 水波纹白瓷加锡盖，只有水滴带一点淡青微光，壶身不发光。

subject.zh: 一只银边水晶圆肚水壶，直立，四分之三视角，壶口在上。透明的水晶壶身里装着清水，水自身泛着淡淡的浅青微光#a8e8e8，中心一点亮心；壶口与壶底各一圈银边#d0d4dc，银盖上嵌一粒小水晶。
subject.en: A silver-rimmed crystal round-bellied water flask, upright in three-quarter view with the mouth on top. Through the clear crystal body the water itself glows a soft pale cyan #a8e8e8 with a bright point at its heart; silver bands #d0d4dc ring the mouth and base, and the silver cap is set with a small crystal bead.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。同壶形；T4 透明水晶加银边，水自身微光；不用门扉金或神光白金。

subject.zh: 一只深灰褐粗陶酒杯，直立，四分之三视角，杯把缠一圈灰白毛皮#c8c0b0。杯里是近乎黑色的黑麦酒#3a2418，顶一层薄薄的棕褐泡沫；杯沿斜搭一根黑麦穗。杯壁厚重，有一道没打磨的修补痕。
subject.en: A dark grey-brown rough earthenware mug, upright in three-quarter view, its handle wrapped with a band of grey-white fur #c8c0b0. It holds near-black rye ale #3a2418 under a thin tan-brown head; a single ear of rye leans across the rim. Thick heavy walls with one unpolished mended seam.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。近黑酒色、毛皮杯把、黑麦穗是辨识点；与麦酒的铁箍木杯和白泡沫区分。

subject.zh: 一只细颈白瓷酒瓶，直立，四分之三视角，瓶口在上。瓶身绘一圈浅绿藤叶纹，塞子是刻着年轮纹的素木塞，瓶颈系一片新鲜绿叶；瓶口挂一滴蜂蜜金色的林蜜酒#e0b050。素雅清淡，木与瓷都不上漆。
subject.en: A slender-necked white porcelain wine bottle, upright in three-quarter view with the mouth on top. A ring of pale green leafy vines is painted round the body, the stopper is unvarnished wood carved with growth-ring lines, and a fresh green leaf is tied at the neck; a drop of honey-gold forest mead #e0b050 hangs at the lip. Quiet and elegant, bare wood with porcelain.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T3 花纹瓷；年轮纹木塞与系颈绿叶是辨识点，与朝圣葡萄酒的白釉高脚杯区分。

subject.zh: 一只白釉陶高脚酒杯，直立，四分之三视角。杯里盛着清透的浅禾黄白葡萄酒#e0d070，杯身绕一圈浅蓝细环纹，杯脚系着一截打结的白色细绳。造型素净端正，左右对称，没有别的装饰。
subject.en: A white-glazed earthenware stemmed wine cup, upright in three-quarter view. It holds clear pale straw-yellow white wine #e0d070; a fine pale blue ring band circles the bowl and a knotted thin white cord is tied round the stem. Plain, upright and symmetrical, with no other decoration.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T2 白釉高脚杯；白葡萄酒偏禾黄，不用神光白金或门扉金；与南坡红酒的酒壶区分。

subject.zh: 一只圆肚带把的赭红釉陶酒壶，直立，四分之三视角，壶嘴朝右。壶嘴淌出一滴深宝石红的葡萄酒#7a1a2a，壶颈系着一片绿色葡萄叶和一小段卷曲的藤须；釉面温润，壶肩一道深色釉线。
subject.en: A round-bellied, handled terracotta-red glazed earthenware wine jug, upright in three-quarter view with the spout to the right. A drop of deep ruby red wine #7a1a2a runs from the spout; a green vine leaf with a little curling tendril is tied at the neck, the glaze is smooth and warm, and a dark glaze line rings the shoulder.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。深宝石红酒加葡萄叶是辨识点；酒色偏红不偏紫，与朝圣白葡萄酒的高脚杯区分。

subject.zh: 一只宽口浅釉陶碗盛着热奶茶，四分之三俯视。茶色是温润的奶褐#d8c0a0，表面浮着一层奶皮和一片灰绿的鼠尾草叶，冒着热气；碗外壁是赭黄釉#c8a050，碗沿系一圈红蓝相间的彩编绳。
subject.en: A wide, shallow glazed earthenware bowl of hot milk tea, slight three-quarter overhead view. Warm milky tan tea #d8c0a0 with a skin of cream and a single grey-green sage leaf floating on top, steam rising; the outside is ochre-yellow glaze #c8a050 and a red-and-blue braided cord is tied round the rim.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。宽口碗加彩编绳是辨识点，草原待客的样子；与学城浓茶的带盖瓷杯区分。

subject.zh: 一只带盖的白瓷茶杯，直立，四分之三视角，杯盖斜搭在杯沿。杯里是深褐近黑的浓茶#3a2010，浓得不透光；杯身绕一道深蓝色带#2a3a70，带上织满极小的点线纹，像学派色带。杯下托一只锡碟。
subject.en: A lidded white porcelain teacup, upright in three-quarter view, the lid tilted on the rim. It holds a dark brown, near-black strong tea #3a2010, too strong to see through; a deep blue band #2a3a70 circles the cup, filled with tiny dot-and-line patterns like a school's colours, and it sits on a pewter saucer.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。近黑浓茶与点线纹深蓝色带是辨识点；点线纹不能像字；与鬃奶茶的宽口碗区分。

subject.zh: 一只扁圆的铁灰釉陶随身酒壶，直立，四分之三视角，壶口在上。釉色铁灰#5a5e66，壶颈系一根深红绳#8a2a2a，壶肩刻一排无字的短竖编号痕；软木塞上卡着一小截灰绿草叶。样式统一，像军中配发的。
subject.en: A flat round iron-grey glazed earthenware field flask, upright in three-quarter view with the mouth on top. Iron-grey glaze #5a5e66, a dark red cord #8a2a2a tied round the neck and a row of wordless short tally notches cut into the shoulder; a short blade of grey-green herb is wedged into the cork. Uniform and standard-issue in look.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。铁灰加深红、无字编号痕是军中配发的辨识点；与灰烬烈酒、蒸馏烈酒区分。

subject.zh: 一只方口厚底的黑石酒杯，直立，四分之三视角，杯口包一圈银边#d0d4dc。杯壁刻着铆钉般排成矿脉的小点，正面镶一粒橙红火玉#e05030；杯里的火酒是深橙琥珀色，透出余火般的暖光#f0a040。
subject.en: A square-mouthed, thick-bottomed black stone cup, upright in three-quarter view, its lip bound with a silver rim #d0d4dc. The walls are carved with rivet-like dots running in ore-vein lines, an orange-red fire jade #e05030 is set in the front, and the brandy inside is deep orange amber with a warm ember glow #f0a040.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。T4 银边；方正厚重的矮人样式，酒有余火般橙光；与定胆酒、蒸馏烈酒区分。

subject.zh: 一张摊开的粗黄纸包，四分之三俯视，纸角折起，用细绳松松系着。纸上滚着三粒圆滚滚的墨绿药丸#3a5a30，表面沾着细白粉，旁边搭一片嫩绿的薄荷叶。小而朴素，像药铺随手包的。
subject.en: An opened packet of coarse yellow paper, slight three-quarter overhead view, corners folded up and loosely tied with thin string. Three plump dark green pills #3a5a30 dusted with fine white powder sit on the paper, with a tender green mint leaf beside them. Small and plain, like something an apothecary wrapped in passing.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。三粒墨绿药丸是辨识点；不是瓶装饮品，不画杯；绿色要墨绿，不要澱病药的灰绿。

subject.zh: 一只白纸折成的纸鸟，展翅斜飞，四分之三视角，鸟头朝右上。纸面画着细墨几何符纹，一侧翅上盖一枚红色圆印#c03030；尾部夹着一根灰褐小羽毛#8a7a68，折痕清楚利落。
subject.en: A bird folded from white paper, wings spread in a slanting glide, three-quarter view with the head toward upper right. Fine ink geometric charm lines cover the paper and a red round seal #c03030 is stamped on one wing; a small grey-brown feather #8a7a68 is tucked into the tail, the folds crisp and clean.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。必须是纸鸟形状；红色圆印表示 T2，尾部羽毛是辨识点，与平放的符纸区分。

subject.zh: 一张粗黄纸长符，斜放，下端一角微微卷起。纸色粗黄#d0b070，纤维粗糙，纸面用墨线画着一个盾形的几何框，框里三道横线与一个圆点；上端穿一根麻绳。纹样是抽象几何，不像文字。
subject.en: A long strip of coarse yellow paper charm lying at a slant, one lower corner slightly curled. Rough-fibered yellow paper #d0b070 with an ink-drawn shield-shaped geometric frame holding three horizontal lines and a dot; a hemp cord threads through the top end. The markings are abstract geometry, nothing like writing.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。护身符纸三阶同一盾形符纹，只按阶换纸与墨；T1 粗黄纸墨线，无印无光。

subject.zh: 一张白纸长符，斜放，下端一角微微卷起。纸面洁白细密#f0ece0，墨线画着同样的盾形几何框，框里三道横线与一个圆点，盾形下方盖一枚红色圆印#c03030；上端穿一根红绳。纹样不像文字。
subject.en: A long strip of white paper charm lying at a slant, one lower corner slightly curled. Fine clean white paper #f0ece0 with the same ink shield-shaped geometric frame of three horizontal lines and a dot, and a red round seal #c03030 stamped beneath the shield; a red cord threads through the top end. The markings look nothing like writing.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与 T1 同一盾形符纹；白纸加红圆印加红绳是 T2 的差别，不发光。

subject.zh: 一张白纸长符，斜放，下端一角微微卷起。盾形几何框、三道横线与圆点都用晶墨画成，纹线泛着淡青光#a8e8e8，盾形下方盖红色圆印；纸边压一道细银线，上端穿一根青色丝绳。纹样不像文字。
subject.en: A long strip of white paper charm lying at a slant, one lower corner slightly curled. The shield-shaped geometric frame, three lines and dot are drawn in crystal ink whose lines glow a faint pale cyan #a8e8e8, with a red round seal beneath the shield; a fine silver line edges the paper and a cyan silk cord threads through the top. The markings look nothing like writing.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与 T1、T2 同一盾形符纹；T3 晶墨淡青光加银线是差别，光不要太亮。

subject.zh: 一张粗黄纸方符，斜放，一角折起。纸色粗黄#d0b070，四边略起毛；墨线画着一个圆和向外放射的八道短线，圆心抹了一点晶粉，闪着几粒浅青的细小亮点#a8e8e8。纹样抽象，不像文字。
subject.en: A square charm of coarse yellow paper lying at a slant with one corner folded over. Coarse yellow #d0b070 with slightly fuzzy edges; ink lines draw a circle with eight short rays radiating outward, and a smear of crystal powder at the center glints with a few tiny pale cyan sparkles #a8e8e8. The pattern is abstract, nothing like writing.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。方形纸加放射纹是辨识点；亮点是晶粉的浅青，不用神光白金或门扉金。

subject.zh: 一条细长的白纸封条，斜放，两端微微卷起。纸面墨线画着一串连环交叉的锁扣纹，正中盖一枚红色圆印#c03030，圆印两侧各一滴暗红封蜡#8a3030；一端拴着一小段打死结的麻线。纹样不像文字。
subject.en: A long narrow white paper seal strip lying at a slant, both ends slightly curled. Ink lines draw a chain of interlocking crossed clasp patterns along it, a red round seal #c03030 is stamped at the center with a drop of dark red wax #8a3030 on each side, and a short piece of hemp thread tied in a hard knot hangs from one end. The markings look nothing like writing.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。细长封条加两滴封蜡是辨识点；比护身符纸更窄更长，不发光。

subject.zh: 一张白纸长符，斜放，下端一角卷起。墨线画着由外向内收拢的螺旋纹，螺旋中心伸出一道细针般的直线，指向符的一角；纸面撒着一层细细的门石碎屑，零星闪着门扉金#f0d890的细光；右下角盖一枚红色圆印。
subject.en: A long strip of white paper charm at a slant, one lower corner curled. Ink lines draw a spiral winding inward, from whose center a fine needle-like straight line points toward one corner; the paper is sprinkled with fine door-stone grit that glints here and there with door gold #f0d890, and a red round seal is stamped in the lower right corner.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。螺旋加指针线是辨识点；门扉金只是零星碎屑的闪光，与回门符的拱门金框区分。

subject.zh: 一只粗麻小布袋，四分之三俯视，袋口敞开，抽绳松垂。袋里堆着灰白细粉#d8d4c8，混着几粒闪亮的石英屑；一小撮粉洒出袋口，在袋前画出一段弯弯的弧线。粗麻本色#c8b890，袋角补着一块旧布。
subject.en: A small coarse hemp pouch, slight three-quarter overhead view, its mouth open and drawstring hanging loose. It holds a heap of grey-white fine powder #d8d4c8 flecked with a few glinting quartz grains; a pinch has spilled from the mouth and traces a curved arc in front of the pouch. Undyed hemp #c8b890 with an old cloth patch on one corner.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。结界粉三阶都有洒出的弧线粉；T1 粗麻袋，粉灰白不发光，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一只敞口的灰青釉陶小罐，四分之三俯视，罐盖斜靠在一旁。罐里满着灰白细粉#d8d4c8，混着闪亮的石英屑；一小撮粉洒在罐前，画出一段弯弧；罐肩一圈墨色的圆环几何纹，釉面光滑#8a9a9a。
subject.en: An open small grey-blue glazed earthenware jar, slight three-quarter overhead view, its lid propped beside it. Full of grey-white fine powder #d8d4c8 flecked with glinting quartz; a spilled pinch traces a curved arc in front, and a ring of dark ink-colored circle motifs runs round the shoulder. Smooth glaze #8a9a9a.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与 T1 同样的灰白粉与弧线；T2 换成釉陶罐加圆环纹，粉仍不发光。

subject.zh: 一只敞口的小锡罐，四分之三俯视，锡盖用细链挂在罐边。罐里的灰白细粉#d8d4c8掺着晶屑，泛着极淡的浅青微光#a8e8e8；洒出的一小撮在罐前画成一段弯弧，弧线也亮着淡光。锡罐#a0a4a8刻一圈环纹。
subject.en: An open small pewter tin, slight three-quarter overhead view, its pewter lid hanging from the rim by a fine chain. The grey-white powder #d8d4c8 inside is mixed with crystal grit and gives off a very faint pale cyan glow #a8e8e8; a spilled pinch traces a curved arc in front that also glows faintly. The pewter tin #a0a4a8 is engraved with a ring pattern.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与 T1、T2 同样的弧线粉；T3 锡罐加淡青微光，光要克制，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一卷粗黄纸契约，斜放，半展开，一端还卷着，用麻绳松松系住。纸面是几道抽象墨线和两个不同的几何画押，下方并排按着三枚小小的墨色指印。没有印章，没有封蜡，素朴的凡人契纸。
subject.en: A scroll of coarse yellow paper contract lying at a slant, half unrolled with one end still rolled and loosely tied with hemp string. The paper carries a few abstract ink lines and two different geometric signature marks, with three small inky fingerprints pressed in a row below. No seal and no wax, a plain mortal contract.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。三枚墨色指印与两个几何画押是辨识点；不能有红印、封蜡与神光；纸上不写字。

subject.zh: 一封折成长方的白纸帖，斜放，四分之三视角。封口压着一团深红封蜡#8a2a2a，蜡上是两道交叉的斜线纹，像交叉的两柄剑；帖面一角盖红色圆印#c03030，另一角系一截红绳。纸张挺括，边角锋利。
subject.en: A white paper writ folded into a rectangle, lying at a slant in three-quarter view. Its flap is pressed shut with a blob of dark red wax #8a2a2a bearing two crossed diagonal lines like two crossed swords; a red round seal #c03030 is stamped in one corner and a short red cord is tied to another. Crisp paper with sharp edges.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。折叠帖加交叉剑纹封蜡是辨识点；不写字，与长条符纸、契约卷区分。

subject.zh: 一张粗黄纸长符，斜放，下端一角卷起。墨线画着一个闭合的圆和下方三道依次变短的横线，纸面抹着一道灰白的骨灰#c8c4b8；上端用细绳系着一小枝灰绿的草#8a9a80。素净肃穆，纹样不像文字。
subject.en: A long strip of coarse yellow paper charm at a slant, one lower corner curled. Ink lines draw a closed circle above three horizontal lines that grow shorter downward, a grey-white smear of bone ash #c8c4b8 crosses the paper, and a small sprig of grey-green herb #8a9a80 is tied to the top end with thin string. Plain and solemn, the markings nothing like writing.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。骨灰抹痕与系着的灰绿草枝是辨识点；不加紫，不用神光白金，与护身符纸区分。

subject.zh: 三支箭并拢斜放，箭镞在右上、箭羽在左下。浅褐铁杉箭杆#a07850，铁镞#7a7f88是简单的柳叶形，略粗糙无光；箭羽是参差的灰色鹅羽#9a9a98，用麻线缠在杆尾。朴素的普通箭。
subject.en: Three arrows lying together at a slant, heads at upper right and fletching at lower left. Light brown hemlock shafts #a07850 with simple leaf-shaped iron heads #7a7f88, slightly rough and dull; the fletching is ragged grey goose feathers #9a9a98 bound to the shaft ends with hemp thread. Plain common arrows.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。箭五阶同一柳叶镞与三支并拢构图，只按阶换镞色与箭羽；T1 铁镞灰羽。

subject.zh: 三支箭并拢斜放，箭镞在右上、箭羽在左下。浅褐铁杉箭杆#a07850，柳叶形精钢镞#a8b0bc，刃口一线亮高光；箭羽是修剪整齐的白灰羽，羽根缠一圈细黑线。做工比铁箭更利落。
subject.en: Three arrows lying together at a slant, heads at upper right and fletching at lower left. Light brown hemlock shafts #a07850 with leaf-shaped bright steel heads #a8b0bc, a single bright highlight along each edge; the fletching is neatly trimmed white-grey feathers with a fine black thread wrap at the base. Cleaner work than the iron arrows.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与 T1 同形；精钢亮灰镞与整齐白灰羽是差别；与银镞箭的宽三角冷白镞区分。

subject.zh: 三支箭并拢斜放，箭镞在右上、箭羽在左下。浅褐铁杉箭杆，柳叶形澱钢镞是蓝灰色#5a6a80，表面一层极淡的青色光泽#8fd0d8；箭羽是剪成盾形的石板蓝灰羽，带一道深色细纹，羽根缠细银线。
subject.en: Three arrows lying together at a slant, heads at upper right and fletching at lower left. Light brown hemlock shafts with leaf-shaped blue-grey steel heads #5a6a80 carrying a very faint cyan sheen #8fd0d8; the fletching is slate blue-grey feathers cut in a shield shape with one fine dark stripe, bound at the base with fine silver thread.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与前两阶同形；澱钢镞的光泽是青色不是紫色，箭羽修成盾形。

subject.zh: 三支箭并拢斜放，箭镞在右上、箭羽在左下。浅褐铁杉箭杆，柳叶形夜铁镞黑而不反光#26232a，镞脊透出暗红光泽#8a3030，刃根多出两个尖角；箭羽是乌黑长羽，羽缘一线暗红，羽根缠黑线。
subject.en: Three arrows lying together at a slant, heads at upper right and fletching at lower left. Light brown hemlock shafts with leaf-shaped night-iron heads, matte black #26232a with a dark red sheen #8a3030 along the spine and two extra angled spurs at the base of the blade; the fletching is long jet-black feathers edged with a thin dark red line, bound with black thread.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与前几阶同形；夜铁镞不反光，黑红配色，刃根两个尖角是辨识点。

subject.zh: 三支箭并拢斜放，箭镞在右上、箭羽在左下。浅褐铁杉箭杆，柳叶形穹铁镞灰白#c8ccd8，镞面散着几粒星点般的亮斑；箭羽是修长的银白羽，羽根缠细银线，杆尾包一小截穹铁箍，带一两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: Three arrows lying together at a slant, heads at upper right and fletching at lower left. Light brown hemlock shafts with leaf-shaped sky-iron heads in grey-white #c8ccd8 scattered with a few starlike bright flecks; the fletching is long silver-white feathers bound with fine silver thread, each nock capped with a short sky-iron collar, with one or two single-pixel sparkles.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与前几阶同形；穹铁星点亮斑与杆尾铁箍是辨识点，与银镞箭的黑横纹白羽区分。

subject.zh: 三支弩矢并拢斜放，矢头在右上。矢比箭短一半、杆更粗，浅褐铁杉矢杆#a07850；铁矢头#7a7f88是方锥形，粗糙无光；尾端插着三片薄木片硬尾翼#8a6040，代替羽毛。
subject.en: Three crossbow bolts lying together at a slant, heads at upper right. Half the length of an arrow with thicker light brown hemlock shafts #a07850; square pyramidal iron heads #7a7f88, rough and dull; the tails carry three stiff vanes of thin wooden slat #8a6040 in place of feathers.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。弩矢五阶同一短粗形与方锥头，按阶换金属与尾翼片；与箭区分：短、粗、硬片尾翼。

subject.zh: 三支弩矢并拢斜放，矢头在右上。短而粗的浅褐铁杉矢杆，方锥形精钢矢头#a8b0bc，棱线一道亮高光；尾端三片深褐橡心木硬片尾翼#6a4628，削得平整，尾翼根部缠一圈细黑线。
subject.en: Three crossbow bolts lying together at a slant, heads at upper right. Short thick light brown hemlock shafts with square pyramidal bright steel heads #a8b0bc, a bright highlight along each ridge; three stiff vanes of dark brown oak-heart slat #6a4628 at the tail, planed smooth and bound at the root with fine black thread.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与 T1 同形；精钢矢头与深褐橡心木尾翼是差别，比箭明显短粗。

subject.zh: 三支弩矢并拢斜放，矢头在右上。短粗的浅褐铁杉矢杆，方锥形澱钢矢头蓝灰#5a6a80，带极淡的青色光泽#8fd0d8；尾端三片灰白的灰皮木硬片尾翼#8a8680，矢头后包一圈细铁箍。
subject.en: Three crossbow bolts lying together at a slant, heads at upper right. Short thick light brown hemlock shafts with square pyramidal blue-grey steel heads #5a6a80 with a very faint cyan sheen #8fd0d8; three stiff vanes of grey-white ashbark slat #8a8680 at the tail, and a thin iron collar just behind each head.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与前两阶同形；澱钢矢头光泽是青不是紫；灰白硬片尾翼是辨识点。

subject.zh: 三支弩矢并拢斜放，矢头在右上。短粗的浅褐铁杉矢杆，方锥形夜铁矢头黑而不反光#26232a，棱上透暗红光泽#8a3030，四角各多一个小倒刺；尾端三片红褐林紫杉硬片尾翼#9a4a3a。
subject.en: Three crossbow bolts lying together at a slant, heads at upper right. Short thick light brown hemlock shafts with square pyramidal night-iron heads, matte black #26232a with a dark red sheen #8a3030 along the ridges and a small extra spur at each corner; three stiff vanes of red-brown forest yew slat #9a4a3a at the tail.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与前几阶同形；夜铁黑红不反光，红褐尾翼片；与夜铁箭的乌黑长羽区分。

subject.zh: 三支弩矢并拢斜放，矢头在右上。短粗的浅褐铁杉矢杆，方锥形穹铁矢头灰白#c8ccd8，散着星点般的亮斑；尾端三片银白的世界树落枝硬片尾翼#e8e4d8，片根冒一点细小绿芽；矢尾包穹铁箍，带一两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: Three crossbow bolts lying together at a slant, heads at upper right. Short thick light brown hemlock shafts with square pyramidal sky-iron heads in grey-white #c8ccd8 scattered with starlike bright flecks; three stiff vanes of silver-white world-tree deadwood slat #e8e4d8 at the tail with a tiny green bud at the root, and a sky-iron cap on each nock, with one or two single-pixel sparkles.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与前几阶同形；穹铁星点与银白木尾翼上的小绿芽是辨识点，最精致的一阶。

subject.zh: 一小撮三颗河石弹丸聚在一起，四分之三俯视。石子是被水磨得光滑的扁圆卵石，颜色各略不同：灰#8a8a84、灰褐、一颗带白色石纹；每颗比核桃略小。朴素天然，没有加工痕迹。
subject.en: A small cluster of three river-stone sling shots, slight three-quarter overhead view. Water-smoothed flattened oval pebbles, each a slightly different colour: grey #8a8a84, grey-brown, and one with a white quartz vein; each a little smaller than a walnut. Plain and natural, with no tooling marks.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。三颗光滑卵石，颜色略不同；与 T2 铅弹的杏仁形、T3 黑铁圆球区分。

subject.zh: 一小撮三颗铅弹聚在一起，四分之三俯视。弹丸是两头尖的杏仁形，铅色暗蓝灰#707888，表面哑光，中间一道铸模留下的细合缝线；其中一颗被撞扁了一点。比河石小而沉，形状统一。
subject.en: A small cluster of three lead sling bullets, slight three-quarter overhead view. Almond-shaped and pointed at both ends, dull blue-grey lead #707888 with a matte surface and a fine mould seam running around the middle; one is slightly dented. Smaller and heavier than river stones, all the same shape.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。两头尖的杏仁形与铸模合缝是辨识点；铅色哑光，不要画成亮银。

subject.zh: 一小撮三颗黑铁弹丸聚在一起，四分之三俯视。弹丸是滚圆的铁球，近黑蓝灰#3c3f46，高光偏蓝，表面锻得紧实光滑；每颗压着一圈细细的环形箍纹。大小一致，沉甸甸的。
subject.en: A small cluster of three black-iron sling shots, slight three-quarter overhead view. Perfectly round balls of near-black blue-grey iron #3c3f46 with bluish highlights, forged dense and smooth, each pressed with a fine ring-shaped band. Uniform in size and heavy-looking.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。滚圆黑铁球加环形箍纹是辨识点；高光偏蓝，与 T2 杏仁形铅弹区分。

subject.zh: 三支火箭并拢斜放，箭镞在右上。浅褐铁杉箭杆，精钢镞#a8b0bc后面都缠着一团浸油的粗布，布团沾着点点硫黄粉#d8c040；最上面一支的布团燃着一小簇橙红火苗#f0a040，冒一缕黑烟。
subject.en: Three fire arrows lying together at a slant, heads at upper right. Light brown hemlock shafts with bright steel heads #a8b0bc, each with a wad of oil-soaked rough cloth wrapped just behind the head and flecked with sulphur-yellow powder #d8c040; the wad on the topmost arrow burns with a small tuft of orange-red flame #f0a040 and a wisp of black smoke.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。油布团与一簇火苗是辨识点；只点着一支，火不要大到盖住箭形。

subject.zh: 三支响箭并拢斜放，箭头在右上。浅褐铁杉箭杆，铁镞后面都套着一个白骨哨头#e0d8c4：圆鼓的骨球上开两个小孔，像一颗带孔的蒜头；箭羽是灰色鹅羽，箭尾系一缕红布条。
subject.en: Three whistling arrows lying together at a slant, heads at upper right. Light brown hemlock shafts, each iron head backed by a white bone whistle #e0d8c4, a bulging bone bulb pierced with two small holes like a holed garlic bulb; grey goose fletching and a wisp of red cloth tied at each tail.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。带孔的圆鼓骨哨头是辨识点，要比镞大一圈；与普通铁箭区分。

subject.zh: 三支银镞箭并拢斜放，箭镞在右上。浅褐铁杉箭杆，镞是宽三角形的纯银#d0d4dc，比钢更白更亮，带冷冷的光泽；箭羽是白羽加一道黑横纹，羽根缠白线。镞面素净无纹。
subject.en: Three silver-headed arrows lying together at a slant, heads at upper right. Light brown hemlock shafts with broad triangular heads of pure silver #d0d4dc, whiter and brighter than steel with a cold sheen; the fletching is white feathers crossed by one black band, bound with white thread. The heads are plain, with no engraving.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。银镞箭三阶同一宽三角镞与黑横纹白羽，与普通箭的柳叶镞区分；T2 素面。

subject.zh: 三支银镞箭并拢斜放，箭镞在右上。宽三角形银镞#d0d4dc中线刻一道细槽，镞后的箭杆缠一段细银丝；浅褐铁杉箭杆，白羽加一道黑横纹，修剪得整齐。比素面的银镞箭更精细。
subject.en: Three silver-headed arrows lying together at a slant, heads at upper right. Broad triangular silver heads #d0d4dc with a fine groove cut down the center line, and a short wrap of fine silver wire on the shaft just behind each head; light brown hemlock shafts with neatly trimmed white feathers crossed by one black band. Finer than the plain silver arrows.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与 T2 同形；镞中线细槽与银丝缠杆是 T3 的差别，不发光。

subject.zh: 三支银镞箭并拢斜放，箭镞在右上。宽三角形银镞#d0d4dc打磨得像镜面，刃口一线雪亮，带一两颗单像素亮点；镞后缠银丝，箭尾包一小截银箍。浅褐铁杉箭杆，修长的白羽加一道黑横纹。
subject.en: Three silver-headed arrows lying together at a slant, heads at upper right. Broad triangular silver heads #d0d4dc polished mirror-bright with a snow-bright edge and one or two single-pixel sparkles; silver wire wraps the shaft behind each head and a short silver cap sits on each nock. Light brown hemlock shafts with long white feathers crossed by one black band.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。与前两阶同形；镜面银镞加银箍箭尾是 T4 的差别，不用神光白金。

subject.zh: 三支倒钩箭并拢斜放，箭镞在右上。镞是一枚磨尖的米黄兽牙#d8ccb0，牙根两侧刻出向后弯的倒钩，用深色兽筋缠在浅褐铁杉箭杆上；箭羽是深褐色的粗羽#5a4030。镞形凶狠。
subject.en: Three barbed arrows lying together at a slant, heads at upper right. Each head is a sharpened cream-yellow beast fang #d8ccb0 with backward-curving barbs carved on both sides at its root, lashed to the light brown hemlock shaft with dark sinew; the fletching is coarse dark brown feathers #5a4030. A vicious head shape.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。兽牙镞与向后的倒钩是辨识点；牙是自然色，不加紫纹。

subject.zh: 三支瓷骨箭并拢斜放，箭镞在右上。镞是乳白的瓷骨#f4f0e8，像上了釉一样温润光滑，用细金线#d8b040缠在浅褐铁杉箭杆上；镞尖透出一丝神光白金#fff0c0的柔光，箭羽纯白。
subject.en: Three porcelain-bone arrows lying together at a slant, heads at upper right. Each head is milk-white porcelain bone #f4f0e8, smooth and lustrous as if glazed, bound to the light brown hemlock shaft with fine gold thread #d8b040; the tips give off a faint soft glow of holy white-gold #fff0c0, with pure white fletching.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。纯白瓷加金线，绝对不加紫色或灰斑；瓷质温润不是金属，与银镞箭区分。

subject.zh: 一枚拳头大的卵形炮弹，直立略斜，四分之三视角。弹壳是近黑蓝灰的黑铁#3c3f46，高光偏蓝，前端开着十字形槽口，露出里面一粒透着浅青光的小魔晶#a8e8e8；尾部一圈粗铆钉箍。
subject.en: A fist-sized egg-shaped cannon shell standing slightly tilted, three-quarter view. The casing is near-black blue-grey black iron #3c3f46 with bluish highlights, its nose cut with a cross-shaped slot revealing a small magic crystal glowing pale cyan #a8e8e8 inside; a band of heavy rivets rings the base.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。卵形黑铁壳与十字槽口里的浅青晶是辨识点；不加紫；比中晶攻城弹小而圆。

subject.zh: 一枚长圆柱形的攻城弹，斜放，弹头在右上。弹壳是蓝灰澱钢#5a6a80，泛极淡的青色光泽，钝圆弹头加厚，壳身三道粗铆箍；箍间开三道纵槽，露出一枚鸡蛋大的棱晶，透着浅青光#a8e8e8。
subject.en: A long cylindrical siege shell lying at a slant, nose at upper right. The casing is blue-grey steel #5a6a80 with a very faint cyan sheen, a thickened blunt rounded nose and three heavy riveted bands around the body; between the bands three lengthwise slots reveal an egg-sized prism crystal glowing pale cyan #a8e8e8. Bigger and heavier than the small crystal shell.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。长圆柱、三道铆箍、纵槽里的棱晶是辨识点；光泽是青不是紫，比小晶炮弹大。

subject.zh: 一枚圆球形的火玉弹，四分之三视角。外面箍着交叉的黑铁条#3c3f46，铁条之间露出一整块橙红火玉#e05030，透出余火般的橙光#f0a040；顶端铁条交汇处嵌一粒浅青小晶，球底一圈铆钉。
subject.en: A round fire-jade shell in three-quarter view. Crossing black-iron straps #3c3f46 cage a single orange-red fire jade #e05030 that shows between them and gives off an ember-like orange glow #f0a040; a small pale cyan crystal is set where the straps meet at the top, and a ring of rivets circles the base.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。铁条笼住的橙红火玉是辨识点，主光是橙色；与小晶炮弹的浅青光区分。

subject.zh: 一只敞口的铁皮圆筒弹，直立略斜，四分之三视角。筒身铁灰#7a7f88，上下各一道铆箍，侧壁开几个小孔，筒底一块厚铁底托；筒口挤满一簇浅青的碎晶尖片#a8e8e8，像一把向外炸开的晶针。
subject.en: An open-topped sheet-iron canister shell, upright and slightly tilted, three-quarter view. Iron-grey body #7a7f88 with a riveted band at top and bottom, a few small holes in the side and a thick iron base plate; the mouth is crammed with a cluster of pale cyan crystal shard splinters #a8e8e8 like a fistful of needles bursting outward.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。圆筒罐加口部一簇碎晶是辨识点；与卵形小晶炮弹、长圆柱攻城弹区分。

subject.zh: 一只粗玻璃爆罐，直立，四分之三视角。浑浊的厚玻璃罐身里卡着两块浑浊灰晶#8a8a90，晶芯透出一缕澱紫#4a3a62；罐口塞着软木塞，插一截短短的黑引信，罐颈胡乱缠着几圈旧布条。没有封签，做工粗糙。
subject.en: A crude glass blast jar, upright, three-quarter view. Two cloudy grey crystals #8a8a90 are wedged inside the thick murky glass, each with a wisp of sediment violet #4a3a62 at its core; a cork stopper holds a short black fuse, and old cloth strips are wound carelessly round the neck. No seal tag, rough workmanship.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。两块灰晶与晶芯的澱紫必须透过玻璃看得见；无封签、缠旧布，与晶爆罐的铁箍浅青晶区分。

subject.zh: 一只合规的晶爆罐，直立，四分之三视角。透明玻璃罐身外箍着十字形铁条#7a7f88，罐里并排两块透明浅青魔晶#a8e8e8，各有一点亮心；铁盖正中引出一截捻紧的引信，罐颈系一枚压着几何镐锤纹的红褐封签。
subject.en: A licensed crystal blast jar, upright, three-quarter view. Clear glass bound outside with a cross of iron straps #7a7f88, two clear pale-cyan crystals #a8e8e8 side by side inside, each with a bright core; a tightly twisted fuse rises from the centre of the iron lid, and a red-brown seal tag stamped with a geometric pick-and-hammer emblem hangs at the neck.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。晶是透明浅青不带紫；十字铁箍与镐锤纹封签是合法器材的标志，与澱晶爆罐区分。

subject.zh: 一只火油瓶，直立，四分之三视角。小圆肚粗玻璃瓶里装着大半瓶琥珀橙的油#d08030，液面浮一层油光；瓶口塞着一团浸油的破布当引火，布头垂在瓶颈外，用细麻绳扎了两圈。没有封蜡，不点火。
subject.en: A fire-oil flask, upright, three-quarter view. A small round-bellied rough glass bottle more than half full of amber-orange oil #d08030 with an oily sheen on top; a wad of oil-soaked rag is stuffed into the mouth as a wick, its end hanging over the neck and tied with two turns of thin hemp cord. No wax seal, not lit.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。瓶口塞布当引火是辨识点；油是琥珀橙而非治疗红，不画火焰，与守城火油桶区分。

subject.zh: 一只霜罐，直立，四分之三视角。矮胖的玻璃罐里翻着冰蓝#a0d0f0的凝雾，罐身外结着一层白霜，霜纹从底部往上爬；锡盖用细铁丝扣紧，盖顶嵌一小粒透明浅青碎晶#a8e8e8，旁边垂一个拉环。
subject.en: A frost jar, upright, three-quarter view. A squat glass jar filled with ice-blue #a0d0f0 swirling mist, its outside coated in white rime that creeps up from the base; a tin lid clamped with fine iron wire, a tiny clear pale-cyan crystal chip #a8e8e8 set in its top, and a pull ring hanging beside it.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。外壁白霜与冰蓝雾气是辨识点；锡盖铁丝扣表示高阶，与网罐、响罐的玻璃罐区分。

subject.zh: 一颗烟丸，四分之三俯视。拳头大小的圆球用深灰粗纸#5a5a58层层裹紧，外面十字捆一道细麻绳；顶上拧出一截纸捻当引信，纸缝里露出一点黑炭末#2a2a2a。素面无封签，像个灰色纸团。
subject.en: A smoke ball, three-quarter top-down view. A fist-sized sphere tightly wrapped in layers of dark grey coarse paper #5a5a58, tied crosswise with thin hemp cord; a twisted paper tail at the top serves as the fuse, and a little black charcoal dust #2a2a2a shows at the paper seams. Plain, no seal, like a grey paper bundle.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。圆纸团加顶上纸捻，不是玻璃罐；深灰纸与十字绳是辨识点，与闪光粉的白纸包区分。

subject.zh: 一个闪光粉纸包，斜放。白纸#ece6d8折成鼓起的三角小包，一角撕开，漏出一小撮雪白细粉，粉里夹着几粒透明浅青碎晶#a8e8e8闪着亮点；包口折边上压一枚红色圆印，系一根拉线。
subject.en: A flash-powder packet, lying at a slant. White paper #ece6d8 folded into a plump triangular packet, one corner torn open and spilling a small heap of snow-white fine powder with a few clear pale-cyan crystal flecks #a8e8e8 glinting in it; a red round stamp is pressed on the folded edge, with a pull string attached.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。三角白纸包加雪白粉与浅青亮点；红色圆印不能有字，与烟丸的灰纸球、灰晶粉的旧纸包区分。

subject.zh: 一只网罐，直立，四分之三视角。透明平肩玻璃罐里紧紧塞满折叠的灰白蛛丝网#c8c8c0，网眼的菱形格贴着罐壁清楚可见；软木塞外封红褐蜡，塞边垂出一个蛛丝绳拉环。罐身干净，没有发光。
subject.en: A net jar, upright, three-quarter view. A clear flat-shouldered glass jar packed tight with folded grey-white spider-silk netting #c8c8c0, its diamond mesh pressed visibly against the glass; the cork is sealed with red-brown wax, and a loop of silk cord hangs from beside the stopper as a pull tab. Clean jar, no glow.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。罐壁上的菱形网眼是唯一辨识点，要画清；不发光，与响罐的碎石、霜罐的白霜区分。

subject.zh: 一袋铁蒺藜，四分之三俯视。敞口的粗麻小袋#d8c8a8，抽绳松开，里面堆着几枚四尖铁蒺藜#7a7f88，尖刺朝各个方向支出袋口；袋前还滚出一枚，总有一根尖刺朝上。素铁无纹，带几点锈。
subject.en: A bag of iron caltrops, three-quarter top-down view. An open small hemp sack #d8c8a8 with its drawstring loosened, heaped with four-pointed iron caltrops #7a7f88 whose spikes jut out of the mouth in every direction; one has rolled out in front, a spike always pointing up. Plain iron, no pattern, a few rust specks.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。四尖蒺藜的形状要一眼认出，袋前滚出的一枚是重点；袋子不要画太大，与石灰袋区分。

subject.zh: 一只响罐，直立，四分之三视角。小圆肚粗玻璃罐里装着小半罐灰色碎石粒#8a8680，罐身外用细绳缠成网兜；软木塞正中嵌一小粒透明浅青碎晶#a8e8e8，塞顶系一截短拉绳。像个装了石子的玩具罐。
subject.en: A lure jar, upright, three-quarter view. A small round-bellied rough glass jar a third full of grey stone gravel #8a8680, wrapped outside in a string mesh; a tiny clear pale-cyan crystal chip #a8e8e8 is set in the centre of the cork, with a short pull cord tied on top. It looks like a toy jar full of pebbles.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。罐里的灰石粒与塞上碎晶是辨识点；绳网兜住罐身，与网罐的蛛丝网、霜罐区分。

subject.zh: 一瓶解毒剂，直立，四分之三视角。小圆肚粗玻璃瓶，玻璃里带几粒气泡，装着清亮的浅碧绿药液#60c0a0；瓶口塞软木塞，细麻绳在瓶颈绕一圈，绳头挂一片干薄荷叶。粗朴实用，不发光。
subject.en: An antidote, upright, three-quarter view. A small round-bellied rough glass bottle with a few bubbles in the glass, holding clear pale jade-green liquid #60c0a0; a cork stopper, thin hemp cord looped once round the neck, a dried mint leaf hanging from the cord end. Plain and practical, no glow.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。浅碧绿药液三阶相同只换瓶；不能画成毒的黄绿或澱病药的灰绿，薄荷叶是本族标记。

subject.zh: 一瓶解毒剂，直立，四分之三视角。透明玻璃平肩瓶，装着清亮的浅碧绿药液#60c0a0，液面映出一道高光；软木塞外封一层红褐色蜡#8a4a30，蜡下压着一圈细绳，绳头仍挂一片干薄荷叶。
subject.en: An antidote, upright, three-quarter view. A clear flat-shouldered glass bottle holding clear pale jade-green liquid #60c0a0 with a highlight on its surface; the cork is sealed with red-brown wax #8a4a30 over a turn of thin string, whose end still carries a dried mint leaf.

items.notes: 阶的视觉：同族各阶外形与颜色一致，只按阶换瓶型、器皿、纸张或金属。平肩瓶加红褐蜡封是本阶；药液颜色与另两阶完全一致，薄荷叶保留作同族标记。

subject.zh: 一瓶解毒剂，直立，四分之三视角。细高的透明玻璃瓶，装着清亮的浅碧绿药液#60c0a0；瓶口是锡盖#a0a4a8，用细铁丝扣扣紧，瓶颈系一片干薄荷叶和一圈浅碧绿细绳。瓶形修长，比低阶更精致。
subject.en: An antidote, upright, three-quarter view.
