items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。锥形撞头加螺旋晶带；只画锥头与套座，不画整架撞城锤；与晶炮区分。

subject.zh: 烽晶台的火盆构件，直立四分之三视角。一只银#d0d4dc镶边的石火盆立在短三脚架上，盆里卧着一块魔晶，燃起一束细高的浅青火焰#a8e8e8，焰心近白；盆沿挂两片挡雨的小檐片。
subject.en: The fire-basin part of a crystal beacon, upright in three-quarter view. A stone brazier rimmed in silver #d0d4dc on a short tripod, a crystal resting in the bowl and burning with a tall slender pale cyan flame #a8e8e8 that is almost white at its heart; two small rain-guard eaves hang from the rim.

items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。画火盆不画哨塔；火焰是浅青晶焰不是橙火；挡雨檐片是辨识点；与港灯（灯笼）区分。

subject.zh: 一只传令晶号，横放略斜，号口朝右。弯成半月的兽角号#c8b898，上下箍三道银#d0d4dc环，号口内圈嵌一圈小魔晶，透浅青光#a8e8e8；吹口包银，号身挂一条深红#8a2a2a背带，军中式样干净统一。
subject.en: A command horn lying nearly level, bell toward the right. A half-moon curved animal horn #c8b898 bound with three silver #d0d4dc rings, a ring of small crystals glowing pale cyan #a8e8e8 set inside the bell; the mouthpiece is capped in silver and a dark red #8a2a2a carrying strap hangs from it, in clean, uniform military style.

items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。弯角号形，号口晶圈是标志；深红背带；与耳语贝（小海螺）区分。

subject.zh: 一辆野战结界车的微缩，四分之三视角。双轮的矮木车#6a4628，车前竖着一面高过车身的厚盾板，镀金#d8b040包边，顶沿一排三枚魔晶，透浅青光#a8e8e8，向前张开一层淡淡的弧形光幕。车身圆润，挂一只小铃。
subject.en: A miniature field barrier cart in three-quarter view. A low two-wheeled wooden cart #6a4628 with a thick shield board standing at its front, taller than the cart and edged in gilt #d8b040; three crystals along its top edge glow pale cyan #a8e8e8 and spread a faint curved sheet of light forward. The cart is rounded in shape with a small bell hanging from it.

items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。车加高盾板与弧形光幕是标志；画微缩模型，不画拉车牲畜；与晶炮的炮车区分。

subject.zh: 一盏战地医灯，直立四分之三视角。手提圆筒灯，银#d0d4dc顶盖与提环，磨砂玻璃灯罩里魔晶透出柔和的浅青光#a8e8e8；灯身系一条白布带，布带上缝一枚绿色叶形徽记#7ac060。
subject.en: A field infirmary lamp, upright in three-quarter view. A cylindrical hand lantern with a silver #d0d4dc top and carrying ring, a crystal behind its frosted glass shade giving off a soft pale cyan light #a8e8e8; a white cloth band is tied around the body with a green leaf-shaped emblem #7ac060 sewn onto it.

items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。白布带加绿叶徽是医用标志，不画十字；光柔和；与港灯（八角笼光束）、照纹灯区分。

subject.zh: 一支远望晶镜，斜放45度，目镜在左下、物镜在右上。三节可伸缩的长镜筒，月银#e0e8f0精雕卷草纹，节口镀金；物镜镜片中心一点星光般的白亮点；筒身晶座的魔晶浅青光#a8e8e8是全系最亮的。
subject.en: A far-sight crystal spyglass lying at 45 degrees, eyepiece at lower left and objective at upper right. A three-section telescoping tube of moonsilver #e0e8f0 finely carved with scrolling leaf work, gilded at each joint; a single star-like white point shines at the center of the objective lens, and the crystal set in the barrel glows the brightest pale cyan #a8e8e8 of the set.

items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。三节伸缩长筒形，物镜一点星光亮点；与品鉴镜（短目镜）、残页镜区分，精雕最亮。

subject.zh: 一枚浮桥晶，斜放45度。一根扁长的大魔晶，晶面分成一节一节，像排好的桥板，透浅青光#a8e8e8；两端各套一只镀金#d8b040夹头，夹头上再嵌一颗小晶；晶下沿挂着几滴水珠。
subject.en: A bridge crystal lying at 45 degrees. A long flat crystal divided along its length into segments like laid bridge planks, glowing pale cyan #a8e8e8; each end is fitted with a gilded #d8b040 clamp set with one more small crystal, and a few drops of water cling to its lower edge.

items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。扁长分节的晶条像桥板是标志；画晶条本身，不画河与桥；与破城晶锥的锥形区分。

subject.zh: 号旗晶：一段旗杆顶，斜放45度，杆尖在右上。杆顶的银#d0d4dc尖托夹着一枚魔晶，透浅青光#a8e8e8，四周放出短光芒；晶下挂一面燕尾小旗，深红#8a2a2a布面绣一枚无字几何纹章。
subject.en: A rally standard crystal: the top section of a banner pole lying at 45 degrees, tip toward the upper right. A silver #d0d4dc finial at the top grips a crystal glowing pale cyan #a8e8e8 with short rays around it; below it hangs a small swallowtail pennant of dark red #8a2a2a cloth embroidered with a wordless geometric crest.

items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。只画旗杆顶段与燕尾小旗；旗面无字；晶在杆顶；与传讯塔尖构件区分。

subject.zh: 一枚门标，直立四分之三视角。巴掌大的灰石#8e8c88小碑，削成拱顶门的形状，底下一截短尖好插进地里；门形轮廓刻成凹线，线里透门扉金#f0d890的细光，门心一粒小晶座同样发金光。石面粗糙，有手作痕迹。
subject.en: A door marker, upright in three-quarter view. A palm-sized grey stone #8e8c88 tablet cut into the shape of an arched door, with a short spike underneath for planting in the ground; the door outline is carved as a groove that glows with a thin line of door gold #f0d890, and a tiny crystal socket at the door's center shines the same gold. Rough, handmade stone surface.

items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。门类用门扉金不用浅青；拱门形小石碑是标志；T0 庭具最朴素，不加金属件。

subject.zh: 一座门标座，四分之三俯视。方正的灰石#8e8c88矮座，表面是整齐的矮人式凿痕，四角包银#d0d4dc；座顶开一道拱门形插槽，空着，槽底透出门扉金#f0d890的光；座前嵌一枚门形小徽。
subject.en: A marker plinth seen in three-quarter view from above. A squared, low grey stone #8e8c88 block dressed with neat dwarven chisel marks and capped in silver #d0d4dc at the corners; an empty arched-door-shaped slot is cut into its top with door gold light #f0d890 rising from the bottom of the slot, and a small door-shaped badge is set into the front.

items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。空着的拱门形插槽是辨识点，不画门标本身；方正矮座；与门路锁盘区分。

subject.zh: 一只门感铃，直立四分之三视角，上方一段系绳。门铜#9a7840小手铃，铃身镂出一个拱门形的孔，铃舌是玻璃珠包着的一粒小晶，透门扉金#f0d890的光；铃面敲打痕明显，像手工自制，绳上缀一片旧布。
subject.en: A gate-sense bell, upright in three-quarter view with a length of cord above. A small door-copper #9a7840 hand bell with an arched door-shaped hole pierced through its side; the clapper is a tiny crystal sealed in a glass bead glowing door gold #f0d890, the bell shows clear hammer marks as if homemade, and a scrap of old cloth is tied to the cord.

items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。铃身拱门镂孔与门扉金铃舌是标志；手作粗糙感；与虚压铃（宽口、钟铜、浅青）区分。

subject.zh: 一枚门路锁盘，正面略俯视。厚重的门铜#9a7840圆盘，外缘精雕三圈可转动的同心环，环上刻门形纹；盘心一个锁孔，透出全系最亮的门扉金#f0d890光，环缝里也渗出细细金光，缀几个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A gate-path lock disc, face-on and seen slightly from above. A thick door-copper #9a7840 disc with three finely carved concentric rings around its edge that look able to turn, each carved with door-shaped motifs; a keyhole at the center pours out the brightest door gold #f0d890 light of the family, fine gold light seeps from the ring seams too, with a few single-pixel sparkles.

items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。同心转环加中心锁孔是标志；不要画裂纹；与通行计（鼓形计数器）区分。

subject.zh: 一盏执钥灯，直立四分之三视角。灯框做成拱顶门的形状，门铜#9a7840框镀门扉金边，四面玻璃，灯心一枚魔晶透门扉金#f0d890光；灯顶挂钩弯成一把钥匙的形状，框脚嵌两颗小金晶。
subject.en: A keyholder lantern, upright in three-quarter view. The frame is shaped like an arched door, made of door copper #9a7840 edged in door gold, with glass on four sides and a crystal at its heart glowing door gold #f0d890; the hanging hook on top is bent into the shape of a key, and two small gold-lit crystals sit at the feet of the frame.

items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。拱门形灯框加钥匙形挂钩是标志；光用门扉金，不画变淡或紫色；与照纹灯、医灯区分。

subject.zh: 一只通行计，直立四分之三视角。矮鼓形的门铜#9a7840计数器，侧面叠着三圈可转的银#d0d4dc刻环，环上只有点与短线；正面开一扇拱门形小窗，透门扉金#f0d890的光，顶上晶座嵌一枚碎晶同样发金光。
subject.en: A passage counter, upright in three-quarter view. A short drum-shaped counter of door copper #9a7840 with three turning silver #d0d4dc rings stacked around its side, marked only with dots and short ticks; a small arched-door window in the front glows door gold #f0d890, and a crystal chip in a socket on top shines the same gold.

items.notes: 魔道具：晶座必须可见，外壳材质按阶升级（铜、钟铜、银、镀金、精雕）。鼓形叠环计数器，环上不能有数字；拱门小窗是门类标志；与门路锁盘（扁圆盘）区分。

subject.zh: 一块铁矿石，四分之三俯视。灰褐色粗糙岩块#6a6058，几道铁灰矿脉#7a7f88斜穿而过，矿脉边缘带锈红斑#9a5a3a；岩面坑洼，一角沾着细碎矿灰。素朴哑光，只有矿脉上一点小高光。
subject.en: A chunk of iron ore in three-quarter top-down view. A rough grey-brown rock #6a6058 crossed diagonally by a few iron-grey veins #7a7f88, the vein edges stained with rust-red patches #9a5a3a; the surface is pitted, with fine ore dust clinging to one corner. Plain and matte, with only a small highlight on one vein.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。基础铁矿：灰褐岩加铁灰矿脉与锈斑；与荒原古铁（锈块里嵌旧铁器）和黑铁矿区分。

subject.zh: 一块铜矿石，四分之三俯视。灰褐岩块#6a6058里嵌着几道赭橙铜脉#c87a48，铜脉旁散着几点铜绿#5a9a80；岩块棱角分明，断面露出一小片亮铜色。朴素，不发光。
subject.en: A chunk of copper ore in three-quarter top-down view. A grey-brown rock #6a6058 set with a few ochre-orange copper veins #c87a48, with a few dots of verdigris #5a9a80 scattered beside them; the rock is sharply angular and a broken face shows a small patch of bright copper. Plain, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。赭橙铜脉加零星铜绿是辨识点；不夹暗红颗粒，与赤砧铜区分。

subject.zh: 一根铁锭，四分之三视角的梯形锭条。铁灰#7a7f88，暗部#4a4e55，表面略粗糙，带几个铸造留下的小气孔；顶面平，棱角略圆钝。朴素无纹，只有顶边一点小高光。
subject.en: An iron ingot: a trapezoidal bar in three-quarter view. Iron grey #7a7f88 with shadows #4a4e55, the surface slightly rough with a few small casting pores; the top is flat and the edges a little rounded. Plain and unmarked, with just a small highlight on the top edge.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。全库锭条的基准外形：梯形、铁灰、带小气孔；其他锭只换颜色与一个辨识特征。

subject.zh: 一根铜锭，四分之三视角的梯形锭条。赭橙铜色#c87a48，顶面比侧面亮一阶；一侧下沿生出一小片铜绿#5a9a80；表面平整，没有压印。朴素，顶面左上一点小高光。
subject.en: A copper ingot: a trapezoidal bar in three-quarter view. Ochre-orange copper #c87a48, the top face one shade brighter than the sides; a small patch of verdigris #5a9a80 has formed along one lower edge; the surface is smooth with no stamp. Plain, with a small highlight at the top left.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。与铁锭同形，只换铜色；一角铜绿是辨识点，不要画成金锭。

subject.zh: 一块银矿石，四分之三俯视。灰岩块#6e6a68里夹着几道亮冷灰银脉#d0d4dc，银脉旁嵌着几粒方块状的暗铅灰晶粒#5a5c64；银脉比岩石亮得多，有一个小高光。
subject.en: A chunk of silver ore in three-quarter top-down view. A grey rock #6e6a68 holding a few bright cool-grey silver veins #d0d4dc, with several small cubic dark lead-grey grains #5a5c64 embedded beside them; the veins are far brighter than the rock and carry a small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。银脉旁的方块铅灰晶粒是辨识点；银脉要冷白，不偏黄，与霜镐银区分。

subject.zh: 一根银锭，四分之三视角的梯形锭条。亮冷灰银色#d0d4dc，表面光滑，顶面中央压着一枚无字的小圆形压印；棱线清楚，顶边一道细高光，暗部偏冷蓝灰#9aa0ac。
subject.en: A silver ingot: a trapezoidal bar in three-quarter view. Bright cool-grey silver #d0d4dc with a smooth surface and a small blank round stamp pressed into the centre of the top; crisp edges, a thin highlight along the top edge, shadows in cool blue-grey #9aa0ac.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。冷白光滑、顶面小圆印是辨识点；不发光，不偏蓝白，与月银锭区分。

subject.zh: 一根精钢锭，四分之三视角的梯形锭条。亮钢灰#a8b0bc，表面打磨平整，棱角锋利，顶边一线明亮高光；侧面隐约有几道折叠锻打留下的细横纹。素面无印。
subject.en: A fine steel ingot: a trapezoidal bar in three-quarter view. Bright steel grey #a8b0bc, ground smooth with sharp edges and a single bright line of highlight along the top edge; faint fine horizontal lines from fold forging show on the side. Unstamped.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。亮钢灰加棱线高光是基准；与帝国制式钢（两锭叠放带红漆）和赤砧钢（砧形印）区分。

subject.zh: 一块黑铁矿石，四分之三俯视。深灰岩块#4a4648，里面嵌着宽厚的近黑蓝灰矿脉#3c3f46，矿脉上的高光偏蓝#6a7a90；岩块沉重方钝，断口粗糙。不发光。
subject.en: A chunk of blackiron ore in three-quarter top-down view. A dark grey rock #4a4648 holding broad near-black blue-grey veins #3c3f46 whose highlights lean blue #6a7a90; the rock is heavy and blocky with rough broken faces. No glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。矿脉近黑而高光偏蓝是辨识点；不加紫斑或红光，与夜铁矿区分。

subject.zh: 一根黑铁锭，四分之三视角的梯形锭条，比铁锭更矮更厚。近黑蓝灰#3c3f46，高光偏蓝#6a7a90；表面无纹无印，棱角钝厚，显得沉重。只有顶边一点冷蓝小高光。
subject.en: A blackiron ingot: a trapezoidal bar in three-quarter view, squatter and thicker than an iron ingot. Near-black blue-grey #3c3f46 with blue-leaning highlights #6a7a90; no pattern or stamp, the edges blunt and heavy. Only a small cold blue highlight on the top edge.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。矮厚的锭形与偏蓝高光是辨识点；不刻任何纹，不带红光，与夜铁锭区分。

subject.zh: 一根澱钢锭，四分之三视角的梯形锭条。蓝灰#5a6a80，表面覆着一层极淡的青色光泽#8fd0d8，像水面反光；侧面有几道细细的层叠纹。棱线干净，顶边一点小高光。
subject.en: A diansteel ingot: a trapezoidal bar in three-quarter view. Blue-grey #5a6a80 overlaid with a very faint cyan sheen #8fd0d8, like light on water; a few fine layered lines run along the side. Clean edges and a small highlight on the top edge.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。名字带澱但颜色是蓝灰加淡青光泽，绝不能用紫；与精钢锭（亮灰无光泽）区分。

subject.zh: 一块夜铁矿石，四分之三俯视。暗灰玄武岩块#3a3638，夹着几道黑色矿脉#26232a，矿脉表面泛一层暗红光泽#8a3030，几乎不反光；岩面多棱角。整体阴沉，只有岩棱上一点暗淡小高光。
subject.en: A chunk of nightiron ore in three-quarter top-down view. A dark grey basalt block #3a3638 with a few black veins #26232a that carry a dark red sheen #8a3030 and barely reflect light; the rock is many-angled. Gloomy overall, with only a dim small highlight on one rock edge.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。黑脉上的暗红光泽是辨识点，不能亮；与黑铁矿（偏蓝高光）区分。

subject.zh: 一根夜铁锭，四分之三视角的梯形锭条，顶面两角各多切一道斜面，显得多棱。黑色#26232a，棱边泛暗红光泽#8a3030，表面不反光，只有一点极暗的小高光。冷硬阴沉。
subject.en: A nightiron ingot: a trapezoidal bar in three-quarter view with an extra bevel cut at both top corners, giving it many facets. Black #26232a with a dark red sheen #8a3030 along the edges; the surface does not reflect, with just one very dim small highlight. Cold, hard and sombre.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。多切的斜面与暗红棱光是辨识点；不能有亮高光，与黑铁锭的蓝光区分。

subject.zh: 一根月银锭，四分之三视角的细长梯形锭条。冷白银色#e0e8f0带一层浅蓝#b8d0e8，表面光滑如月光下的水；顶面压着一枚细小的弯月形凹印。柔和的冷光泽，顶边一道细高光。
subject.en: A moonsilver ingot: a slender trapezoidal bar in three-quarter view. Cold white silver #e0e8f0 washed with pale blue #b8d0e8, smooth as water under moonlight; a small crescent-shaped recess is pressed into the top. A soft cool sheen with a thin highlight along the top edge.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。弯月凹印与浅蓝冷白是辨识点；比银锭更细长更亮，不加紫，不画成透明。

subject.zh: 一块穹铁，四分之三俯视。拳头大的不规则金属块，灰白色#c8ccd8，表面布满熔蚀的小凹坑，一侧有烧黑的焦壳#4a4850；金属面上散着几粒星点般的亮斑，其中一两粒是单像素亮点。
subject.en: A chunk of vaultiron in three-quarter top-down view. A fist-sized irregular lump of metal, grey-white #c8ccd8, its surface covered in small melted pits, with a scorched black crust #4a4850 on one side; a few star-like bright flecks dot the metal, one or two of them single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。不是带矿脉的岩石，而是坑洼的天降金属块；焦壳与星点亮斑是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一根穹铁锭，四分之三视角的梯形锭条。灰白色#c8ccd8，表面平滑，像夜空一样散布着细小的星点亮斑，其中一两粒是单像素亮点；棱线清楚，顶边一道浅淡高光。
subject.en: A vaultiron ingot: a trapezoidal bar in three-quarter view. Grey-white #c8ccd8 with a smooth surface scattered with tiny star-like bright flecks like a night sky, one or two of them single-pixel highlights; crisp edges and a pale highlight along the top edge.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。灰白锭面上的星点亮斑是辨识点；不画成银锭的纯冷白，也不加光晕。

subject.zh: 一根炉心金锭，四分之三视角的梯形锭条。深橙金#e0a030，像余火一样暖；锭身下沿透出一圈暗红橙的余热色#c05a20，仿佛刚出炉。表面温润，顶面有一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A forgeheart gold ingot: a trapezoidal bar in three-quarter view. Deep orange gold #e0a030, warm like banked embers; a band of dark red-orange residual heat #c05a20 shows along the lower edge as if just out of the furnace. A mellow surface with one or two single-pixel highlights on top.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。下沿的余热红橙是辨识点；是深橙金而非黄金，不用门扉金或白金色。

subject.zh: 一根门铜锭，四分之三视角的梯形锭条。暗金铜#9a7840，顶面浮着一个拱门形的浅浮雕框，铜纹细缝里透出门扉金#f0d890的细光；几处凹槽里有暗紫纹#4a3a62爬过。外缘一像素淡金光晕。
subject.en: A gatebronze ingot: a trapezoidal bar in three-quarter view. Dark gold-bronze #9a7840 with a low-relief arched doorway frame raised on the top, fine door-gold #f0d890 light glinting from the cracks in the metal grain; thin dark purple lines #4a3a62 creep through a few recesses. A one-pixel pale gold halo along the outline.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。拱门浮雕与纹缝里的门扉金细光是辨识点；暗紫只在凹槽里少量出现。

subject.zh: 一段短原木，四分之三俯视，截面朝左上。中褐木身#8a6040，深褐树皮#5a3e28带竖向裂纹，侧面伸出一截短枝桩；斧砍的截面浅黄褐#c8a070，年轮清楚。朴素无光泽。
subject.en: A short log in three-quarter top-down view, cut face toward the upper left. Mid-brown wood #8a6040 under dark brown bark #5a3e28 with vertical cracks, a short branch stub sticking out of the side; the axe-cut face is light tan #c8a070 with clear growth rings. Plain, no sheen.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。基础木材：斧砍截面与短枝桩；与精灵倒木（参差断口加苔藓）区分。

subject.zh: 一段橡心木短原木，四分之三俯视，截面朝左上。树皮粗厚，沟裂很深；截面中央是深褐心材#6a4628，年轮又细又密，外圈一窄条浅色边材#b08a60。木身沉实，截面有一点油润光泽。
subject.en: A short log of oak heartwood in three-quarter top-down view, cut face toward the upper left. Thick bark with deep furrows; the centre of the cut face is dark brown heartwood #6a4628 with fine, tightly packed rings, ringed by a narrow band of pale sapwood #b08a60. Dense and heavy, the cut face slightly oily.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。截面上深色心材与细密年轮是辨识点；比普通木更粗更深，不加纹饰。

subject.zh: 一段灰皮木短原木，四分之三俯视，截面朝左上。灰白树皮#8a8680薄而起鳞，表面浮着一层灰烬似的细粉；截面木芯浅米白#d8d0b8，年轮淡。树皮裂缝里有几缕细细的暗紫纹#4a3a62。
subject.en: A short log of ashbark in three-quarter top-down view, cut face toward the upper left. Thin, flaking grey-white bark #8a8680 dusted with a fine ash-like powder; the cut face shows a pale cream core #d8d0b8 with faint rings. A few fine dark purple threads #4a3a62 run in the bark cracks.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。灰白树皮与浅色木芯是辨识点；暗紫只在裂缝里细细几缕，不发光。

subject.zh: 一段林紫杉枝木，四分之三俯视，截面朝左上。树皮薄，呈红褐鳞片状剥落；截面中心是红褐心材#9a4a3a，外围一圈奶白边材#e0d0b0，对比鲜明。两端是自然折断的旧断口，没有斧痕。
subject.en: A length of forest yew in three-quarter top-down view, cut face toward the upper left. Thin bark peeling in red-brown flakes; the face shows red-brown heartwood #9a4a3a ringed by a sharply contrasting band of cream sapwood #e0d0b0. Both ends are old natural breaks with no axe marks.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。红心白边的截面对比是辨识点；断口是自然折断不是斧砍。

subject.zh: 一截世界树落枝，四分之三俯视，截面朝左上。银白色木身#e8e4d8，树皮光滑带极细的纵纹，枝身冒出两三粒细小的嫩绿芽#8ac868；截面年轮泛着柔和的珍珠光，有一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A fallen branch of the world tree in three-quarter top-down view, cut face toward the upper left. Silver-white wood #e8e4d8 with smooth, finely grooved bark, two or three tiny tender green buds #8ac868 sprouting from it; the rings on the end face have a soft pearly sheen with one or two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。银白木身与嫩绿小芽是辨识点；是落下的枝段不是砍下的原木，不发金光。

subject.zh: 一块门木，四分之三俯视。从古门扉上拆下的厚木板段，深褐旧木#4a3a2c，断面年轮极密；板面嵌着一枚锈蚀门钉与半个铰链孔，木纹细缝透出门扉金#f0d890细光，几缕暗紫纹#4a3a62。外缘一像素淡光晕。
subject.en: A piece of gatewood in three-quarter top-down view: a thick plank section taken from an ancient door leaf, dark brown old wood #4a3a2c with extremely tight rings on its end. A rusted door nail and half a hinge hole sit in its face, fine door-gold #f0d890 light glints from the grain cracks, with a few dark purple lines #4a3a62. A one-pixel faint halo on the outline.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。厚板段加门钉与铰链孔是辨识点，不是圆原木；门扉金细光要细，暗紫只几缕。

subject.zh: 一小束药草，斜放，根部用细麻绳扎住。五六枝寻常的绿草#6a9a50，叶片宽而带锯齿，叶脉浅一阶，根须带一点干土。朴素实用，没有花，没有光泽。
subject.en: A small bunch of medicinal herbs lying at a slant, tied at the roots with thin hemp string. Five or six stems of ordinary green herb #6a9a50 with broad serrated leaves and veins one shade lighter, a little dry soil on the roots. Plain and practical, no flowers, no sheen.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。基础药草：宽叶锯齿、无花无光；与庭草（扎浅蓝丝带）和银叶草（叶背银白）区分。

subject.zh: 一小束银叶草，斜放，用细麻绳扎住。细长的披针形叶片，正面暗绿#5a7a50，叶背亮银白#c8d0cc，几片叶子翻转露出银色一面；茎细而直。叶背有一点小高光。
subject.en: A small bunch of silverleaf lying at a slant, tied with thin hemp string. Long lance-shaped leaves, dark green #5a7a50 on top and bright silver-white #c8d0cc underneath, several turned over to show the silver side; the stems are thin and straight. A small highlight on the silver undersides.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。叶背银白、正反两色是辨识点；与普通药草的宽锯齿叶区分。

subject.zh: 一小束祛灰草，斜放，根部用细绳扎住。叶片厚而软，灰绿色#8a9a80，叶面覆着一层浅灰白的细绒毛#c8ccc0，叶缘微卷；根上沾着一点灰土。不发光。
subject.en: A small bunch of greybane lying at a slant, tied at the roots with thin string. Thick soft grey-green leaves #8a9a80 covered with fine pale grey-white down #c8ccc0, the edges slightly curled; a little grey soil clings to the roots. No glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。灰绿厚叶加白绒毛是辨识点；名字带灰但不能加紫色，与灰百合区分。

subject.zh: 两枝灰百合，斜放，茎根用细绳扎在一起。花朵是下垂的喇叭形，花瓣灰白#c0bcb8带灰烬色的边，花喉里有几道细细的暗紫纹#4a3a62；茎叶灰绿。整体苍白冷淡。
subject.en: Two stems of ash lily lying at a slant, tied together at the base with thin string. Drooping trumpet-shaped flowers with grey-white petals #c0bcb8 edged in ash colour, a few fine dark purple lines #4a3a62 inside each throat; grey-green stems and leaves. Pale and cold overall.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。下垂的灰白喇叭花是辨识点；暗紫只在花喉里几道细纹，不发光。

subject.zh: 一团月苔，四分之三俯视，下面垫一片湿叶，用细绳轻轻扎住。苔丛柔软蓬松，银蓝绿色#a8c8c0，苔尖泛着一层月光般的银白光泽#e0ecf0；叶上留几颗水珠。柔和，不刺眼。
subject.en: A clump of moonmoss in three-quarter top-down view, resting on a damp leaf and loosely tied with thin string. The moss is soft and springy, silvery blue-green #a8c8c0, its tips holding a moonlight-like silver-white sheen #e0ecf0; a few water droplets sit on the leaf. Gentle, not glaring.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。银蓝绿的蓬松苔团与苔尖银光是辨识点；是苔不是草，不画成一束长叶。

subject.zh: 一小束风鬃草，斜放，中段用红黄两色编绳扎住。草叶细长，银绿色#a0b080，叶梢一齐向一侧飘拂，像被风吹起的马鬃；根部短而结实。叶梢有一点浅亮高光。
subject.en: A small bunch of windmane grass lying at a slant, bound at the middle with a red and yellow braided cord. Long slender silver-green blades #a0b080 all streaming to one side like a horse's mane in the wind; the roots are short and sturdy. A pale bright highlight at the blade tips.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。一边倒的长叶像马鬃、彩色编绳是辨识点；与银叶草的直立叶区分。

subject.zh: 一株灵泉莲，单株连根，斜放。一朵半开的莲花，花瓣是带淡青的玉白色#e0f0ec，瓣尖染一点浅水青#a8d8d0；下面一截浅褐莲茎连着一段嫩藕根，挂着水珠。花瓣上有一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A single spring lotus with its root, lying at a slant. One half-open flower with jade-white petals tinged pale cyan #e0f0ec, the petal tips touched with pale water-cyan #a8d8d0; below, a light brown stem joins a section of young lotus root hung with water droplets. One or two single-pixel highlights on the petals.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。玉白带淡青的莲花连藕根是辨识点；不用白金色，不画水面背景。

subject.zh: 一滴世界树露，盛在一片卷起的银白叶片#e8e4d8上，四分之三俯视。露珠很大，清澈透明，内里一点柔和的浅绿亮心#c8f0c0；叶面有细叶脉。露珠外缘一像素淡光晕，带一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A drop of world tree dew held in a curled silver-white leaf #e8e4d8, three-quarter top-down view. The droplet is large and perfectly clear with a soft pale green bright core #c8f0c0 inside; the leaf shows fine veins. A one-pixel faint halo around the drop and one or two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。主体是露珠不是瓶子；银白叶片与珠内浅绿亮心是辨识点，不用白金色。

subject.zh: 一张生皮，折成两折，四分之三俯视。外露的肉面是浅肉米色#c8a888，边缘不规整，翻折处露出一线短短的褐色兽毛#7a5a40；中间用一根粗绳捆住，打一个结。粗糙，没有光泽。
subject.en: A raw hide folded in two, three-quarter top-down view. The exposed flesh side is a pale fleshy beige #c8a888 with ragged edges, a line of short brown fur #7a5a40 showing at the fold; a thick cord ties it round the middle in a knot. Rough, no sheen.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。未鞣的生皮：肉面朝外、边缘不齐；与狼皮（灰毛加尾巴）和厚皮区分。

subject.zh: 一张狼皮，毛面朝外折起，四分之三俯视。灰色兽毛#8a8680，背脊一道深灰毛带，腹边毛色发白；一端垂出一条蓬松的狼尾，中间用细皮绳捆住。毛尖有一点柔亮。
subject.en: A wolf pelt folded fur side out, three-quarter top-down view. Grey fur #8a8680 with a darker grey stripe down the spine and whitish fur at the belly edge; a bushy wolf tail hangs from one end, and a thin leather thong ties it round the middle. A soft shine on the fur tips.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。灰毛加垂下的蓬松狼尾是辨识点；毛面朝外，与生皮的肉面朝外区分。

subject.zh: 一卷皮革，横放，四分之三视角。中褐色鞣革#8a5a34卷成筒，卷口露出一圈螺旋的皮边，表面平滑带细微纹理；中间用一根细皮绳绕两圈打结。朴素，表面有一点柔光。
subject.en: A roll of leather lying horizontally in three-quarter view. Mid-brown tanned leather #8a5a34 rolled into a tube, the open end showing a spiral of leather edges, the surface smooth with fine grain; a thin leather thong is wound twice round the middle and knotted. Plain, with a soft sheen.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。鞣好的皮卷成筒（生皮是折叠）是关键区分；与风牙熏革的熏黑边区分。

subject.zh: 一张厚皮，毛面朝外折起，四分之三俯视。深褐粗硬的鬃毛#4a3428，翻折处露出很厚的皮层，像叠了两层；用一根粗麻绳十字捆住。粗重结实，没有光泽。
subject.en: A thick hide folded fur side out, three-quarter top-down view. Coarse, stiff dark brown bristles #4a3428, the fold revealing a very thick layer of skin as if doubled over; a heavy hemp rope binds it crosswise. Heavy and sturdy, no sheen.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。粗硬深褐鬃毛与厚厚的折边是辨识点；十字捆绳，比生皮厚一倍。

subject.zh: 两片叠放的硬革板，四分之三俯视。深褐色#6a4226，板面平直发硬，边缘一圈压出的缝线#4a2e18，四角略微翘起；中间用一条带铁扣的皮带捆住。表面哑光。
subject.en: Two stacked panels of hardened leather in three-quarter top-down view. Dark brown #6a4226, flat and stiff, a pressed stitch line #4a2e18 running round each edge and the corners curling up slightly; an iron-buckled strap binds them in the middle. Matte surface.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。硬革是平直的板片，不卷；边缘压线是辨识点，与皮革卷区分。

subject.zh: 一张澱兽皮，折起，四分之三俯视。灰褐兽毛#6a6058间杂着灰白斑块，翻出的肉面发灰，上面爬着细细的暗紫纹路#4a3a62，像细根；用粗绳捆住。整体阴沉，不发光。
subject.en: A dian-beast hide folded up, three-quarter top-down view. Grey-brown fur #6a6058 mottled with grey-white patches; the turned-out flesh side is greyish and crept over by fine dark purple lines #4a3a62 like thin roots; bound with a thick cord. Sombre overall, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。肉面上的暗紫细纹是辨识点；不加暗雾，与渊兽皮的近黑与暗雾区分。

subject.zh: 一卷净革，横放，四分之三视角。浅奶褐色#c8a878卷成筒，表面洁净均匀，卷口的螺旋皮边齐整；用一根白色细绳扎住，绳结里夹着一片灰绿小草叶#8a9a80。干净柔和，有一点柔光。
subject.en: A roll of purified leather lying horizontally in three-quarter view. Pale cream-brown #c8a878 rolled into a tube, clean and even, the spiral edge at the end neat; tied with a thin white cord, a small grey-green herb leaf #8a9a80 tucked into the knot. Clean and soft, with a gentle sheen.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。浅奶褐的颜色与绳结里的灰绿草叶是辨识点；不带任何紫色或斑点。

subject.zh: 三片交叠的亚龙鳞，四分之三俯视。每片是泪滴形的厚硬鳞，暗橄榄绿#4a5a40，中央隆起一道脊棱，边缘锋利；鳞面有几道细细的暗紫纹#4a3a62。脊棱上一点冷亮高光。
subject.en: Three overlapping drake scales in three-quarter top-down view. Each is a thick, hard teardrop-shaped scale in dark olive green #4a5a40 with a raised central keel and sharp edges; a few fine dark purple lines #4a3a62 cross the surface. A cold bright highlight on the keels.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。三片泪滴形鳞与中央脊棱是辨识点；不画成整张鳞革卷，与原龙鳞单片区分。

subject.zh: 一张角兽皮，毛面朝外折起，四分之三俯视。短而密的黄褐兽毛#a07a48，背线有一道深褐长鬃；折边露出极厚的皮层，叠起来有四层；用一根五色编绳捆住。厚重，毛尖有一点光泽。
subject.en: A hornbeast hide folded fur side out, three-quarter top-down view. Short dense tawny fur #a07a48 with a dark brown mane along the back line; the folded edge shows an extremely thick skin stacked four layers deep; bound with a five-coloured braided cord. Heavy, with a little shine on the fur tips.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。极厚的四层折边与五色编绳是辨识点；与厚皮（深褐鬃毛、麻绳）区分。

subject.zh: 一卷鳞革，横放，四分之三视角。皮面铺满青铜绿的细鳞#6a7a50，像细密的鱼鳞排列，卷口露出浅褐的革底；用一根皮绳扎住。鳞面有一层柔和的金属光泽，几处鳞片反光。
subject.en: A roll of scale leather lying horizontally in three-quarter view. The outer face is covered in fine bronze-green scales #6a7a50 laid like dense fish scales, the rolled end showing the light brown leather backing; tied with a leather thong. A soft metallic sheen on the scales, with a few catching the light.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。卷起的细鳞皮料是辨识点；不带紫，与三片亚龙鳞和渊革区分。

subject.zh: 一张渊兽皮，折起，四分之三俯视。近黑的短毛#1e1a22，毛面泛暗紫光泽，翻出的肉面爬满暗紫纹路#4a3a62，折边一圈淡淡的暗雾；用黑绳捆住。毛尖有一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: An abyss-beast hide folded up, three-quarter top-down view. Short near-black fur #1e1a22 with a dark purple sheen; the turned-out flesh side is covered in creeping dark purple lines #4a3a62, and a faint dark haze rings the folded edge; bound with black cord. One or two single-pixel highlights on the fur tips.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。重澱：暗紫纹加边缘暗雾；是折起的毛皮，与卷起的渊革区分。

subject.zh: 一卷渊革，横放，四分之三视角。近黑色#1e1a22的鞣革卷成筒，表面光滑，泛着一层暗紫光泽，卷口露出整齐的螺旋皮边；用一根暗银细链扣住。光泽处有一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A roll of abyss leather lying horizontally in three-quarter view. Near-black tanned leather #1e1a22 rolled into a tube, smooth and carrying a dark purple sheen, the end showing a neat spiral edge; fastened with a thin dark silver chain. One or two single-pixel highlights where the sheen catches.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。光滑卷革加暗紫光泽，无毛无暗雾；与渊兽皮区分，暗银细链是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一片原龙鳞，四分之三俯视。盾牌大小的单片厚鳞，表面有一圈圈生长纹，颜色从深青#2a5a5a渐变到暗古铜#8a6a40，像珠母一样流转；边缘厚而圆钝。外缘一像素浅青光晕，带两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A single elder dragon scale in three-quarter top-down view. One thick shield-sized scale marked with concentric growth rings, its colour shifting from deep teal #2a5a5a to dark antique bronze #8a6a40 with a nacre-like play of colour; the rim is thick and rounded. A one-pixel pale teal halo on the outline and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。单片巨鳞加生长纹与青铜渐变是辨识点；与三片亚龙鳞区分，不用紫或门扉金。

subject.zh: 一团原羊毛，四分之三俯视。蓬松卷曲的米白毛团#e8e0d0，毛卷里夹着几根草屑，颜色略带土黄；中间用一根细麻绳松松捆成一束。柔软，没有光泽。
subject.en: A bundle of raw wool in three-quarter top-down view. A fluffy, curly off-white fleece #e8e0d0 with a few bits of straw caught in the curls and a slight earthy yellow tint; loosely tied into a bundle with thin hemp string round the middle. Soft, no sheen.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。蓬松原毛带草屑是辨识点；与细羊毛（梳顺盘圈）和角羊毛（粗长毛绺）区分。

subject.zh: 一小捆亚麻，斜放，中间用细绳扎住。几十根浅金黄的麻秆#c8b070并拢，顶端残留几朵小小的浅蓝花#7a9ad0与圆蒴果，根端剪齐。干爽，有一点稻草般的光泽。
subject.en: A small sheaf of flax lying at a slant, tied at the middle with thin string. Dozens of pale golden stalks #c8b070 bundled together, a few tiny pale blue flowers #7a9ad0 and round seed bolls left at the tops, the root ends cut square. Dry, with a slight straw-like sheen.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。浅金麻秆顶端的小蓝花是辨识点；与药草、风鬃草等绿色草束区分。

subject.zh: 一卷布，横放，四分之三视角。米褐色本色布#d8c8a8折叠后卷成筒，布面织纹粗而清楚，卷口露出几层布边，一角布头垂下；中间用麻绳扎一道结。朴素，没有光泽。
subject.en: A roll of cloth lying horizontally in three-quarter view. Undyed beige-brown cloth #d8c8a8 folded and rolled into a tube, its coarse weave clearly visible, several layers of edge showing at the end and one corner hanging loose; tied with a hemp cord at the middle. Plain, no sheen.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。基础布卷：米褐粗纹；与细布（近白方叠）和丝绸（柔光高光）区分。

subject.zh: 一卷细羊毛，四分之三俯视。梳顺的纯白毛条#f0ece0盘成一个整齐的椭圆圈，毛丝细而顺，没有杂屑；外面绕一根浅蓝细带打一个小结。柔软洁白，有一点细柔的光泽。
subject.en: A coil of fine wool in three-quarter top-down view. A combed pure white roving #f0ece0 wound into a neat oval coil, the fibres fine and smooth with no debris; a thin pale blue ribbon is wrapped around it in a small knot. Soft and white with a delicate sheen.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。梳顺盘成圈的白毛条是辨识点；与蓬松带草屑的原羊毛区分。

subject.zh: 一叠细布，四分之三俯视。近白色#ece6d8的细布折成整齐的方叠，层层布边对齐，织纹细得几乎看不见；用一根浅褐细带十字扎住，结打在正上方。干净平整，略有柔光。
subject.en: A stack of fine cloth in three-quarter top-down view. Near-white fine cloth #ece6d8 folded into a neat square stack with every edge aligned, the weave so fine it is almost invisible; tied crosswise with a thin light brown ribbon, knotted on top. Clean and flat with a slight soft sheen.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。近白、方叠而非卷筒是辨识点；不要画出丝绸那样的亮高光。

subject.zh: 一绞蛛丝，绕在一根短木棍上，四分之三俯视。灰白的细丝#c0c0c0一圈圈缠成纺锤形，表面有一道细细的丝光，丝头松出一缕垂下；木棍两端露出。轻而细。
subject.en: A skein of spider silk wound on a short wooden stick, three-quarter top-down view. Fine grey-white thread #c0c0c0 wrapped round and round into a spindle shape, a thin silky shine along it and one loose strand hanging from the end; both ends of the stick poke out. Light and fine.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。灰白丝绕在木棍上是辨识点；与澱蛛丝（更粗更暗带紫纹）区分。

subject.zh: 一卷丝绸，横放，四分之三视角。象牙白丝绸#f0e8d8卷成筒，布面光滑，斜着一道柔亮的高光像水波；卷口露出几层极薄的布边，一角滑落下垂；用一根细丝带扎住。
subject.en: A roll of silk lying horizontally in three-quarter view. Ivory silk #f0e8d8 rolled into a tube, its smooth face crossed diagonally by a soft bright highlight like a ripple of water; the end shows several very thin layers and one corner slips down loose; tied with a thin silk ribbon.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。一道柔亮的斜高光是辨识点；与本色布卷的粗纹和细布方叠区分。

subject.zh: 一绞林丝，四分之三俯视。浅绿银色的丝线#c8dcc0绕成一束松软的丝绞，一端还连着一枚椭圆的浅绿蚕茧；丝面泛一层细柔的光泽，用一根细草绳扎住。轻盈。
subject.en: A hank of forest silk in three-quarter top-down view. Pale green-silver thread #c8dcc0 looped into a soft loose hank, one end still attached to an oval pale green cocoon; a delicate sheen on the thread, tied with a thin grass cord. Light and airy.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。浅绿银丝绞连着一枚蚕茧是辨识点；与灰白蛛丝和林丝绸布卷区分。

subject.zh: 一卷林丝绸，横放，四分之三视角。浅绿银色#c8dcc0的丝绸卷成筒，布面一道柔光高光，布边织着一条细细的叶脉纹窄边；用一根浅褐细藤扎住。轻盈柔亮。
subject.en: A roll of forest silk cloth lying horizontally in three-quarter view. Pale green-silver silk #c8dcc0 rolled into a tube with a soft glossy highlight across it, a narrow border woven with a fine leaf-vein pattern along the edge; tied with a thin light brown vine. Light and lustrous.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。浅绿银色与叶脉纹窄边是辨识点；与象牙白丝绸区分，不加金色。

subject.zh: 一枚夜纱蛾茧，四分之三俯视。椭圆的茧是蓝黑色#2a2e40，半透明，茧上抽出一缕极细的暗丝，绕成旁边一小团丝球；丝面泛幽暗的蓝光泽。茧顶有一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A nightgauze moth cocoon in three-quarter top-down view. An oval, semi-translucent blue-black cocoon #2a2e40 with one very fine dark thread drawn out of it and wound into a small ball beside it; the thread has a dim blue sheen. One or two single-pixel highlights on top of the cocoon.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。蓝黑半透明的茧与抽出的丝球是辨识点；颜色是蓝黑不是紫，与林丝区分。

subject.zh: 一叠夜纱，四分之三俯视。半暗的蓝黑薄纱#2a2e40松松折成三层，纱薄而透，叠合处颜色更深，单层处隐约透光；用一根暗银细线扎住。纱面有一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A folded length of nightgauze in three-quarter top-down view. Dim blue-black gauze #2a2e40 loosely folded in three layers, thin and sheer, darker where the layers overlap and faintly letting light through where single; tied with a thin dark silver thread. One or two single-pixel highlights on the gauze.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。薄而透、叠层深浅不同是辨识点；不是厚布卷，蓝黑不用紫。

subject.zh: 一片穹纱，四分之三俯视。极薄的灰白纱#c8ccd8松松折起，几乎透明，纱面散着几粒星点般的亮斑；边缘轻飘，像要散成雾；用一根银白细线扎住。外缘一像素淡银光晕。
subject.en: A piece of vault gauze in three-quarter top-down view. Extremely thin grey-white gauze #c8ccd8 loosely folded and almost transparent, a few star-like bright flecks scattered across it; the edges drift as if about to dissolve into mist; tied with a thin silver-white thread. A one-pixel faint silver halo on the outline.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。灰白极薄纱上的星点亮斑是辨识点；与夜纱的蓝黑区分，不用紫或金。

subject.zh: 一小簇石英，四分之三俯视。两三根乳白半透明的六棱晶柱#e4e8ea从一小块灰岩上斜伸出来，晶尖呈尖锥形，晶身有乳白的云絮；不发光，只有晶面一点小高光。
subject.en: A small cluster of quartz in three-quarter top-down view. Two or three milky, semi-translucent hexagonal crystal columns #e4e8ea jut at angles from a small grey rock, their tips pointed, cloudy milky wisps inside. No glow, just a small highlight on one face.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。乳白六棱晶柱长在岩块上；不能画成浅青魔晶，也不发光。

subject.zh: 一块琥珀，四分之三俯视。圆润不规则的块状，蜂蜜橙色#c8782a，半透明，中心比边缘亮一阶，表面打磨光滑；里面清澈没有杂物。左上一个温暖的小高光。
subject.en: A piece of amber in three-quarter top-down view. A rounded irregular lump of honey-orange #c8782a, semi-translucent and one shade brighter in the centre than at the edges, polished smooth; clear inside with no inclusions. A warm small highlight at the upper left.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。纯净无杂物的蜂蜜橙块是基准；与北境琥珀（封着虫）和林琥珀（带光点）区分。

subject.zh: 一块黑曜石，四分之三俯视。锋利的黑色玻璃质碎块#1e1c22，断面是一圈圈贝壳状的弧纹，刃口锋利；表面像玻璃一样反出一道冷灰蓝的高光#7a8090。
subject.en: A piece of obsidian in three-quarter top-down view. A sharp black glassy fragment #1e1c22 whose broken face shows rings of shell-like conchoidal ripples and a keen edge; the surface throws back a glassy cold blue-grey highlight #7a8090.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。贝壳状弧纹断面与玻璃高光是辨识点；与墨晶（短钝棱柱）和渊晶（细长尖刺）区分。

subject.zh: 一块火玉，四分之三俯视。粗磨的半透明玉石块，红橙色#d04a2a，内里有几缕像火苗一样向上卷的亮橙纹#f0a040；表面温润，有一个暖色的小高光。
subject.en: A piece of fire jade in three-quarter top-down view. A roughly polished semi-translucent jade block in red-orange #d04a2a, with a few bright orange streaks #f0a040 curling upward inside like flames; the surface is smooth and mellow with one warm small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。内里向上卷的火苗纹是辨识点；是玉石不是晶体，与琥珀、炉心金区分。

subject.zh: 一颗星眼石，四分之三俯视。圆凸面的宝石，深蓝黑色#1a2440，中央一圈浅蓝的虹彩环像瞳孔，环心一个亮星点；石面光滑，有一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A star-eye stone in three-quarter top-down view. A domed cabochon gem in deep blue-black #1a2440, with a ring of pale blue iridescence in the centre like an iris and a bright star point at its heart; the surface is smooth with one or two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。像眼睛的虹彩环与环心星点是辨识点；与黑曜石、墨晶区分，不用紫。

subject.zh: 一根门晶，四分之三俯视。半透明的棱晶，顶端天然长成拱门形的晶面，晶内透出门扉金#f0d890的柔光；根部嵌在一块灰黑门址石里，根上缠着几道暗紫纹#4a3a62与淡淡暗雾。外缘一像素淡金光晕。
subject.en: A gate crystal in three-quarter top-down view. A semi-translucent prism whose tip has grown naturally into an arched doorway-shaped face, a soft door-gold #f0d890 light shining within; its base is embedded in a grey-black chunk of gate-site stone, wrapped in a few dark purple lines #4a3a62 and a faint dark haze. A one-pixel pale gold halo on the outline.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。拱门形晶面与门扉金内光是辨识点；暗紫只在根部；与魔晶的浅青区分。

subject.zh: 一小撮灰色碎晶，四分之三俯视。四五粒指甲大小的碎片堆在一起，浑浊灰#8a8a90，半透不透，每粒里面隐约一缕澱紫#4a3a62；断口锋利。只有一点哑光小高光，不发光。
subject.en: A small pinch of grey crystal shards in three-quarter top-down view. Four or five fingernail-sized fragments heaped together, cloudy grey #8a8a90 and barely translucent, each with a faint wisp of dian purple #4a3a62 inside; sharp broken edges. Only a dull small highlight, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。碎片一小撮、浑浊灰带紫芯；与魔晶碎（透明浅青）同形不同色，必须区分。

subject.zh: 一小撮魔晶碎，四分之三俯视。四五粒指甲大小的碎片堆在一起，透明浅青#a8e8e8，每粒里有一个小小的亮心；断口锋利，晶面清澈。一个清亮的小高光。
subject.en: A small pinch of refined crystal shards in three-quarter top-down view. Four or five fingernail-sized fragments heaped together, clear pale cyan #a8e8e8, each with a tiny bright core; sharp broken edges and limpid faces. One clear bright small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。透明浅青的碎片小堆，和灰色碎晶同形；绝不能带紫或浑浊。

subject.zh: 一枚小晶（灰），四分之三俯视。拇指大小的单根六棱晶，浑浊灰#8a8a90，晶身磨砂发闷，中心有一缕澱紫芯#4a3a62；晶尖尖锐。只有一点哑光小高光。
subject.en: A small grey crystal in three-quarter top-down view. A single thumb-sized hexagonal crystal, cloudy grey #8a8a90 with a frosted, dull body and a wisp of dian purple #4a3a62 at its core; a sharp point. Only a dull small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。拇指大单晶、浑浊灰带紫芯；与透明浅青的小晶同形，只换颜色与透明度。

subject.zh: 一枚小晶，四分之三俯视。拇指大小的单根六棱晶，透明浅青#a8e8e8，晶身清澈，中心一点亮心；晶尖尖锐，晶面一道清亮的小高光。
subject.en: A small refined crystal in three-quarter top-down view. A single thumb-sized hexagonal crystal, clear pale cyan #a8e8e8 and limpid, with a bright point at its core; a sharp tip and one clean bright small highlight on a face.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。拇指大透明浅青单晶，带一点亮心；不带紫，与灰色小晶同形。

subject.zh: 一枚中晶（灰），四分之三俯视。鸡蛋大小的粗壮棱晶，两端尖，浑浊灰#8a8a90，表面带磨砂与细裂，晶心一团较浓的澱紫芯#4a3a62；一点哑光小高光。
subject.en: A medium grey crystal in three-quarter top-down view. A stout egg-sized prism pointed at both ends, cloudy grey #8a8a90 with a frosted, finely cracked surface and a denser knot of dian purple #4a3a62 at its core; one dull small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。鸡蛋大的双尖棱晶，比小晶粗大；浑浊灰与紫芯，与透明中晶同形。

subject.zh: 一枚中晶，四分之三俯视。鸡蛋大小的粗壮棱晶，两端尖，透明浅青#a8e8e8，晶面平整清澈，中心一颗明显的亮心，透出淡淡浅青光；一道清亮小高光。
subject.en: A medium refined crystal in three-quarter top-down view. A stout egg-sized prism pointed at both ends, clear pale cyan #a8e8e8 with flat limpid faces and a distinct bright core giving off a faint pale cyan light; one clean bright small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。鸡蛋大透明浅青棱晶，亮心比小晶更明显；不带紫，与灰中晶同形。

subject.zh: 一簇大晶（灰），四分之三俯视。拳头大小的晶簇，三四根粗棱晶从同一个根部长出，浑浊灰#8a8a90，晶心是浓重的澱紫芯#4a3a62，根部边缘一圈淡淡的暗雾。一点哑光小高光。
subject.en: A large grey crystal cluster in three-quarter top-down view. A fist-sized cluster of three or four thick prisms growing from one base, cloudy grey #8a8a90 with heavy dian purple cores #4a3a62, a faint dark haze around the edge of the base. One dull small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。拳头大晶簇，紫芯最浓并带淡暗雾；与透明浅青的大晶同形。

subject.zh: 一簇大晶，四分之三俯视。拳头大小的晶簇，三四根粗棱晶从同一个根部长出，透明浅青#a8e8e8，每根都有亮心，整簇透出柔和的浅青光；晶尖一道清亮高光。
subject.en: A large refined crystal cluster in three-quarter top-down view. A fist-sized cluster of three or four thick prisms growing from one base, clear pale cyan #a8e8e8, each with a bright core, the whole cluster giving off a soft pale cyan light; a clean bright highlight on the tips.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。拳头大透明浅青晶簇；不带紫与暗雾，与灰大晶同形。

subject.zh: 一枚王晶（灰），四分之三俯视。冠状的大棱晶，一根主晶周围环立一圈短尖晶，像一顶冠；浑浊灰#8a8a90，内里一大团澱紫芯#4a3a62，边缘淡淡暗雾；尖上一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A grey king crystal in three-quarter top-down view. A large crown-like crystal: one main prism ringed by a circle of short spikes like a crown; cloudy grey #8a8a90 with a large mass of dian purple #4a3a62 inside and a faint dark haze at the edges; one or two single-pixel highlights on the points.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。冠状大棱晶，灰浊带浓紫芯与暗雾；与透明王晶同形，与冕晶的白瓷冠区分。

subject.zh: 一枚王晶，四分之三俯视。冠状的大棱晶，一根主晶周围环立一圈短尖晶，像一顶冠；透明浅青#a8e8e8，主晶中心一颗耀眼的亮心，整体透出浅青光，尖上一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A refined king crystal in three-quarter top-down view. A large crown-like crystal: one main prism ringed by a circle of short spikes like a crown; clear pale cyan #a8e8e8 with a dazzling bright core in the main prism, the whole piece glowing pale cyan, one or two single-pixel highlights on the points.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。冠状透明浅青大晶，亮心最亮；不带紫，与灰王晶同形。

subject.zh: 一枚迷宫核，四分之三俯视。拳头大的球形晶核，外面裹着两三层半剥开的浑浊灰晶壳#8a8a90，壳缝里露出浓重的澱紫芯#4a3a62，外缘一圈淡暗雾。表面有一两个单像素亮点，外缘一像素暗光晕。
subject.en: A labyrinth core in three-quarter top-down view. A fist-sized spherical crystal core wrapped in two or three half-peeled layers of cloudy grey crystal shell #8a8a90, a heavy dian purple core #4a3a62 showing through the gaps, a faint dark haze around the edge. One or two single-pixel highlights on the surface and a one-pixel dark halo on the outline.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。层层晶壳包着的球形核是辨识点，不是棱晶；未净炼，灰壳紫芯。

subject.zh: 一枚渊晶，四分之三俯视。一根细长锋利的尖晶，像一枚长刺，黑紫色#2a2034，晶心透出暗紫#4a3a62的幽光，晶面有几道更暗的棱；尖端一两个单像素亮点，外缘一像素暗紫光晕。
subject.en: An abyss crystal in three-quarter top-down view. A long slender razor-sharp spike crystal like a thorn, black-purple #2a2034, a dim dark purple #4a3a62 glow showing from its core and a few darker ridges along its faces; one or two single-pixel highlights at the tip and a one-pixel dark purple halo on the outline.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。细长黑紫尖刺是辨识点；与黑曜石碎块、墨晶区分，不发白光。

subject.zh: 三枚灰晶堆成一小堆，四分之三俯视。每枚都是拇指大小的单棱晶，浑浊灰#8a8a90，晶心一缕澱紫#4a3a62；底下垫着一小块铅灰色的方垫片#5a5c64。哑光，不发光。
subject.en: Three grey crystals in a small heap, three-quarter top-down view. Each is a thumb-sized single prism in cloudy grey #8a8a90 with a wisp of dian purple #4a3a62 at its core; they rest on a small square lead-grey pad #5a5c64. Matte, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。城建库存的灰晶：三枚一堆加铅灰垫片；与单枚灰小晶和灰碎晶区分。

subject.zh: 三枚魔晶堆成一小堆，四分之三俯视。每枚都是拇指大小的透明浅青单棱晶#a8e8e8，各有一点亮心，彼此映出浅青光；底下垫着一小块浅木托片#b08a60。一个清亮的小高光。
subject.en: Three refined crystals in a small heap, three-quarter top-down view. Each is a thumb-sized clear pale cyan single prism #a8e8e8 with its own bright point, the three casting pale cyan light on one another; they rest on a small light wooden tray piece #b08a60. One clean bright small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。城建库存的魔晶：三枚一堆加木托片；与单枚小晶和魔晶碎区分，不带紫。

subject.zh: 一小撮瓷骨屑，四分之三俯视。几片薄而苍白的碎片，像打碎的白瓷#f4f0e8，边缘锋利微卷，断面细白，其中一片边上留着一线细细的浅金#d8b860；釉面一点柔光。通体纯净，只有白与浅金。
subject.en: A small pinch of porcelain bone flakes in three-quarter top-down view. A few thin, pale fragments like broken white porcelain #f4f0e8, their edges sharp and slightly curled, the broken faces fine and white, one flake edged with a thin line of pale gold #d8b860; a soft glaze sheen. Entirely pure, white and pale gold only.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。纯白瓷碎片加一线浅金，严禁紫色或暗雾；与骨片的灰黄碎骨区分。

subject.zh: 一枚白瓷心，四分之三俯视。拳头大的圆润瓷核，略呈钟形，通体白瓷#f4f0e8，釉面光滑，腰间箍着一道细细的浅金环#d8b860；顶上一个明亮的小高光。纯净洁白，只有白与浅金。
subject.en: A white porcelain heart in three-quarter top-down view. A fist-sized rounded porcelain core, slightly bell-shaped, white porcelain #f4f0e8 all over with a smooth glaze and a thin pale gold band #d8b860 around its waist; a bright small highlight on top. Pure white, white and pale gold only.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。钟形白瓷核加腰间金环是辨识点；只有白与金，严禁紫色。

subject.zh: 一顶冕晶，四分之三俯视。一圈乳白不透明的瓷质晶尖围成冠冕，晶尖长短相间，底部连着一条浅金冠带#d8b860；釉面明亮光洁，晶尖有一两个单像素亮点。通体只有纯白与浅金两色。
subject.en: A coronet crystal in three-quarter top-down view. A ring of opaque milky porcelain-like crystal spikes of alternating length forming a crown, joined at the base by a pale gold band #d8b860; the glaze is bright and spotless, with one or two single-pixel highlights on the spikes. Pure white and pale gold only.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。白瓷晶尖围成的圆冠是辨识点；与王晶的浅青冠状晶区分，严禁紫色。

subject.zh: 一小撮赤角屑，四分之三俯视。几块碎裂的兽角碎片，赤黑色，外层暗红#6a1a1a，断面发黑#2a1414，带粗糙的纵纹和锋利的裂口。粗粝哑光，不发光。
subject.en: A small pinch of red horn chips in three-quarter top-down view. A few broken fragments of beast horn, red-black, dark red #6a1a1a on the outside and blackened #2a1414 on the broken faces, with rough lengthwise grain and sharp splits. Coarse and matte, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。赤黑碎角一小撮是辨识点；不加紫光，与凝血角整根湿角区分。

subject.zh: 一根凝血角，斜放，角根在左下、角尖在右上。弯曲的完整兽角，暗红色#6a1820，表面永远湿润发亮，角尖挂着一滴暗红液珠；角根粗糙带环纹。湿光是唯一的光泽。
subject.en: A clotblood horn lying at a slant, base at lower left and tip at upper right. A whole curved beast horn in dark red #6a1820, its surface perpetually wet and glistening, a single dark red droplet hanging from the tip; the base is rough and ringed. The wet shine is its only lustre.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。整根暗红湿角加角尖液珠是辨识点；比赤角屑完整得多，不发光。图上不能出现紫色。

subject.zh: 一枚战魂核，四分之三俯视。拳头大的卵形核，深赤红#8a2028，表面盘着鼓起的粗脉络，脉络里透出亮红#c84040，核身一圈凸棱像在搏动；表面光亮，有一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A war-soul core in three-quarter top-down view. A fist-sized egg-shaped core in deep crimson #8a2028, its surface wound with swollen thick veins that show bright red #c84040 within, a raised ring around its body as if mid-pulse; glossy, with one or two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。鼓起的脉络与搏动凸棱是辨识点；红色系，不加紫；与迷宫核的灰壳区分。

subject.zh: 一小撮拟金屑，四分之三俯视。几片揉皱的薄金箔，颜色是偏绿的黄铜色#b89a40，比真金暗，边缘卷起起毛，有一两片背面露出灰色底；只有一点浮浅的小高光。
subject.en: A small pinch of mimic-gold flakes in three-quarter top-down view. A few crumpled sheets of thin foil in a greenish brass colour #b89a40, duller than real gold, their edges curled and frayed, one or two showing a grey backing; just a shallow small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。揉皱的假金箔，颜色比真金偏绿偏暗；与千金舌的饱满金色区分。

subject.zh: 一枚契胃石，四分之三俯视。鹅卵大的光滑胃石，浅灰褐色#a89a80，磨得圆润发亮，表面布满细细的平行横纹与交叉线，像一张划好格子的契纸；一个柔和的小高光。
subject.en: A pact gastrolith in three-quarter top-down view. A smooth goose-egg-sized stomach stone in pale grey-brown #a89a80, worn round and glossy, its surface covered in fine parallel lines and cross lines like a ruled contract sheet; one soft small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。光滑卵石上的格状细纹是辨识点；纹只是线，不写字，不发光。

subject.zh: 一枚千金舌，四分之三俯视。一块舌形的金色结晶#d8a838，前端微微卷起，像正要开口，表面有细密的颗粒纹；晶面饱满光亮，有一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A thousand-gold tongue in three-quarter top-down view. A tongue-shaped golden crystal #d8a838, its front end curling up slightly as if about to speak, the surface finely granular; full and lustrous, with one or two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。舌形与前端微卷是辨识点；金色饱满，与拟金屑的暗绿假金区分。图上不能出现紫色。

subject.zh: 一小撮灰孢，四分之三俯视。一小堆细腻的灰色孢子粉#8a8a88堆成小丘，顶上飘起一缕细细的粉尘，堆边散着几颗稍大的灰白孢粒；粉面干燥，没有光泽。
subject.en: A small pinch of grey spores in three-quarter top-down view. A little mound of fine grey spore powder #8a8a88 with a thin wisp of dust drifting up from its top and a few slightly larger grey-white spore grains scattered round the edge; dry and matte.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。一小堆灰粉加上飘的粉尘是辨识点；不加紫光，与灰烬精华的余烬区分。

subject.zh: 一段疯长芯，四分之三俯视。一截浅黄褐的木芯#c8b088，两端和侧面冒出鲜绿的嫩芽与卷须#7ac060，卷须弯曲盘绕，像还在往外长；木面湿润。卷须上一点鲜亮高光。
subject.en: A rampant-growth core in three-quarter top-down view. A length of pale yellow-brown wood core #c8b088 with bright green shoots and tendrils #7ac060 bursting from both ends and the sides, the tendrils coiling as if still growing; the wood is damp. A fresh bright highlight on the tendrils.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。冒芽卷须的木芯是辨识点；鲜绿生机，与世界树落枝的银白木与小芽区分。

subject.zh: 一顶腐冠，四分之三俯视。藤枝编成的圆冠，左半边开满粉白小花#f0d0d8，右半边枯成褐黑#4a3a28，长着灰白霉斑与垂落的腐叶；花瓣带一点露水光泽，有一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A rot crown in three-quarter top-down view. A round crown woven of vines, its left half covered in small pink-white flowers #f0d0d8 and its right half withered to brown-black #4a3a28 with grey-white mould spots and drooping rotten leaves; the petals have a little dewy shine with one or two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。一半开花一半腐烂的对比是辨识点；腐烂用褐黑与霉白，不用紫。

subject.zh: 一小撮残页屑，四分之三俯视。几片指甲大小的灰白纸屑#c8c4b8，边缘焦卷，纸面带着细碎的墨点与短线，像残缺的笔画但不成字；纸屑干脆易碎，没有光泽。
subject.en: A small pinch of page scraps in three-quarter top-down view. A few fingernail-sized grey-white paper flakes #c8c4b8 with scorched curled edges, flecked with tiny ink dots and short strokes like broken pen marks that never form a letter; brittle and matte.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。灰纸屑上的抽象墨点短线是辨识点，绝不能画成可读文字；与灰烬残页的半张整页区分。

subject.zh: 一簇墨晶，四分之三俯视。三根短钝的六棱晶柱，墨黑色#1a1a24，晶内有一缕像墨汁在水中化开的深蓝黑纹#2a3050，表面湿亮像未干的墨；一道冷亮小高光。
subject.en: A cluster of ink crystal in three-quarter top-down view. Three short blunt hexagonal columns in ink black #1a1a24, each holding a deep blue-black swirl #2a3050 like ink spreading in water, the surface wet-looking like fresh ink; one cold bright small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。短钝棱柱与晶内化开的墨纹是辨识点；与黑曜石碎块、渊晶尖刺区分。图上不能出现紫色。

subject.zh: 一页录魂页，四分之三俯视。一张泛黄的旧纸页#e0d4b8，一角自己翘起翻卷，像正在翻页；纸面满是极小的点线纹，排成整齐的行，但不是字；纸边有一点柔和的光泽和一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A soul-record page in three-quarter top-down view. A single yellowed old sheet #e0d4b8 with one corner lifting and curling by itself as if mid-turn; the page is filled with minute dot-and-line patterns in neat rows that are not writing; a soft sheen at the edge and one or two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。自己翘起的翻页姿态是辨识点；点线纹不能像文字；与灰烬残页的焦边区分。

subject.zh: 一小撮空隙骨，四分之三俯视。三四块灰白的碎骨片#d8d0c0，每块都穿着一个小小的拱门形空洞，洞边光滑，透过洞能看到后面；骨面干燥，没有光泽。
subject.en: A small pinch of hollow bone in three-quarter top-down view. Three or four grey-white bone chips #d8d0c0, each pierced by a small arched doorway-shaped hole with smooth edges that you can see straight through; the bone is dry and matte.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。碎骨上的拱门形空洞是辨识点；不发光、不加门扉金，与普通骨片区分。

subject.zh: 一块门痕骨，四分之三俯视。一块完整的扁平长骨，灰白色#d8d0c0，骨面天然生着一圈凹陷的纹，形状像一个拱门的门框，框内骨质略暗；骨两端圆钝。一个小高光，不发光。
subject.en: A door-marked bone in three-quarter top-down view. A whole flat long bone in grey-white #d8d0c0, its surface naturally grooved with a sunken line shaped like an arched doorframe, the bone inside the frame slightly darker; both ends rounded. One small highlight, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。骨面上门框形的凹纹是辨识点；比空隙骨大而完整，不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 一枚隙心，四分之三俯视。拳头大的中空心形骨壳，乳白骨色#e0d8c8，表面光滑有光泽，正面开着一个口，里面是深邃的暗处，几道浅色的气流细线从口里旋出；有一两个单像素亮点。
subject.en: A rift heart in three-quarter top-down view. A fist-sized hollow heart-shaped shell of creamy bone #e0d8c8, smooth and glossy, with an opening in front onto deep darkness inside, a few pale thin lines of moving air swirling out of the mouth; one or two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。中空心形壳与口里旋出的风线是辨识点；内部是暗处不是紫光。

subject.zh: 一枚弯如新月的兽牙，斜放，牙根在左下、牙尖在右上；牙根粗钝留一截断口，内弧有一道纵向浅沟。牙身是普通野兽的象牙色#e8dcc0，牙根泛黄#c8b088，牙尖略磨圆。个头小，无纹，无光。
subject.en: A single crescent-curved beast fang lying on the diagonal, root at lower left and tip at upper right; the thick, blunt root ends in a broken edge, and a shallow groove runs along the inner curve. Ordinary ivory #e8dcc0 with a yellowed root #c8b088 and a slightly worn tip. Small, no markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。牙爪五阶同形（新月弯牙加内弧纵沟）；T1 只用自然象牙色，个头最小，不加任何紫。

subject.zh: 一枚弯如新月的兽牙，斜放，牙根在左下、牙尖在右上；牙根粗钝留一截断口，内弧有一道纵向浅沟。比兽牙大一圈、更粗更硬，颜色加深成蜡黄#d8c090，牙根褐黄#a88a58，牙尖锋利，带几道细磨痕。无纹，无光。
subject.en: The same crescent-curved fang on the diagonal, root at lower left and tip at upper right, with the blunt broken root and the shallow groove along the inner curve. A size larger, thicker and harder than the T1 fang, deepened to waxy yellow #d8c090 with a brown-yellow root #a88a58, a sharp tip and a few fine scuff lines. No markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。与T1同形，只是更大、蜡黄更深、牙尖更利；仍是自然色，不能出现紫纹。

subject.zh: 一枚弯如新月的兽牙，斜放，牙根在左下、牙尖在右上；牙根粗钝留一截断口，内弧有一道纵向浅沟。牙身转为灰白#c8beb0，从牙根向牙尖爬着三四道细细的暗紫纹#4a3a62，牙尖锋利。
subject.en: The same crescent-curved fang on the diagonal, root at lower left and tip at upper right, with the blunt broken root and the shallow groove along the inner curve. The fang has turned grey-white #c8beb0, and three or four thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep from the root toward the sharp tip.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。异兽起点：暗紫纹只三四道且细，底色灰白；外形必须与T1、T2的弯牙一致。

subject.zh: 一枚弯如新月的兽牙，斜放，牙根在左下、牙尖在右上；牙根粗钝留一截断口，内弧有一道纵向浅沟。牙身暗灰褐#7a7068，暗紫纹#4a3a62密密交织，几乎布满牙面，牙尖锋利发暗，不发光。
subject.en: The same crescent-curved fang on the diagonal, root at lower left and tip at upper right, with the blunt broken root and the shallow groove along the inner curve. Dark grey-brown #7a7068, densely laced with dark purple veins #4a3a62 that nearly cover the surface; the sharp tip is dull and dark, with no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。比T3纹更密、底色更深，但还不是近黑；不发光，与T5区分。

subject.zh: 一枚弯如新月的兽牙，斜放，牙根在左下、牙尖在右上；牙根粗钝留一截断口，内弧有一道纵向浅沟。牙身近黑#221e28，暗紫纹透出微光，外缘一圈淡淡的暗紫光，牙尖一个单像素亮点。
subject.en: The same crescent-curved fang on the diagonal, root at lower left and tip at upper right, with the blunt broken root and the shallow groove along the inner curve. Near-black #221e28, its veins glowing faintly dark purple #4a3a62, a thin dark purple glow along the outline, and one single-pixel bright point at the tip.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。近黑加暗紫微光是最高阶标志；外形仍是同一枚新月弯牙，不要加大成獠牙或角。

subject.zh: 一根两端膨大的短腿骨，斜放，左下端是圆球状关节头、右上端是双瘤关节，骨干中段略细。骨色米黄#e0d6bc，表面粗糙带几处浅褐斑，骨干一道浅裂纹。个头小，无纹，无光。
subject.en: A short limb bone swollen at both ends, lying on the diagonal, a ball-shaped joint at lower left and a double-knobbed joint at upper right, the shaft slightly narrower in the middle. Pale bone yellow #e0d6bc, rough, with a few light brown stains and one shallow crack along the shaft. Small, no markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。骨五阶同形（球头加双瘤的短腿骨）；T1 自然米黄，与骨白颜料的碎骨片区分。

subject.zh: 一根两端膨大的短腿骨，斜放，左下端是圆球状关节头、右上端是双瘤关节，骨干中段略细。比兽骨粗一圈、更致密，颜色深成旧象牙黄#cfc09a，表面光滑紧实，关节头磨出一点亮光。无纹。
subject.en: The same short limb bone on the diagonal, ball joint at lower left and double-knobbed joint at upper right, narrower at mid-shaft. Thicker and denser than the T1 bone, deepened to old ivory yellow #cfc09a, its surface smooth and tight, the joint heads worn to a slight shine. No markings.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。与T1同形，更粗更密、颜色更深；仍是自然骨色，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一根两端膨大的短腿骨，斜放，左下端是圆球状关节头、右上端是双瘤关节，骨干中段略细。骨色转为灰白#c4beb4，骨干上爬着几道细细的暗紫纹#4a3a62，像细裂缝一样蔓延。
subject.en: The same short limb bone on the diagonal, ball joint at lower left and double-knobbed joint at upper right, narrower at mid-shaft. Turned grey-white #c4beb4, with a few thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 spreading along the shaft like hairline cracks.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。异兽起点：几道细紫纹，底色灰白；外形与T1、T2的腿骨一致。

subject.zh: 一根两端膨大的短腿骨，斜放，左下端是圆球状关节头、右上端是双瘤关节，骨干中段略细。骨色暗灰#7a7478，暗紫纹#4a3a62密密交织，从关节头一路爬满骨干，不发光。
subject.en: The same short limb bone on the diagonal, ball joint at lower left and double-knobbed joint at upper right, narrower at mid-shaft. Dark grey #7a7478, densely laced with dark purple veins #4a3a62 that run from joint to joint and cover the shaft; no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。纹比T3密、底色更深但不发光；与近黑发光的T5区分。

subject.zh: 一根两端膨大的短腿骨，斜放，左下端是圆球状关节头、右上端是双瘤关节，骨干中段略细。通体近黑#221e28，暗紫纹透出微光，外缘一圈淡淡的暗紫光，关节头一个单像素亮点。
subject.en: The same short limb bone on the diagonal, ball joint at lower left and double-knobbed joint at upper right, narrower at mid-shaft. Near-black all over #221e28, its veins glowing faintly dark purple #4a3a62, a thin dark purple glow along the outline, and one single-pixel bright point on a joint head.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。近黑加暗紫微光；仍是同一根短腿骨，不要加长成长骨或画成头骨。

subject.zh: 一片拱起的椭圆甲壳片，正面略带俯视，壳面三道横向生长棱，外缘一圈细锯齿。壳色是甲虫般的栗褐#8a6a40，边缘渐浅#b0905a，壳面哑光。个头小，无纹，无光。
subject.en: An arched oval carapace plate seen from the front and slightly above, three crosswise growth ridges across it and a rim of fine serrations. Beetle-like chestnut brown #8a6a40 fading lighter toward the rim #b0905a, with a matte surface. Small, no markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。甲壳五阶同形（三道生长棱加锯齿边）；T1 自然栗褐、哑光，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一片拱起的椭圆甲壳片，正面略带俯视，壳面三道横向生长棱，外缘一圈细锯齿。比甲片大一圈、更厚，颜色深成乌褐#5a3e24，壳面油亮，锯齿更硬更尖。无纹，无光。
subject.en: The same arched oval carapace plate seen from the front and slightly above, with three growth ridges and a serrated rim. A size larger and thicker than the T1 plate, deepened to dark umber #5a3e24 with an oily gloss, its serrations harder and sharper. No markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。与T1同形，更大更厚、乌褐油亮；仍是自然色，不要画成盾牌。

subject.zh: 一片拱起的椭圆甲壳片，正面略带俯视，壳面三道横向生长棱，外缘一圈细锯齿。壳色转为灰褐#7a7068，生长棱之间的沟里爬着细细的暗紫纹#4a3a62。
subject.en: The same arched oval carapace plate seen from the front and slightly above, with three growth ridges and a serrated rim. Turned grey-brown #7a7068, with thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 creeping along the grooves between the growth ridges.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。紫纹只沿棱沟走几道；不是晶体甲壳，不要加晶块或浅青光。

subject.zh: 一片拱起的椭圆甲壳片，正面略带俯视，壳面三道横向生长棱，外缘一圈细锯齿。壳色深灰#46424a，暗紫纹#4a3a62密布整个壳面，沿着生长棱交织成网，不发光。
subject.en: The same arched oval carapace plate seen from the front and slightly above, with three growth ridges and a serrated rim. Dark grey #46424a, dense dark purple veins #4a3a62 covering the whole plate and knotting into a net along the ridges; no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。紫纹织成网、底色深灰；不发光，与T5的近黑微光区分。

subject.zh: 一片拱起的椭圆甲壳片，正面略带俯视，壳面三道横向生长棱，外缘一圈细锯齿。通体近黑#221e28，暗紫纹透出微光，锯齿外缘一圈淡淡的暗紫光，壳顶一个单像素亮点。
subject.en: The same arched oval carapace plate seen from the front and slightly above, with three growth ridges and a serrated rim. Near-black all over #221e28, its veins glowing faintly dark purple #4a3a62, a thin dark purple glow along the serrated rim, and one single-pixel bright point at the crown.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。近黑加暗紫微光；壳片大小与T2相当，不要画成整只甲虫。

subject.zh: 一个梨形的半透明腺囊，上端收窄成一截短管，用细麻绳扎住，囊里装着液体，外皮光滑干净。囊皮淡黄绿#d0d8a0，透出浅琥珀色液体#c8a050，囊小而软，微微下坠。无纹，无光。
subject.en: A pear-shaped translucent gland sac narrowing at the top into a short duct tied off with thin hemp cord, liquid inside, its skin smooth and clean. Pale yellow-green skin #d0d8a0 showing light amber liquid #c8a050; small and soft, sagging slightly. No markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。腺囊五阶同形（梨形囊加扎绳短管）；画得干净，不要血迹；T1 是浅琥珀液。

subject.zh: 一个梨形的半透明腺囊，上端收窄成一截短管，用细麻绳扎住，外皮光滑干净。比腺大一圈、囊皮更厚更绷，黄绿#a0b040，里面是浓稠的暗黄绿毒液#7a8a20，囊面一道湿亮高光。无纹。
subject.en: The same pear-shaped translucent sac with its short duct tied off by thin hemp cord, smooth and clean. A size larger, its skin thicker and taut, yellow-green #a0b040 and holding thick dark yellow-green venom #7a8a20, with one wet highlight on the sac. No markings.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。毒腺：与T1同形，更大更绷，液体变成暗黄绿；仍不加紫，不像药瓶。

subject.zh: 一个梨形的半透明腺囊，上端收窄成一截短管，用细麻绳扎住，外皮光滑干净。囊皮转为灰绿#9aa088，像叶脉一样爬着几道细细的暗紫纹#4a3a62，里面的液体变得浑浊。
subject.en: The same pear-shaped translucent sac with its short duct tied off by thin hemp cord, smooth and clean. The skin has turned grey-green #9aa088, with a few thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 branching across it like leaf veins, and the liquid inside has gone cloudy.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。紫纹像叶脉分叉、只有几道；外形与T1、T2的梨形囊一致。

subject.zh: 一个梨形的半透明腺囊，上端收窄成一截短管，用细麻绳扎住，外皮光滑干净。囊皮暗灰绿#5a6050，暗紫纹#4a3a62密布成网，里面的液体已经发暗，不透光也不发光。
subject.en: The same pear-shaped sac with its short duct tied off by thin hemp cord, smooth and clean. Dark grey-green skin #5a6050 netted densely with dark purple veins #4a3a62, the liquid inside gone dark; it no longer lets light through and does not glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。囊已不透明、紫纹成网；不发光，与T5的暗紫微光区分。

subject.zh: 一个梨形的腺囊，上端收窄成一截短管，用细麻绳扎住，外皮光滑干净。囊皮近黑#221e28，里面的液体透出暗紫微光，外缘一圈淡淡的暗紫光，囊面一个单像素亮点。
subject.en: The same pear-shaped gland sac with its short duct tied off by thin hemp cord, smooth and clean. Near-black skin #221e28 with the liquid inside glowing faintly dark purple #4a3a62, a thin dark purple glow along the outline, and one single-pixel bright point on the sac.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。近黑囊里透暗紫微光；扎绳短管要保留，与T1到T4同形。

subject.zh: 一只小玻璃球瓶，圆肚细短颈，口塞一颗小木珠并封一点蜡；瓶里悬着一团缓缓旋动的雾状精华，不沉底。雾很稀薄，近乎透明的灰白#e0e0d8，只占瓶的一半。无纹，无光。
subject.en: A small round glass globe flask with a short narrow neck, stoppered with a little wooden bead sealed with a dab of wax; inside hangs a slowly swirling cloud of essence that does not settle. The mist is thin, a near-transparent grey-white #e0e0d8 filling only half the globe. No markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。精华五阶同一只球瓶，内容是悬浮的雾不是液体；与药水瓶区分。

subject.zh: 一只小玻璃球瓶，圆肚细短颈，口塞一颗小木珠并封一点蜡；瓶里悬着一团缓缓旋动的雾状精华，不沉底。雾更浓更满，乳灰色#b8bcc0，中心有一点稍亮的浅白芯。无纹。
subject.en: The same small glass globe flask with a wooden-bead stopper sealed with wax, a slowly swirling cloud of essence hanging inside without settling. The mist is denser and fuller, milky grey #b8bcc0, with a slightly brighter pale core at its center. No markings.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。比T1更浓、有浅白芯；不发光，不用晶的浅青色。

subject.zh: 一只小玻璃球瓶，圆肚细短颈，口塞一颗小木珠并封一点蜡；瓶里悬着一团缓缓旋动的雾状精华，不沉底。浓稠的灰雾#8a8890充满整瓶，雾里缠着几缕细细的暗紫丝#4a3a62。
subject.en: The same small glass globe flask with a wooden-bead stopper sealed with wax, a slowly swirling cloud of essence hanging inside without settling. Thick grey mist #8a8890 fills the whole globe, with a few thin dark purple threads #4a3a62 tangled through it.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。灰雾满瓶、只有几缕细紫丝；瓶子与T1、T2完全一样。

subject.zh: 一只小玻璃球瓶，圆肚细短颈，口塞一颗小木珠并封一点蜡；瓶里悬着一团缓缓旋动的雾状精华，不沉底。深灰#4a4650的浓雾，暗紫丝#4a3a62密密缠绕，瓶壁也蒙上一层暗色。
subject.en: The same small glass globe flask with a wooden-bead stopper sealed with wax, a slowly swirling cloud of essence hanging inside without settling. Dense dark grey mist #4a4650 wound thickly with dark purple threads #4a3a62, and the glass itself is dimmed by a dark film.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。紫丝密缠、瓶壁发暗；不发光，与T5区分。

subject.zh: 一只小玻璃球瓶，圆肚细短颈，口塞一颗小木珠并封一点蜡；瓶里悬着一团缓缓旋动的雾状精华，不沉底。近黑#221e28的浓雾透出暗紫微光，瓶身外缘一圈淡淡的暗紫光，一个单像素亮点。
subject.en: The same small glass globe flask with a wooden-bead stopper sealed with wax, a slowly swirling cloud of essence hanging inside without settling. Near-black mist #221e28 glowing faintly dark purple #4a3a62, a thin dark purple glow around the flask, and one single-pixel bright point.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。近黑雾加暗紫微光；光在瓶内雾里，瓶身外只一圈很淡的光。

subject.zh: 一个米褐粗布小包#d8c8a8，袋口松开向外翻卷，露出满满一小堆灰，系口的细绳垂在一侧。灰是细腻的浅灰#b0aca4，灰面平静，没有火星。无纹，无光。
subject.en: A small coarse beige cloth pouch #d8c8a8 with its mouth loosened and rolled outward, showing a full little heap of ash, the drawstring hanging to one side. The ash is fine and light grey #b0aca4, its surface still, with no embers. No markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。残灰五阶同一只布包，只换灰色；T1 浅灰平静，不画火星或烟。

subject.zh: 一个米褐粗布小包#d8c8a8，袋口松开向外翻卷，露出满满一小堆灰，系口的细绳垂在一侧。灰色更深更粗#8a867e，夹着几粒米白的碎骨屑，堆得更高。无纹，无光。
subject.en: The same small coarse beige cloth pouch #d8c8a8, its mouth rolled outward over a heap of ash, the drawstring hanging to one side. The ash is darker and coarser #8a867e, mixed with a few off-white bone flecks and heaped higher. No markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。骸灰：比T1深、夹碎骨屑；仍是自然灰色，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一个米褐粗布小包#d8c8a8，袋口松开向外翻卷，露出满满一小堆灰，系口的细绳垂在一侧。灰色偏冷#7a7880，灰面上浮着几道细细的暗紫丝纹#4a3a62。
subject.en: The same small coarse beige cloth pouch #d8c8a8, its mouth rolled outward over a heap of ash, the drawstring hanging to one side. The ash is a cooler grey #7a7880, with a few thin dark purple streaks #4a3a62 drifting over its surface.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。只在灰面上浮几道细紫丝；布包本身保持米褐，不染紫。

subject.zh: 一个米褐粗布小包#d8c8a8，袋口松开向外翻卷，露出满满一小堆灰，系口的细绳垂在一侧。深灰#4a4850的灰，暗紫纹#4a3a62密布灰面，布包口也染上一圈灰暗。
subject.en: The same small coarse beige cloth pouch #d8c8a8, its mouth rolled outward over a heap of ash, the drawstring hanging to one side. The ash is dark grey #4a4850 with dense dark purple streaks #4a3a62 over it, and the rim of the pouch is stained a dull grey.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。灰暗、紫纹密，袋口染灰；不发光，与T5区分。

subject.zh: 一个米褐粗布小包#d8c8a8，袋口松开向外翻卷，露出满满一小堆灰，系口的细绳垂在一侧。近黑#221e28的灰透出暗紫微光，灰堆外缘一圈淡淡的暗紫光，一个单像素亮点。
subject.en: The same small coarse beige cloth pouch #d8c8a8, its mouth rolled outward over a heap of ash, the drawstring hanging to one side. Near-black ash #221e28 glowing faintly dark purple #4a3a62, a thin dark purple glow around the heap, and one single-pixel bright point.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。近黑灰加暗紫微光；布包形状与T1一致，光只在灰上。

subject.zh: 一根长飞羽，斜放，羽根在左下、羽尖在右上，羽片略向一侧弯，近羽尖有两道深色横斑。羽色灰褐#8a7a68，横斑深褐，羽轴米白，羽片边缘有一处小分叉。无纹，无光。
subject.en: A long flight feather lying on the diagonal, quill at lower left and tip at upper right, the vane curving slightly to one side with two dark crossbars near the tip. Grey-brown #8a7a68 with dark brown bars and an off-white shaft, one small split in the vane edge. No markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。羽五阶同形（长飞羽加两道横斑）；T1 自然灰褐，羽片有一处小分叉。

subject.zh: 一根长飞羽，斜放，羽根在左下、羽尖在右上，羽片略向一侧弯，近羽尖有两道深色横斑。比羽更长更挺，羽轴粗硬，羽色深成暗褐#5e4632，横斑近黑褐，羽片紧密不分叉，一道油亮高光。
subject.en: The same long flight feather on the diagonal, quill at lower left and tip at upper right, curving slightly with two dark crossbars near the tip. Longer and stiffer than T1 with a thick hard shaft, deepened to dark brown #5e4632 with near-black bars, the vane tight and unsplit, one oily highlight along it.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。硬羽：更长更挺、暗褐油亮、羽片不分叉；仍是自然色。

subject.zh: 一根长飞羽，斜放，羽根在左下、羽尖在右上，羽片略向一侧弯，近羽尖有两道深色横斑。羽色转为灰#8a8690，羽枝之间夹着几道细细的暗紫纹#4a3a62，顺着羽轴斜走。
subject.en: The same long flight feather on the diagonal, quill at lower left and tip at upper right, curving slightly with two dark crossbars near the tip. Turned grey #8a8690, with a few thin dark purple lines #4a3a62 running between the barbs, slanting along the shaft.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。紫纹顺羽枝斜走、只几道；两道横斑仍要看得见。

subject.zh: 一根长飞羽，斜放，羽根在左下、羽尖在右上，羽片略向一侧弯，近羽尖有两道深色横斑。羽色深灰#46424c，暗紫纹#4a3a62密布整片羽，两道横斑几乎融进底色，不发光。
subject.en: The same long flight feather on the diagonal, quill at lower left and tip at upper right, curving slightly with two crossbars near the tip. Dark grey #46424c, the whole vane densely lined with dark purple #4a3a62, the two bars almost lost in the dark ground; no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。紫纹密布、横斑几乎看不出；不发光，与T5区分。

subject.zh: 一根长飞羽，斜放，羽根在左下、羽尖在右上，羽片略向一侧弯，近羽尖有两道横斑。通体近黑#221e28，羽缘透出暗紫微光，外缘一圈淡淡的暗紫光，羽尖一个单像素亮点。
subject.en: The same long flight feather on the diagonal, quill at lower left and tip at upper right, curving slightly with two crossbars near the tip. Near-black all over #221e28, the vane edges glowing faintly dark purple #4a3a62, a thin dark purple glow along the outline, and one single-pixel bright point at the tip.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。近黑羽加暗紫微光；不要画成多根羽毛或翅膀。

subject.zh: 一支弯成弧形的兽角，斜放，角根在左下、角尖在右上，角身一圈圈横向环棱，角根截面平整。角色灰褐#b0a080，往角尖渐深成褐#6a5438，角面粗糙哑光。无纹，无光。
subject.en: A beast horn bent into an arc, lying on the diagonal, base at lower left and tip at upper right, ringed all along with crosswise ridges, the base cut flat. Grey-brown #b0a080 darkening to brown #6a5438 toward the tip, rough and matte. No markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。角五阶同形（弧形角加环棱）；与兽牙区分：角更长更粗、有环棱、根部平切。

subject.zh: 一支弯成弧形的兽角，斜放，角根在左下、角尖在右上，角身一圈圈横向环棱，角根截面平整。比兽角更粗更长，环棱更深，颜色深成栗褐#7a5a3a，角尖近黑褐，表面微亮。无纹。
subject.en: The same arced beast horn on the diagonal, base at lower left and tip at upper right, ringed with crosswise ridges and cut flat at the base. Thicker and longer than T1 with deeper rings, deepened to chestnut brown #7a5a3a with a near-black-brown tip and a slight sheen. No markings.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。坚角：与T1同形，更粗更长、栗褐微亮；仍是自然色。

subject.zh: 一支弯成弧形的兽角，斜放，角根在左下、角尖在右上，角身一圈圈横向环棱，角根截面平整。角色转为灰褐#8a8278，环棱的沟里爬着细细的暗紫纹#4a3a62。
subject.en: The same arced beast horn on the diagonal, base at lower left and tip at upper right, ringed with crosswise ridges and cut flat at the base. Turned grey-brown #8a8278, with thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 creeping in the grooves between the rings.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。紫纹只在环棱沟里；外形与T1、T2一致，不加枝杈。

subject.zh: 一支弯成弧形的兽角，斜放，角根在左下、角尖在右上，角身一圈圈横向环棱，角根截面平整。角色深灰褐#4a4448，暗紫纹#4a3a62绕着环棱密密缠满角身，不发光。
subject.en: The same arced beast horn on the diagonal, base at lower left and tip at upper right, ringed with crosswise ridges and cut flat at the base. Dark grey-brown #4a4448, dark purple veins #4a3a62 winding densely around the rings over the whole horn; no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。紫纹缠满全角、底色深；不发光，与T5区分。

subject.zh: 一支弯成弧形的兽角，斜放，角根在左下、角尖在右上，角身一圈圈横向环棱，角根截面平整。通体近黑#221e28，环棱透出暗紫微光，外缘一圈淡淡的暗紫光，角尖一个单像素亮点。
subject.en: The same arced beast horn on the diagonal, base at lower left and tip at upper right, ringed with crosswise ridges and cut flat at the base. Near-black all over #221e28, the rings glowing faintly dark purple #4a3a62, a thin dark purple glow along the outline, and one single-pixel bright point at the tip.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。近黑角加暗紫微光；仍是一支弧形角，不要画成号角或鹿角。

subject.zh: 一颗处理过的眼珠，打磨得像一枚圆润的宝石，正面朝观者；表面一层清亮釉光，一圈虹膜，中间一道竖瞳，干净无血丝。眼白米黄#ece4d0，虹膜琥珀褐#b07a30，竖瞳深褐。个头小，无纹。
subject.en: A treated eyeball polished like a smooth round gem, facing the viewer; a clear glaze over its surface, a ring of iris and a vertical slit pupil, clean with no veins or blood. Cream white #ece4d0 with an amber-brown iris #b07a30 and a dark brown pupil. Small, no markings.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。画成宝石般的眼珠，不要血腥、不带视神经；眼五阶同形，T1 是琥珀虹膜。

subject.zh: 一颗处理过的眼珠，打磨得像一枚圆润的宝石，正面朝观者；表面一层清亮釉光，一圈虹膜，中间一道竖瞳，干净无血丝。比兽眼大一圈，眼白更清，虹膜是明亮的金黄#d8a830，竖瞳更细，釉光更亮。
subject.en: The same treated, gem-polished eyeball facing the viewer, clear glaze, iris ring and vertical slit pupil, clean and bloodless. A size larger than T1 with a clearer white, a bright golden iris #d8a830, a thinner pupil and a brighter glaze. No markings.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。明眼：更大、金黄虹膜、釉光更亮；仍是自然色，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一颗处理过的眼珠，打磨得像一枚圆润的宝石，正面朝观者；表面一层清亮釉光，一圈虹膜，中间一道竖瞳，干净无血丝。眼白转灰#c0bcb8，虹膜灰琥珀，几道细细的暗紫纹#4a3a62从竖瞳向外放射。
subject.en: The same treated, gem-polished eyeball facing the viewer, clear glaze, iris ring and vertical slit pupil, clean and bloodless. The white has turned grey #c0bcb8, the iris a greyish amber, and a few thin dark purple lines #4a3a62 radiate outward from the pupil.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。紫纹从竖瞳放射、只几道；画成宝石般的球，不要血丝。

subject.zh: 一颗处理过的眼珠，打磨得像一枚圆润的宝石，正面朝观者；表面一层清亮釉光，一圈虹膜，中间一道竖瞳，干净无血丝。眼白暗灰#6a6670，虹膜几乎被暗紫纹#4a3a62密密盖满，竖瞳深黑，不发光。
subject.en: The same treated, gem-polished eyeball facing the viewer, clear glaze, iris ring and vertical slit pupil, clean and bloodless. Dark grey white #6a6670, the iris almost covered by dense dark purple lines #4a3a62, the pupil deep black; no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。虹膜被紫纹盖满、不发光；与T5的暗紫发光瞳区分。

subject.zh: 一颗处理过的眼珠，打磨得像一枚圆润的宝石，正面朝观者；表面一层清亮釉光，一圈虹膜，中间一道竖瞳，干净无血丝。整颗近黑#221e28，竖瞳透出暗紫微光，外缘一圈淡淡的暗紫光，釉面一个单像素亮点。
subject.en: The same treated, gem-polished eyeball facing the viewer, clear glaze, iris ring and vertical slit pupil, clean and bloodless. Near-black all over #221e28, the slit pupil glowing faintly dark purple #4a3a62, a thin dark purple glow around the outline, and one single-pixel bright point on the glaze.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。近黑宝石眼，只有竖瞳透暗紫光；不画眼眶与血肉。

subject.zh: 一块干缩的心形器官块，像风干的果子，表面布满皱褶，顶端两截短管口已经收拢封住，干净无血。颜色是风干的深红褐#7a3a2e，皱褶处稍暗，表面微微油亮。无纹，无光。
subject.en: A shrunken, dried heart-shaped organ like a withered fruit, its surface covered in wrinkles, two short vessel stubs at the top pinched closed, clean and bloodless. Dried deep red-brown #7a3a2e, darker in the folds, with a faint oily sheen. No markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。心四阶同形（干缩心形块，像风干果子）；不要鲜红滴血；T2 是自然深红褐。

subject.zh: 一块干缩的心形器官块，像风干的果子，表面布满皱褶，顶端两截短管口已经收拢封住，干净无血。颜色转为灰红褐#6a4a48，皱褶的沟里爬着几道细细的暗紫纹#4a3a62。
subject.en: The same shrunken, dried heart-shaped organ like a withered fruit, wrinkled all over, two vessel stubs pinched closed at the top, clean and bloodless. Turned greyish red-brown #6a4a48, with a few thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 creeping along the folds.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。紫纹只在皱褶沟里几道；仍是干缩的果子状，不要画成跳动的鲜心。

subject.zh: 一块干缩的心形器官块，像风干的果子，表面布满皱褶，顶端两截短管口已经收拢封住，干净无血。颜色暗灰褐#3e3438，暗紫纹#4a3a62密布皱褶，交织成网，不发光。
subject.en: The same shrunken, dried heart-shaped organ like a withered fruit, wrinkled all over, two vessel stubs pinched closed at the top, clean and bloodless. Dark grey-brown #3e3438, the folds densely netted with dark purple veins #4a3a62; no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。紫纹成网、底色暗；不发光，与T5的近黑微光区分。

subject.zh: 一块干缩的心形器官块，像风干的果子，表面布满皱褶，顶端两截短管口已经收拢封住，干净无血。通体近黑#221e28，皱褶里透出暗紫微光，外缘一圈淡淡的暗紫光，一个单像素亮点。
subject.en: The same shrunken, dried heart-shaped organ like a withered fruit, wrinkled all over, two vessel stubs pinched closed at the top, clean and bloodless. Near-black all over #221e28, the folds glowing faintly dark purple #4a3a62, a thin dark purple glow around the outline, and one single-pixel bright point.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。近黑干心加暗紫微光；光从皱褶里透出，不画血管或滴液。

subject.zh: 一片圆盾形的鳞片，前缘圆弧、后缘收出一小截鳞根，鳞面几道从根部放射的细棱，带一点珠光。小而薄，橄榄灰#9aa088，边缘半透明，珠光很淡。无纹，无光。
subject.en: A single round shield-shaped scale, its front edge a smooth arc and its back narrowing into a short root, a few fine ridges radiating from the root, with a faint pearly sheen. Small and thin, olive grey #9aa088, translucent at the edge, the sheen very faint. No markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。鳞片三阶同形（圆盾鳞加放射棱）；单片，与龙鳞、鳞革的成片细鳞区分。

subject.zh: 一片圆盾形的鳞片，前缘圆弧、后缘收出一小截鳞根，鳞面几道从根部放射的细棱，带一点珠光。比细鳞大一圈、更厚更硬，颜色深成暗橄榄绿#5e6a4a，放射棱更深，边缘不再透光。无纹。
subject.en: The same single round shield-shaped scale with a short root and fine ridges radiating from it, faintly pearly. A size larger, thicker and harder than T1, deepened to dark olive green #5e6a4a, with deeper ridges and an edge that no longer lets light through. No markings.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。硬鳞：与T1同形，更大更厚、暗橄榄绿；不用鳞革的青铜绿#6a7a50。

subject.zh: 一片圆盾形的鳞片，前缘圆弧、后缘收出一小截鳞根，鳞面几道从根部放射的细棱。颜色转为灰绿#6e7470，放射棱之间爬着细细的暗紫纹#4a3a62，珠光发暗。
subject.en: The same single round shield-shaped scale with a short root and fine ridges radiating from it. Turned grey-green #6e7470, with thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 creeping between the ridges, and the pearly sheen gone dull.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。鳞片最高阶是T3：几道细紫纹即可，不要近黑也不发光。

subject.zh: 一大块带骨腿肉，斜放，粗端是肉、细端露出一截白骨，肉外裹一层脂边，用一圈麻绳扎住。肉色鲜红#b04a3a，脂边米白#e8dcc0，骨头米黄。无纹，无光。
subject.en: A big bone-in haunch of meat lying on the diagonal, meat at the thick end and a stub of white bone at the thin end, a layer of fat around the outside and one loop of hemp cord tied around it. Fresh red meat #b04a3a, off-white fat #e8dcc0 and a pale yellow bone. No markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。兽肉五阶同形（带骨腿肉加麻绳）；与鹿肉卷、羊排、雪牛肉区分。

subject.zh: 一大块带骨腿肉，斜放，粗端是肉、细端露出一截白骨，肉外裹一层脂边，用一圈麻绳扎住。比兽肉更大更厚，肉色深红#8a2e28，脂边更厚，骨头更粗。无纹，无光。
subject.en: The same big bone-in haunch on the diagonal, meat at the thick end and a stub of white bone at the thin end, fat around the outside and one loop of hemp cord. Bigger and thicker than T1, deep red meat #8a2e28 with a thicker fat layer and a heavier bone. No markings, no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。厚肉：与T1同形，更大更厚、深红；仍是自然肉色，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一大块带骨腿肉，斜放，粗端是肉、细端露出一截白骨，肉外裹一层脂边，用一圈麻绳扎住。肉色转为灰红#8a5a58，肉里夹着细细的暗紫纹#4a3a62，像大理石纹。
subject.en: The same big bone-in haunch on the diagonal, meat at the thick end and a stub of white bone at the thin end, fat around the outside and one loop of hemp cord. The meat has turned greyish red #8a5a58, threaded with thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 like marbling.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。异兽肉：紫纹像大理石纹那样细；与雪牛肉的白色雪花纹区分。

subject.zh: 一大块带骨腿肉，斜放，粗端是肉、细端露出一截白骨，肉外裹一层脂边，用一圈麻绳扎住。肉色暗灰褐#5a4448，暗紫纹#4a3a62密布肉面，脂边也变成灰色，不发光。
subject.en: The same big bone-in haunch on the diagonal, meat at the thick end and a stub of bone at the thin end, fat around the outside and one loop of hemp cord. Dark grey-brown meat #5a4448 densely veined with dark purple #4a3a62, the fat turned grey as well; no glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。紫纹密布、脂边变灰；不发光，与T5区分。

subject.zh: 一大块带骨腿肉，斜放，粗端是肉、细端露出一截骨，肉外裹一层脂边，用一圈麻绳扎住。通体近黑#221e28，纹路透出暗紫微光，外缘一圈淡淡的暗紫光，骨端一个单像素亮点。
subject.en: The same big bone-in haunch on the diagonal, meat at the thick end and a stub of bone at the thin end, fat around the outside and one loop of hemp cord. Near-black all over #221e28, its veins glowing faintly dark purple #4a3a62, a thin dark purple glow along the outline, and one single-pixel bright point on the bone end.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。近黑肉加暗紫微光；带骨腿肉外形不变，麻绳仍要看得见。

subject.zh: 一块荒原古铁，四分之三俯视。和铁矿石一样大小的块，但它是锈结在一起的古铁件：锈壳#8a4a30里嵌着一枚旧铁环和半把古锁的轮廓，还露出一块空白小铁牌的边角。铁灰#7a7f88底色，没有光泽。
subject.en: A lump of wasteland old iron in three-quarter top-down view. The same size as an iron ore chunk, but made of ancient ironwork rusted together: an old iron ring and the outline of half an antique lock are embedded in a rust crust #8a4a30, with the corner of a small blank iron plate poking out. Iron-grey #7a7f88 underneath, matte.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。外形像矿块，但嵌着铁环、古锁、空白铁牌是区别；铁牌上不能有字或数字。

subject.zh: 一块赤砧铜，四分之三俯视。和铜矿石一样的灰褐岩块，嵌着赭橙铜脉#c87a48与更多的铜绿#5a9a80，岩缝里还夹着几粒暗红的榴石碎粒#8a2a2a，像血点。朴素，只有一点小高光。
subject.en: A chunk of red-anvil copper ore in three-quarter top-down view. The same grey-brown rock as copper ore, set with ochre-orange copper veins #c87a48 and more verdigris #5a9a80, plus a few dark red garnet grains #8a2a2a lodged in the cracks like drops of blood. Plain, with just a small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。与铜矿石同形，暗红榴石碎粒是区别；铜绿也更多一些。

subject.zh: 一块霜镐银，四分之三俯视。和银矿石一样的岩块，但岩石偏冷青灰#8a929a，银脉#d0d4dc宽厚饱满，几乎占满半块，没有铅灰晶粒；岩块一角结着一层白霜#eef2f6。银脉一道明亮高光。
subject.en: A chunk of frostpick silver ore in three-quarter top-down view. The same kind of rock as silver ore but a cooler blue-grey #8a929a, its silver veins #d0d4dc broad and rich, filling nearly half the chunk, with no lead-grey grains; one corner is coated in white frost #eef2f6. A bright highlight along the veins.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。银脉宽厚、无铅粒、一角结霜是区别；与普通银矿石区分，不画成锭。

subject.zh: 两根叠放的帝国制式钢锭，四分之三视角。与精钢锭同色同形，亮钢灰#a8b0bc，两根完全一样；每根端面都涂着一道深红漆#8a2a2a，侧面压着一排无字的短刻痕。整齐划一，顶边一线高光。
subject.en: Two stacked imperial standard steel ingots in three-quarter view. The same colour and shape as fine steel ingots, bright steel grey #a8b0bc, the two completely identical; each end face carries a stripe of dark red paint #8a2a2a and a row of short unlettered tally notches is pressed into the side. Uniform and orderly, a line of highlight on the top edge.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。两根一模一样的锭叠放、端面深红漆是区别；刻痕不能是数字。

subject.zh: 一根赤砧钢锭，四分之三视角，锭身比精钢锭更方更厚。亮钢灰#a8b0bc，顶面压着一个砧子形状的几何印，锭身两端留着一圈淡淡的回火色，从麦黄渐到暗红#8a3a2a。顶边一线高光。
subject.en: A red-anvil steel ingot in three-quarter view, squarer and thicker than a fine steel ingot. Bright steel grey #a8b0bc with an anvil-shaped geometric stamp pressed into the top, both ends showing a faint band of temper colour shading from wheat yellow to dark red #8a3a2a. A line of highlight on the top edge.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。砧形压印与两端回火色是区别；与精钢锭、帝国制式钢区分。

subject.zh: 一段精灵倒木，四分之三俯视，截面朝左上。和普通木材一样的中褐木身#8a6040，但两端是自然折断的参差断口，没有斧痕，树皮上覆着几块绿苔#6a8a48。朴素无光泽。
subject.en: A length of elven deadfall in three-quarter top-down view, end face toward the upper left. The same mid-brown wood #8a6040 as an ordinary log, but both ends are jagged natural breaks with no axe marks, and a few patches of green moss #6a8a48 cover the bark. Plain, no sheen.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。与普通木材同色同形，参差断口加绿苔是区别；不画斧痕。

subject.zh: 一块北境琥珀，四分之三俯视。和琥珀一样的蜂蜜橙色圆块#c8782a，半透明，正中封着一只小小的暗色飞虫，翅膀张开；顶端穿着一个小孔，系一段短短的皮绳。一个温暖的小高光。
subject.en: A piece of northern amber in three-quarter top-down view. The same honey-orange rounded lump #c8782a as amber, semi-translucent, with a tiny dark insect sealed at its centre, wings spread; a small hole is drilled through the top with a short leather cord tied through it. One warm small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。封在里面的小飞虫是区别，皮绳圈表示护身符；颜色与琥珀相同。

subject.zh: 一块林琥珀，四分之三俯视。和琥珀一样的圆块，但颜色偏浅黄绿#c8a840，内部清透，悬浮着几粒细小的浅绿光点#a8e0a0，整块透出一层柔和的内光。表面光滑，有一个小高光。
subject.en: A piece of forest amber in three-quarter top-down view. The same rounded lump as amber but a paler yellow-green #c8a840, clear inside with several tiny pale green motes of light #a8e0a0 suspended in it, the whole piece giving off a soft inner glow. Smooth, with one small highlight.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。内部的浅绿光点与柔和内光是区别；不封虫，与北境琥珀区分。

subject.zh: 一块玻璃原石英，四分之三俯视。像石英一样乳白半透明，但晶柱已熔成圆钝的玻璃团，表面一圈圈流动的熔纹，像凝住的蜡；透光却雾蒙蒙的，里面藏着几缕细暗紫纹#4a3a62。
