subject.en: A small white porcelain jar in three-quarter view, its mouth sealed with a flattened white flower #e8eee8 whose petals are blackening at the edges #4a3b2a; a thick run of honey seeps out from under the flower, milky white at the top and darkening to black-brown as it runs down the jar, with a few dark purple threads #4a3a62 tangled in it.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。白花封口与由白转黑的蜜痕是辨识点；与蜂蜜 honey 的粗陶罐金蜜、林蜜 honey_silva 区分；紫只几缕。

subject.zh: 一支凝角，斜放，角根在左下、角尖在右上。赤红色#b33a2a的角像一截凝固的血块，角面不是环棱，而是一层层流淌后凝住的瘤状纹；角根发黑#2e2a2c，角身爬着几道暗紫纹#4a3a62，角尖锋利。
subject.en: A clotted horn lying at a slant, base at lower left and tip at upper right. The crimson #b33a2a horn looks like a length of congealed blood, its surface not ringed but covered in lumpy ridges that seem to have run and set; the base darkens to near black #2e2a2c, a few dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep along the shaft, and the tip is sharp.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。流淌凝住的瘤状纹代替环棱是辨识点；不画血滴；与通用角 part_horn_t4、巢母角核 brood_horn_core 区分。

subject.zh: 一片圣咏瓷，四分之三俯视。一大片弧形的瓷白碎片#ede8dc，光滑如蛋壳，边缘碎成锯齿；外面绘着半圈左右对称的几何光环纹，纹线淡金#d8c27a；碎片一角开着一个圆孔，像张开的口；断口内侧透一线暗紫#4a3a62。
subject.en: A piece of choir porcelain seen in three-quarter view from above. A large curved shard of porcelain white #ede8dc, smooth as eggshell with a jagged broken edge; half a ring of symmetrical geometric halo pattern is painted on the outside in pale gold lines #d8c27a, a round hole opens at one corner like a singing mouth, and a thin line of dark purple #4a3a62 shows on the inner side of the break.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。不发光，不用神光白金；圆孔与对称光环纹是辨识点；与照纹灯残件 mt_sigil_lamp_shard 区分。

subject.zh: 一张苍榆鹿皮，折成两折，四分之三俯视。和生皮一样外露浅肉米色#c8a888的肉面，边缘不规整，中间用粗绳捆住打结；只是翻折处露出的一线褐色短毛#7a5a40上点着几粒小白斑#e8e0d0。
subject.en: A greyelm deerskin folded in two, three-quarter top-down view. Like the raw hide, its exposed flesh side is pale fleshy beige #c8a888 with ragged edges and a thick cord knotted round the middle; only the line of short brown fur #7a5a40 showing at the fold is dotted with a few small white spots #e8e0d0.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。与生皮 hide 同形同色，翻折处鹿毛上的小白斑是唯一区别；不画鹿角与鹿头。

subject.zh: 一只矮胖的粗陶蜜罐，正面四分之三视角；和蜂蜜一样罐口蒙本色布，细绳扎紧，金琥珀色#d89a30的蜜从布边溢出，沿罐身流下；只是扎布的细绳下插着一小枝白色碎花#f0ece0。
subject.en: A squat coarse earthenware honey pot in front three-quarter view; like the plain honey, its mouth is covered with undyed cloth tied down with thin string, and golden-amber honey #d89a30 seeps from under the cloth and runs down the side; only a small sprig of tiny white flowers #f0ece0 is tucked under the string.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。与蜂蜜 honey 同形同色，绳下的白色碎花是唯一区别；不画蜜蜂与蜂巢，蜜色不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 一颗鼠后之心：干缩的心形器官块，比一般兽心圆胖，表面布满皱褶，暗红褐#6a3a30；外面缠着几根稻草与谷壳#d8c070，一侧粘着一小撮灰褐鼠毛#6b6359；顶端两截短管口收拢封住，干净无血。
subject.en: A rat queen's heart: a shrunken, wrinkled heart-shaped organ, plumper and rounder than an ordinary beast heart, dark red-brown #6a3a30; a few strands of straw and grain husk #d8c070 are tangled around it, a small tuft of grey-brown rat fur #6b6359 clings to one side, and the two short vessel stubs at the top are pinched closed, clean and bloodless.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_heart_t1；缠稻草谷壳、粘鼠毛是与通用心 part_heart_t2 的区分；不加紫。

subject.zh: 一片锈母甲，正面略带俯视。拱起的椭圆甲片，比普通甲片厚重，像一块锈铁板#8a4a2a，暗处铁褐#5a3a28；中央一道焊缝似的隆脊纵贯甲面，两侧排着一行行铆钉般的圆凸；边缘落着一点橙褐锈粉。
subject.en: A rust matron's carapace seen from the front and slightly above. An arched oval plate, heavier than an ordinary carapace, like a slab of rusted iron #8a4a2a with iron-brown #5a3a28 in the shadows; a welded-seam ridge runs down its center, rows of rivet-like round bumps line both sides, and a little orange-brown rust powder has fallen from its edge.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_carapace_t2；焊缝隆脊与铆钉圆凸是区分点；不要画成盾牌（盾是 eq_rustmatron_buckler）。

subject.zh: 一枚头狼牙，斜放，牙根在左下、牙尖在右上。比普通兽牙更长更弯，像一把小弯刀，牙身灰黄#c8b890，牙面一道深深的旧裂痕；牙根裹着一撮赤黑硬鬃#5a1a16，用细皮绳缠住。不发光。
subject.en: A den alpha's fang lying at a slant, root at lower left and tip at upper right. Longer and more curved than an ordinary beast fang, like a small curved knife, grey-yellow #c8b890 with one deep old crack along its face; a tuft of stiff red-black mane #5a1a16 is wrapped around the root and bound with a thin leather thong. No glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_fang_t2；刀形长弯牙加赤黑鬃是区分点；与狼牙 wolf_fang、头狼牙刀装备区分。

subject.zh: 一枚豺窟老母牙，斜放，牙根在左下、牙尖在右上。细长微弯，比狼牙窄，牙身旧黄#c8b088，布满细小的纵裂纹，牙尖已被磨钝；牙根连着一小撮灰白的嘴边毛#d8d4c8，夹几根灰黄毛#9a8a6a。
subject.en: A jackal matriarch's fang lying at a slant, root at lower left and tip at upper right. Long, slender and slightly curved, narrower than a wolf's fang, old yellow #c8b088 covered in fine lengthwise cracks, its tip worn blunt; a small tuft of grey-white muzzle hair #d8d4c8 mixed with a few grey-yellow hairs #9a8a6a still clings to the root.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_fang_t2；磨钝的牙尖与灰白嘴边毛是区分点；与头狼牙 den_alpha_fang 区分，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一团骨冢之心，四分之三俯视。拳头大的一球碎骨与小头骨紧紧压在一起，骨色从灰黄#c8bfa8到焦黑#3a3632，骨缝里卡着一截锈断的箭镞；正中一圈小头骨围出的空洞里透出暗红微光#b33a2a，骨面爬着几道细暗紫纹#4a3a62。
subject.en: A bonepile core seen in three-quarter view from above. A fist-sized ball of bone shards and small skulls packed tightly together, ranging from grey-yellow #c8bfa8 to charred black #3a3632, a rusted broken arrowhead wedged in a gap; a ring of small skulls in the middle encircles a hollow that glows dull dark red #b33a2a, and a few fine dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep over the bone.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_bone_t3；头骨环与暗红空洞是区分点，不是单根腿骨；与骨冢头骨锤 eq_bonepile_crown_maul 区分。

subject.zh: 一块灶心石，四分之三俯视。一块被烟熏黑的方砖石#4d4a52，一面烧得发红褐，表面挂着一层灶灰#8a8580；石心裂开一道缝，缝里透出淡淡的冷紫火光#c6b5e0；石边粘着一小片碎陶碗片。
subject.en: A hearthstone seen in three-quarter view from above. A squarish soot-blackened brick of stone #4d4a52, one face burnt reddish-brown, coated in hearth ash #8a8580; a crack runs through its heart with a faint cold violet firelight #c6b5e0 showing inside, and a small chip of broken earthenware bowl is stuck to its edge.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_essence_t4；熏黑方石与裂缝冷火是区分点；与灶心石戒 eq_empty_house_hearth_ring 区分。

subject.zh: 一个白囊，梨形，上端收窄成短管，用细麻绳扎住。囊皮瓷白#ede8dc，光滑得像上了釉，一圈圈节纹左右完全对称，节缝泛淡金#d8c27a；囊里的液体透出淡蓝#9db4c8。干净无血。
subject.en: A pale sac, pear-shaped and narrowing at the top into a short duct tied off with thin hemp cord. The skin is porcelain white #ede8dc and smooth as glaze, ringed with perfectly symmetrical segment lines whose seams carry a pale gold tint #d8c27a; the liquid inside shows a pale blue #9db4c8. Clean and bloodless.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_gland_t2；瓷白对称节纹区别于黄绿毒腺；不发光，不用神光白金；与白囊手套 eq_pale_brood_gloves 区分。

subject.zh: 一块回音砚坯，四分之三俯视。一块未经雕琢的扁平墨黑石片#2b2b3a，天然凹下一个浅池，池里积着一汪墨水，水面一圈圈同心涟漪；石面贴着两三片残破的羊皮纸屑#d8d2c0，纸上只有模糊墨点。
subject.en: A raw echo inkstone seen in three-quarter view from above. An uncarved flat slab of ink-black stone #2b2b3a with a natural shallow hollow holding a pool of ink, rings of concentric ripples spreading across its surface; two or three torn scraps of parchment #d8d2c0 stick to the stone, bearing only blurred ink dots.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_essence_t2；是粗坯，与成品砚 eq_lecture_echo_inkstone、留声石区分；纸屑无字。

subject.zh: 一块烽燧余烬，心形的焦黑炭核#2e2a28，四分之三俯视。炭壳裂成龟甲纹，裂缝里透出暗红余火#b33a2a，深处夹着几缕暗紫#4a3a62；核外箍着半圈熏黑的铁片#3c3f46，顶上飘起两三点火星。
subject.en: A beacon ember core seen in three-quarter view from above, a heart-shaped charred coal #2e2a28. Its crust is cracked like a tortoise shell, dark red embers #b33a2a glowing in the cracks with a few threads of dark purple #4a3a62 deep inside; half a band of soot-blackened iron #3c3f46 hugs the core, and two or three sparks drift up from the top.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_heart_t4；心形炭核加半圈铁箍是区分点；火是暗红不是暖橙，与灰烬精华 ash_essence 区分。

subject.zh: 一块宝窟锁板，正面略俯视。一块拱起的旧锁板，包铜发绿#8a7a3a，钉在一片暗褐木板#5a4028上；正中一个大锁眼，锁眼周围一圈细尖的铜齿，像一张小嘴；板缝里卡着两枚金褐小钱#c9a227。
subject.en: A hoard lockplate seen from the front and slightly above. An arched old lock plate of green-tarnished brass #8a7a3a nailed onto a piece of dark brown board #5a4028; a large keyhole sits in the middle ringed with fine pointed brass teeth like a small mouth, and two little gold-brown coins #c9a227 are wedged in a seam.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_carapace_t2；带齿锁眼的拱形锁板是区分点，币面无字；与锁板背心 eq_hoard_lockplate_vest 区分。

subject.zh: 一块渣心石，四分之三俯视。拳头大的圆鼓炉渣块，黑灰色#3a3634，表面起泡多孔，夹着锈铁斑#6a4a3a；裂缝里透出橙红热光#c8682a，最深处一点亮黄#e09a3a；一角卡着一片焦黑的纸屑。
subject.en: A slag heartstone seen in three-quarter view from above. A fist-sized rounded lump of slag, black-grey #3a3634, blistered and porous with patches of rusty iron #6a4a3a; orange-red heat #c8682a glows through its cracks with one point of bright yellow #e09a3a at the deepest spot, and a scrap of charred paper is caught in one corner.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_essence_t2；裂缝橙黄热光是区分点；与澱渣 mat_dross、渣心锤 eq_slagheart_hammer 区分。

subject.zh: 一顶孢窟菌冠，单朵连一小截菌柄，四分之三视角。菌盖宽而层叠，边缘翻卷成一圈王冠似的尖瓣，灰白#c9c1a0带橄榄绿霉斑#6b7f3a；菌褶里飘出几粒细小的孢粉。不发光。
subject.en: A grotto sporecap, a single mushroom with a short stub of stalk, in three-quarter view. The cap is broad and layered, its edge curling up into a ring of crown-like points, grey-white #c9c1a0 blotched with olive-green mold #6b7f3a; a few tiny grains of spore dust drift from its gills. No glow.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_gland_t2；王冠尖瓣菌盖是区分点；与夜帽菇 mat_nightcap、菌冠杖 eq_sporecap_staff 区分。

subject.zh: 一个蝗卵囊，长圆形像一截鼓胀的豆荚，四分之三俯视。囊皮枯黄#c9c1a0，爬着橄榄绿的脉纹#6b7f3a，透过囊皮看得见里面一排排米粒般的卵；囊底粘着一点暗褐泥土#4a3b2a。
subject.en: A locust brood sac seen in three-quarter view from above, oblong like a swollen bean pod. Its withered yellow skin #c9c1a0 is veined with olive green #6b7f3a, and rows of rice-grain eggs show through it; a little dark brown soil #4a3b2a clings to its underside.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_gland_t2；豆荚形与成排的卵是区分点；与同色菌冠 grotto_sporecap、护腕区分。

subject.zh: 一枚巢母角核，斜放。角根是一团暗红肉质的核#5a1a16，从中歪扭着长出一截粗短的黑角#1c1a1a；角面裂纹里露出赤红#b33a2a，核上爬着几道暗紫纹#4a3a62。不滴血。
subject.en: A brood mother's horn core lying at a slant. The base is a lump of dark red fleshy core #5a1a16 from which a short, thick, crooked black horn #1c1a1a grows; crimson #b33a2a shows in the cracks of the horn, and a few dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep over the core. No dripping blood.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_horn_t4；暗红肉核加黑色歪角是区分点；与通体赤红的凝角 mat_clotted_horn 区分。

subject.zh: 一块蜕鳞板，正面略俯视。几片大鳞连成一整块薄板，冰蓝灰#8a9aa8，鳞缘泛银#d0d8e0；鳞片空薄，边缘透光，背面看得见空空的鳞窝；板角卷起一圈薄薄的蜕皮边。
subject.en: A sloughed scale plate seen from the front and slightly above. Several large scales joined into one thin plate, icy blue-grey #8a9aa8 with silver-edged scales #d0d8e0; the scales are hollow and thin, their edges letting light through, the empty scale sockets visible behind, and one corner curls up in a thin rim of shed skin.

items.notes: 材料：阶由材料本身的稀有度与光泽体现，不加品质装饰。巢主专名部件，可替代 part_scale_t2；连成一板的冰蓝空鳞是区分点；与龙蜕屑 mat_dragon_molt、云阶霜符区分。
